papers.summary: 本文提出Agibot，一个面向农业机器人研究与教学的开源模块化低成本平台，旨在缓解农业自动化研究中 affordable、灵活、可获取研究平台稀缺的问题。平台硬件集成四轮独立转向驱动、可更换计算单元、分布式嵌入控制、多模态传感与可配置操作机构，软件上构建统一的感知-规划-执行-验证（sense-plan-act-verify）框架，覆盖感知、控制、导航、操作与自主任务验证。作者在行作物场景下开展代表性导航与操作任务评估，涵盖不同光照与土壤条件，验证了车道跟随、行间自主导航、目标识别、播种、植株操作及任务成功闭环验证等概念验证能力，并通过控制器调参研究与集成试验展示平台研究能力。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Agibot以开源、模块化、低成本方式整合四轮独立转向与感知-规划-执行-验证框架，为农业机器人自主性研究与教学提供可复现的硬件与软件基座。
papers.core_method: 构建四轮独立转向驱动的模块化移动底盘，搭配可更换计算单元、分布式嵌入控制、多模态传感与可配置操作机构；软件层面统一实现感知-规划-执行-验证闭环框架，支持感知、控制、导航、操作与自主任务验证，并以行作物导航和操作任务进行概念验证与控制器调参评估。
innovation_points: 开源模块化低成本硬件架构，支持计算、传感与操作模块独立替换与快速原型验证
四轮独立转向驱动赋予平台在行作物场景下灵活机动与行间自主导航能力
统一sense-plan-act-verify框架将感知、控制、导航、操作与任务成功闭环验证集成于单一平台
兼顾研究与教学双重定位，强调可获取性与可重构性以支持动手机器人教育
experiment_results: 在行作物导航与操作任务中展示可靠的车道跟随与行间自主导航能力
完成目标识别、播种、植株操作及任务成功闭环验证等概念验证任务
在不同光照与土壤条件下开展集成试验与控制器调参研究，但摘要未给出定量性能指标
limitations: 评估以概念验证任务与控制器调参为主，摘要未报告定量精度、成功率或效率指标
平台定位为研究与教学基座，尚未涉及大规模田间长期部署或生产级可靠性验证
摘要未说明与现有农业机器人平台在成本、性能上的系统对比
papers.practical_value: 为农业机器人自主性研究提供低成本、可重构的开源硬件与软件基座，降低实验室原型开发与课程教学门槛，支持感知、导航、操作等组件的独立测试与快速迭代，并可用于农业机器人劳动力培训。
papers.why_it_matters: 农业劳动力短缺与自动化需求上升，但研究平台昂贵且封闭；Agibot以开源模块化设计降低进入门槛，其sense-plan-act-verify闭环框架为农业自主任务研究提供可复现的实验基座，对研究与教学均有直接参考价值。

papers.title: SURE:Spatiotemporal Uncertainty Representation for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Learning
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies have become a promising paradigm for end-to-end robot control, but their effectiveness still depends heavily on large volumes of demonstration data. In manipulation tasks, this dependence is compounded by structured spatiotemporal uncertainty in the action space: multiple nearby actions or trajectories may successfully solve the same task, while semantically equivalent demonstrations often unfold at different speeds. Standard pointwise supervision treats each demonstrated action as an exact target, imposing an unnecessary learning burden under such uncertainty. We present SURE, a data-efficient VLA training framework that explicitly models both spatial and temporal uncertainty. SURE augments a VLA backbone with a lightweight transposed-convolutional probabilistic action decoder that captures spatial uncertainty through local correlations among neighboring action bins. It further introduces Soft-DTW alignment supervision to accommodate local timing variations between predicted and demonstrated action chunks. Together, these two components reduce sensitivity to demonstrator-specific poses and execution timing, enabling more data-efficient action learning. We evaluate SURE on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world manipulation tasks. Even with only 10% of the demonstration data or 20% of the training steps, SURE achieves manipulation success rates that match or surpass baseline VLAs.
papers.summary: SURE针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略在机器人操作任务中依赖大量示范数据的问题，指出动作空间存在结构化的时空不确定性：同一任务可由多个邻近动作或轨迹完成，语义等价的示范常以不同速度执行，而标准逐点监督将每个示范动作视为精确目标，带来不必要的学习负担。为此，SURE在VLA骨干上增加轻量转置卷积概率动作解码器，通过邻近动作bin的局部相关性建模空间不确定性；并引入Soft-DTW对齐监督，容忍预测动作块与示范动作块之间的局部时序变化。两者共同降低对示范者特定姿态与执行时序的敏感性，实现更数据高效的动作学习。在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和真实操作任务上，仅用10%示范数据或20%训练步数即可达到或超过基线VLA的成功率。
papers.one_line_takeaway: SURE通过显式建模动作空间的时空不确定性，显著降低VLA对示范数据量和训练步数的依赖。
papers.core_method: 在VLA骨干上附加轻量转置卷积概率动作解码器，以局部相关性建模邻近动作bin的空间不确定性；同时采用Soft-DTW对齐监督，容忍预测与示范动作块之间的局部时序变化，形成数据高效的训练框架。
innovation_points: 将动作空间中的空间不确定性建模为邻近动作bin的局部相关分布，而非逐点精确回归
引入Soft-DTW对齐监督处理语义等价示范的执行速度差异，容忍局部时序变化
轻量概率解码器与VLA骨干结合，不显著增加模型复杂度
experiment_results: 在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和真实操作任务上评估，仅用10%示范数据或20%训练步数，成功率匹配或超过基线VLA
摘要未提供各任务的具体成功率数值和消融实验数据
limitations: 摘要未报告具体成功率数值与方差，难以量化相对提升幅度
仅在操作任务上验证，未覆盖其他机器人任务类型或更复杂场景
Soft-DTW与概率解码器的计算开销及超参数敏感性未在摘要中说明
papers.practical_value: 为机器人操作任务提供数据高效的VLA训练方案，在示范数据采集成本高或训练资源受限时，可用更少数据和更短训练达到可比成功率，降低部署门槛。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作从动作空间时空不确定性角度重新审视VLA的监督方式，而非单纯扩大数据或模型，为数据高效机器人学习提供了可复用的建模范式。

papers.title: ToolDex: An Ego-Exo Human Demonstration Dataset for Creative Physical Tool Use
papers.abstract: Creative tool use is a fundamental human capability and an important step toward general-purpose embodied intelligence. It requires agents to reason about object affordances, physical constraints, and manipulation strategies, especially when standard tools are unavailable. However, progress in this area is limited by the lack of real-world datasets that capture human tool-use behavior with sufficient scale, fidelity, and diversity. Existing benchmarks are often simulation-based, focus on simplified interactions, or lack detailed observations and annotations. We introduce ToolDex, a large-scale egocentric-exocentric (ego-exo) human demonstration dataset for creative physical tool use. ToolDex captures scenarios in which humans select, adapt, and repurpose available objects as tools. Using synchronized egocentric cameras and eight exocentric cameras, the dataset provides high-fidelity multi-view observations and rich annotations for hands, tools, target objects, and their deformable interactions. Beyond data collection, we establish a benchmark suite characterizing three core capabilities: physical tool-use reasoning, sparse-view 3D and 4D reconstruction, and robot policy learning. ToolDex provides a foundation for studying human tool-use behavior and developing embodied agents that can adaptively use tools in complex real-world environments. Dataset visualizations and benchmarking results are available at https://tooluse-dataset.github.io/.
papers.summary: 针对创造性工具使用缺乏真实世界大规模数据的问题，ToolDex构建了自我中心-外中心（ego-exo）人类演示数据集，捕捉人类选择、改造和重新利用现有物体作为工具的场景。数据采集采用同步的第一人称相机与八台外中心相机，提供高保真多视角观测，并对双手、工具、目标物体及其可变形交互进行丰富标注。基于该数据集，作者建立了覆盖物理工具使用推理、稀疏视角3D/4D重建和机器人策略学习三项核心能力的基准套件。该工作为研究人类工具使用行为、开发能在复杂真实环境中自适应使用工具的具身智能体提供了数据基础与评测平台。
papers.one_line_takeaway: ToolDex以同步ego-exo多视角真实演示数据填补创造性工具使用基准空白，并配套三项具身能力评测。
papers.core_method: 构建大规模自我中心-外中心人类演示数据集：同步第一人称相机与八台外中心相机采集人类选择、改造、复用物体作为工具的过程，标注手、工具、目标物体及可变形交互；并据此设计物理工具使用推理、稀疏视角3D/4D重建、机器人策略学习三类基准任务。
innovation_points: 面向创造性工具使用这一真实场景，采集人类选择、改造与复用物体的演示数据，而非简化或仿真交互
采用同步ego视角与八台exo相机的多视角采集方案，提供高保真观测
标注覆盖手、工具、目标物体及其可变形交互，支持细粒度物理理解
建立推理、重建、策略学习三位一体的基准套件，连接感知与具身决策
experiment_results: 摘要与元数据未给出具体量化指标；仅说明已建立三类能力基准并提供可视化与评测结果，具体数值需查阅原文
limitations: 数据规模、场景与受试者多样性等具体统计未在给定材料中披露
基准结果缺乏量化数据，难以直接评估各任务难度与现有方法差距
真实演示数据到机器人策略的迁移效果未在摘要中说明
papers.practical_value: 为具身智能研究提供真实世界多视角工具使用演示数据与统一评测基准，可用于训练和评估工具选择、物理推理、稀疏视角重建及机器人操作策略，降低对仿真数据的依赖。
papers.why_it_matters: 创造性工具使用是通用具身智能的关键能力，而真实世界数据稀缺长期制约该方向；ToolDex同时提供高保真多视角数据与多任务基准，为数据驱动的方法比较和机器人工具使用研究提供公共基础。

papers.title: Vision–Language–Action Model for Agricultural Fresh Produce Handling with a Humanoid Robot
papers.abstract: Reaching, grasping, and placing delicate fresh produce are among the most labor-intensive operations in agricultural production, yet most robotic solutions remain task-specific, single-crop systems that generalize poorly across the morphological diversity of fresh produce. This study investigates whether a large, pre-trained Vision–Language–Action (VLA) model can be adapted with only modest demonstration data to serve as a flexible language-conditioned produce-handling policy on a humanoid robotic platform. The NVIDIA GR00T N1.7-3B foundation model is fine-tuned for a standard 23-degree-of-freedom Unitree G1 humanoid robot fitted with two Dex3-1 three-finger dexterous hands, whose arm and hand joint streams form a 24-dimensional combined manipulation command space. This study also compared the π0.5 VLA model. Demonstrations were collected through a Meta Quest 3 extended-reality teleoperation pipeline augmented with a multi-label recording mode that embeds a natural-language goal in each episode, yielding 605 language-conditioned demonstrations (261,724 synchronized frames) across four produce categories (lemon, peach, pear, and tomato). A dual-camera design paired a wide-angle head camera for global scene context with a wrist-mounted camera for close-range grasp feedback. The results show that the fine-tuned policy achieved a 96.25% individual-trial success rate and 85% on mixed-scene trials requiring retrieval of the language-specified item. However, adapting the π0.5 VLA model to the same data achieved 68.75% individual-trial success. Furthermore, a controlled ablation isolated the role of close-range perception. Without wrist-camera input, the policy reached every target in single-item trials but failed to secure a single grasp, resulting in 0% pick-and-place success despite comparable training loss. Therefore, close-range wrist perception was a precondition for contact in this setting. Together, these results demonstrate that VLA fine-tuning can transform a pre-trained humanoid foundation model into a reliable, data-efficient policy for multi-category fresh produce handling. This work provides a practical step toward flexible humanoid robotic systems for agricultural pick-and-place, sorting, and postharvest automation.
papers.summary: 本研究面向农业鲜果抓取这一劳动密集且形态多样的操作场景，探究能否用少量示范数据将大规模预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型适配为人形机器人上的语言条件操作策略。作者以NVIDIA GR00T N1.7-3B为基座，在23自由度Unitree G1人形机器人（配双Dex3-1三指灵巧手，24维联合操作命令空间）上微调，并与π0.5 VLA对比。示范数据经Meta Quest 3扩展现实遥操作管线采集，采用多标签记录模式将自然语言目标嵌入每段轨迹，共605条语言条件示范、261724帧，覆盖柠檬、桃、梨、番茄四类。感知采用头部广角相机提供全局场景与腕部相机提供近距抓取反馈的双相机设计。结果显示微调策略单项试验成功率96.25%，混合场景按语言指定取物成功率85%；π0.5在同数据下仅68.75%。消融表明去掉腕部相机后单项试验虽能到达目标但抓取成功率为0%，说明近距腕部感知是接触成功的前提。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 用约600条语言条件示范微调GR00T N1.7-3B，即可让人形机器人对多类鲜果实现96.25%的单项抓放成功率，而腕部近距视觉是抓取成功的必要条件。
papers.core_method: 以NVIDIA GR00T N1.7-3B预训练VLA为基座，在Unitree G1人形机器人（23自由度、双三指灵巧手、24维联合操作命令空间）上做语言条件策略微调；通过Meta Quest 3扩展现实遥操作采集带自然语言目标的多标签示范（605条、261724帧、四类水果）；采用头部广角相机与腕部相机双相机感知，并与π0.5 VLA在相同数据上对比，另做去除腕部相机的消融。
innovation_points: 将大规模预训练VLA基座以少量示范数据适配到人形机器人多类别鲜果操作，验证数据高效迁移路径
构建带自然语言目标嵌入的XR遥操作多标签示范采集管线，形成语言条件操作数据集
设计头部广角加腕部近距的双相机感知结构，并用消融定量隔离近距感知对抓取的作用
在同一数据条件下横向对比GR00T N1.7-3B与π0.5两类VLA模型的人形操作表现
experiment_results: 微调后策略单项试验成功率96.25%，混合场景按语言指定取物成功率85%
π0.5 VLA在相同数据上单项试验成功率为68.75%
去除腕部相机输入的消融中，单项试验均能到达目标但抓取成功率为0%，训练损失与完整模型相当
limitations: 示范数据规模有限（605条、四类水果），未报告跨更多形态或更复杂堆叠场景的泛化结果
研究聚焦抓取放置任务，未涉及分拣、采后处理等更完整流程的验证
仅基于给定摘要与元数据，缺少推理时延、力控安全等工程指标的公开数据
papers.practical_value: 为农业鲜果抓取、分拣与采后自动化提供了一条可落地的人形机器人路线：复用预训练VLA基座，仅需数百条遥操作示范即可获得语言条件操作策略，降低新品类与新场景的数据采集成本；同时明确腕部近距感知是抓取成功的硬性前提，对硬件配置与传感器选型有直接指导意义。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把通用VLA基座模型与人形机器人农业操作的真实需求连接起来，用受控实验说明少量示范即可获得高成功率，并揭示近距视觉对接触成败的决定性作用，为后续农业人形机器人的数据效率与感知配置研究提供了可复现的参照。

papers.title: Can LLMs Debug Robots by Editing Their Weights?
papers.abstract: A language model can repair a robot policy's lexical instruction grounding by editing just 65 token-embedding rows. We bring weight-space programming to robot foundation policies: GPT-6 Astra reads weights and uses a CPU workspace and budgeted simulator feedback, without gradient updates or new demonstrations. Three independent sessions on $π_{0.5}$ all improve success on 765 held-out paraphrases; the best raises success from 86.3\% to 92.0\% (48 repairs, four regressions; exact paired $p=1.31\times10^{-10}$). Among the 335 instructions containing edited tokens, success rises from 74.3\% to 87.5\%; the other 430 episodes have zero outcome changes. Matched random-direction edits do not help. Full replacement using the editor's own lexicon explains much of the gain but produces more regressions; its direct difference from the editor is not significant at 0.05. Across 13 further robot sessions, the editor declines 12 candidates; the sole retained edit does not show a significant held-out gain. Separately, benchmark metadata lowers FastWAM success from 70.0\% to 48.6\%, while the evaluated VLA's aggregate rate is unchanged. The evidence supports precise lexical repair, not general acquisition of missing robot capabilities.
papers.summary: 论文研究LLM能否通过直接编辑机器人策略权重来修复其指令理解缺陷，而非依赖梯度更新或新示范。作者提出将权重空间编程用于机器人基础策略：GPT-6 Astra读取权重，在CPU工作区中结合有预算的模拟器反馈，仅编辑65行token嵌入。在π0.5上三个独立会话均提升765条留出改写指令的成功率，最佳从86.3%升至92.0%（48次修复、4次回退，配对p=1.31e-10）；含被编辑token的335条指令成功率从74.3%升至87.5%，其余430条结果不变。匹配随机方向编辑无效。用编辑器自带词表做完整替换可解释大部分增益但回退更多，与编辑器直接差异在0.05水平不显著。另13个机器人会话中编辑器拒绝12个候选，唯一保留的编辑无显著留出增益。基准元数据使FastWAM成功率从70.0%降至48.6%，而所评估VLA总体不变。证据支持精确的词法修复，而非通用缺失能力获取。
papers.one_line_takeaway: LLM可通过编辑少量token嵌入行精确修复机器人策略的词法指令接地，但无法获得其缺失的通用能力。
papers.core_method: 将权重空间编程引入机器人基础策略：语言模型GPT-6 Astra读取策略权重，在CPU工作区中操作，并利用有预算的模拟器反馈搜索编辑方案；不进行梯度更新，也不使用新示范，仅修改少量token嵌入行来修复词法指令接地。
innovation_points: 提出面向机器人基础策略的权重空间编程范式，由LLM直接读取并编辑权重，无需梯度更新或新示范
仅编辑65行token嵌入即可修复词法指令接地，并设计有预算的模拟器反馈与CPU工作区搜索流程
通过匹配随机方向编辑、完整词表替换等对照，区分精确词法修复与通用能力获取
在多个独立会话中系统评估编辑的保留与拒绝策略，揭示编辑的适用范围与边界
experiment_results: π0.5上三个独立会话均提升765条留出改写指令成功率，最佳从86.3%升至92.0%（48次修复、4次回退，精确配对p=1.31e-10）
含被编辑token的335条指令成功率从74.3%升至87.5%，其余430条结果零变化；匹配随机方向编辑无效
13个进一步机器人会话中编辑器拒绝12个候选，唯一保留编辑无显著留出增益；基准元数据使FastWAM成功率从70.0%降至48.6%，所评估VLA总体不变
limitations: 增益主要来自词法指令接地的精确修复，而非通用机器人能力的获取
完整词表替换虽能解释大部分增益但回退更多，与编辑器直接差异在0.05水平不显著
多数新会话候选被拒绝，唯一保留编辑无显著留出增益，泛化性有限
papers.practical_value: 为机器人基础策略提供一种低成本、无需梯度更新和新示范的权重空间修复手段，可在部署后针对词法指令理解缺陷进行精准修补，并借助模拟器反馈与拒绝机制控制回退风险，对线上策略维护具有工程参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作首次系统验证LLM可通过直接编辑权重修复机器人策略的指令接地，并清晰界定其能力边界：精确词法修复可行，通用能力获取不可行，为权重空间编程与机器人策略维护提供了可复现的实验证据与对照设计。

papers.title: The World Model Planning Accelerator (WMPA): Hardware-Algorithm Co-Design for Embedded AI in Robotics
papers.abstract: Embedded AI is moving from perception to prediction. Robots now use world models$\unicode{x2014}$learned simulators that predict the outcome of candidate actions in a compressed latent space before any is executed. Every predicted step must be computed on board within a tight power and thermal budget, yet the energy these steps fundamentally require, and how far real hardware sits from it, have not been characterized. We derive lower bounds on the arithmetic operations and the CMOS dynamic energy of a latent state transition from information theory and Boolean circuit complexity. Profiling a DreamerV3-style Recurrent State Space Model (RSSM) shows that every rollout operation is memory-bandwidth bound and that a GPU consumes at least $5.9\times10^{10}$ times the CMOS energy floor. Transient 3D thermal simulations show that this inefficiency is also a thermal one, since sustained back-to-back planning heats a millimeter-scale silicon tile to 556 K even behind an ideal copper heat spreader. Guided by this chain from bound to bottleneck, we propose the World Model Planning Accelerator (WMPA), a chip architecture for embedded world model planning that combines near-memory computation, real-time entropy estimation, variable-precision rollout units, and copy-on-write latent scratchpads. With a design target of 40x lower power, the same tile stays near ambient at 306 K in simulation, pointing toward practical planning on thermally constrained robots.
papers.summary: 该论文针对嵌入式机器人中世界模型规划（以DreamerV3式RSSM为代表）的硬件能耗问题展开研究。作者首先从信息论与布尔电路复杂度出发，推导潜状态转移所需算术操作数与CMOS动态能量的理论下界；随后对RSSM rollout进行性能剖析，发现每个rollout操作均受内存带宽约束，且GPU能耗至少为CMOS能量下界的5.9×10^10倍；瞬态3D热仿真进一步表明，持续规划可使毫米级硅片在理想铜散热器下升温至556 K。基于从下界到瓶颈的分析链条，作者提出WMPA芯片架构，融合近内存计算、实时熵估计、可变精度rollout单元与写时复制潜变量暂存区，设计目标为功耗降低40倍，仿真中同尺寸硅片温度维持在306 K附近。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 论文从信息论下界与热仿真出发，揭示嵌入式世界模型规划存在巨大能效差距，并提出近内存计算架构WMPA以逼近理论能效。
papers.core_method: 从信息论与布尔电路复杂度推导潜状态转移的算术操作与CMOS动态能量下界；对DreamerV3式RSSM进行rollout性能剖析与瞬态3D热仿真定位瓶颈；据此设计WMPA架构，集成近内存计算、实时熵估计、可变精度rollout单元和写时复制潜变量暂存区。
innovation_points: 首次从信息论与布尔电路复杂度给出潜状态转移的算术操作与CMOS动态能量理论下界，并量化真实硬件与下界的差距
通过性能剖析揭示RSSM rollout操作全部受内存带宽约束，而非算力约束
结合瞬态3D热仿真将能效问题扩展为热约束问题，指出持续规划导致毫米级硅片过热
提出面向嵌入式世界模型规划的专用芯片架构WMPA，融合近内存计算、实时熵估计、可变精度与写时复制暂存机制
experiment_results: 性能剖析显示每个rollout操作均为内存带宽受限，GPU能耗至少为CMOS能量下界的5.9×10^10倍
瞬态3D热仿真显示持续规划使毫米级硅片在理想铜散热器下仍升温至556 K
WMPA以40倍降功耗为设计目标，仿真中同尺寸硅片温度维持在306 K附近；摘要未给出实际流片或实测能效数据

40倍降功耗为设计目标，仿真温度结果依赖热模型假设，实际机器人平台验证尚缺
papers.practical_value: 为热约束机器人上的嵌入式世界模型规划提供硬件-算法协同设计路线，指出内存带宽而非算力是主要瓶颈，近内存计算与可变精度rollout可显著降低功耗与温度，对嵌入式AI芯片设计具有工程指导意义。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作将世界模型规划的能效问题从算法层延伸到信息论下界与芯片热约束层，揭示了GPU与理论极限间的巨大差距，并给出可落地的架构方向，对嵌入式机器人AI的硬件协同设计具有参考价值。

papers.title: AI and Analytics: Action Execution for Physical AI in Healthcare Contexts
papers.abstract: Physical artificial intelligence (AI) in healthcare comprises embodied intelligent systems—robotic platforms, autonomous medical devices, cyber-physical clinical infrastructure, and adaptive therapeutic systems—that perceive, reason, and act within physical care environments. While AI perception and predictive analytics are well studied, the action execution layer remains comparatively under-theorized despite being the point at which computational decisions translate into real-world clinical intervention. This chapter examines the technical foundations of AI and analytics for action execution in Physical AI healthcare systems, with emphasis on computational architectures, control-theoretic frameworks, adaptive policy optimization, assurance engineering, and socio-technical integration. Particular attention is given to the requirements of safety-critical clinical deployment, including real-time control, uncertainty quantification, verification and validation, and regulatory-grade assurance. The chapter provides a technically grounded synthesis suitable for advanced academic and professional audiences and outlines future research trajectories for trustworthy, adaptive Physical AI in healthcare.
categories: Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare and Education
Technology and Human Factors in Education and Health
papers.summary: 本章聚焦医疗物理AI（具身智能系统，如机器人平台、自主医疗设备、信息物理临床基础设施与自适应治疗系统）中相对被忽视的“动作执行层”，即计算决策转化为真实临床干预的关键环节。作者从计算架构、控制理论框架、自适应策略优化、保障工程与社会技术集成五个维度梳理技术基础，并针对安全关键临床部署提出实时控制、不确定性量化、验证与确认、监管级保障等要求。全文为技术性综述与综合，面向高级学术与专业读者，并展望可信、自适应医疗物理AI的未来研究方向；材料未给出具体实验或量化结果。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 医疗物理AI的瓶颈不在感知与预测，而在如何以可验证、可监管的方式把决策安全地执行到真实临床环境中。
papers.core_method: 以技术综述与综合为主：围绕动作执行层构建计算架构、控制理论、自适应策略优化、保障工程与社会技术集成五方面的分析框架，并将安全关键部署要求（实时控制、不确定性量化、验证与确认、监管级保障）贯穿其中。
innovation_points: 将研究视角从成熟的AI感知与预测分析转向被理论化不足的动作执行层，明确其为计算决策落地临床干预的关键节点
把控制理论、策略优化与保障工程整合进医疗物理AI的统一技术框架，而非孤立讨论单一模块
将监管级保障、验证与确认、不确定性量化作为一等技术需求纳入系统设计讨论
强调社会技术集成，把临床部署视为技术—组织—监管耦合的系统工程
experiment_results: 本文为综述性章节，材料未提供任何实验数据或量化评估结果
未报告具体系统实现、基准测试或临床验证指标

未给出具体系统架构细节或工程实现方案
对监管路径与落地成本仅作方向性讨论，缺少可操作细则
papers.practical_value: 为医疗机器人、自主医疗设备与自适应治疗系统的研发者提供动作执行层的技术需求清单与设计约束，帮助工程团队在早期即纳入实时性、不确定性量化与验证确认要求，降低安全关键场景的部署与合规风险。
papers.why_it_matters: 当前医疗AI研究高度集中于感知与预测，而真正影响临床安全的是执行环节。该章补足了这一理论缺口，并为可信物理AI的监管级工程实践提供框架性参考。

papers.title: Clarify Before Executing: A Self-Evolving Agent for Resolving Intent Asymmetry in 3D Tool Orchestration
papers.abstract: A fundamental intent asymmetry plagues modern 3D asset creation: while state-of-the-art 3D toolchains demand precise, executable parameters, ordinary users typically provide vague, underspecified instructions. Current 3D agents treat this ambiguity as noise, defaulting to blind execution under a single-turn assumption. To address this limitation, we introduce Clare , a clarification-aware and evolutionary 3D agent that treats intent asymmetry not as an execution error, but as an opportunity for strategic dialogue. By decoupling the generation pipeline into four specialized cognitive roles, Clare intercepts and resolves underspecified instructions before invoking computationally expensive 3D tools to seamlessly execute tasks across five diverse domains: text-to-3D generation, single-view reconstruction, multi-view reconstruction, point cloud editing, and post-processing. Crucially, rather than relying on rigid manual rules, Clare self-evolves its clarification policy via simulated multi-turn interactions. By optimizing a Multi-turn Reward, the agent internalizes the delicate balance between interaction efficiency and task completion. To rigorously test this, we construct 3D-Clarify, a comprehensive benchmark comprising 620 interaction scenarios with systematically injected ambiguity, missing information, and mistaken details. Clare achieves state-of-the-art performance, with 60.40% and 43.34% success rates on single-step and multi-step tasks, respectively, more than doubling existing baselines. Both quantitative and qualitative results demonstrate that proactive clarification is the missing key to robust 3D execution. Code is available at https://github.com/xyzhu1225/CLARE.
papers.venue: ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM)
papers.summary: 该论文针对3D资产创建中的意图不对称问题：用户指令模糊、欠指定，而3D工具链要求精确可执行参数。现有3D智能体将歧义视为噪声，在单轮假设下盲目执行。作者提出Clare，一个澄清感知且可进化的3D智能体，将意图不对称视为策略性对话机会。Clare将生成流水线解耦为四个专门认知角色，在调用计算昂贵的3D工具前拦截并解决欠指定指令，覆盖文本到3D生成、单视图重建、多视图重建、点云编辑和后处理五个领域。其澄清策略不依赖手工规则，而是通过模拟多轮交互自我进化，优化多轮奖励以平衡交互效率与任务完成。作者构建3D-Clarify基准，含620个系统注入歧义、缺失信息和错误细节的交互场景。Clare在单步和多步任务上分别达到60.40%和43.34%成功率，超过现有基线两倍以上。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Clare通过主动澄清与自我进化的多轮对话策略，在调用昂贵3D工具前解决用户意图不对称，显著提升3D工具编排成功率。
papers.core_method: 将3D生成流水线解耦为四个专门认知角色，在调用3D工具前拦截并澄清欠指定指令；通过模拟多轮交互自我进化澄清策略，优化多轮奖励以平衡交互效率与任务完成。
innovation_points: 将意图不对称从执行错误重新定义为策略性对话机会，提出澄清感知的3D智能体框架
将生成流水线解耦为四个专门认知角色，实现调用昂贵3D工具前的意图拦截与澄清
不依赖手工规则，通过模拟多轮交互和多轮奖励优化自我进化澄清策略
构建3D-Clarify基准，系统注入歧义、缺失信息和错误细节，覆盖五类3D任务
experiment_results: 在3D-Clarify基准上，单步任务成功率达60.40%，多步任务成功率达43.34%
成功率超过现有基线两倍以上
定量与定性结果均表明主动澄清是稳健3D执行的关键缺失环节
limitations: 摘要未提供交互效率的具体量化指标，多轮奖励的平衡效果缺乏详细数据
基准场景为系统注入歧义，与真实用户模糊指令的分布差异未说明
四个认知角色的解耦设计带来的额外计算开销未报告
papers.practical_value: 为3D内容创作工具链提供可落地的澄清式交互范式，降低用户使用门槛，避免昂贵3D工具在模糊指令下的无效调用，提升端到端任务成功率与资源利用效率。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作揭示了3D智能体在真实用户模糊指令下的核心瓶颈，提出主动澄清与自我进化策略，并给出可复现基准，对3D工具编排与多轮交互智能体研究具有参考价值。

papers.title: Knowing Me-NIO's NOMI and the Authenticity of a Self-Developed Brand Mind
affiliations: WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management
papers.abstract: In April 2025, NIO announced a partnership with Alibaba's Qwen large language model to enhance its in-cabin experience. The move came amid an industry-wide rush to adopt third-party foundation models, but complicated NIO's long-standing story around NOMI, the dashboard robot often described by owners as the car's “soul.” NIO had presented NOMI's intelligence as self-developed and powered by a proprietary “emotion engine,” making technological ownership part of its emotional appeal. This case places Li Tianshu, NIO's vice president of product experience and one of NOMI's creators, at the moment of deciding how the brand should position NOMI's mind for its next generation: lean harder on the self-developed narrative, quietly integrate commodity models, or reframe the story transparently. Built entirely from public sources, the case is designed for postgraduate and executive courses in branding, digital marketing, and AI strategy. It asks students to weigh brand authenticity against the technical and competitive realities of building an anthropomorphised AI agent.
papers.venue: Advances in computational intelligence and robotics book series
categories: Consumer Behavior in Brand Consumption and Identification
papers.summary: 本文是一篇教学案例研究，聚焦蔚来汽车在2025年4月宣布与阿里通义千问大模型合作后，其车载机器人NOMI所面临的品牌真实性问题。NOMI长期被蔚来塑造为“自研”且搭载专有“情感引擎”的智能体，车主甚至将其视为汽车的“灵魂”，技术自主性构成其情感卖点的一部分。然而行业普遍转向采用第三方基座模型，蔚来产品体验副总裁、NOMI创造者之一李天舒需要决定下一代NOMI的定位策略：强化自研叙事、悄然整合通用模型，还是透明地重构品牌故事。案例完全基于公开资料构建，面向品牌管理、数字营销与AI战略的研究生及高管课程，要求学生在品牌真实性与构建拟人化AI智能体的技术与竞争现实之间进行权衡。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 当第三方基座模型成为行业标配，以“自研情感引擎”为情感卖点的NOMI必须在品牌真实性与技术现实之间重新定位。
papers.core_method: 教学案例研究法：基于公开资料构建蔚来NOMI在采用通义千问后的品牌定位决策情境，设置三种战略选项供课堂讨论与权衡分析。
innovation_points: 将大模型技术采纳决策与品牌真实性叙事结合，而非单纯讨论技术选型
以拟人化车载AI智能体NOMI为对象，揭示“自研”标签作为情感卖点的脆弱性
构建三种可比较的品牌定位路径：强化自研、静默整合、透明重构
experiment_results: 本文为教学案例，未开展实证实验，无定量数据；结论基于公开资料的情境构建与课堂讨论设计。
limitations: 完全基于公开来源，缺乏企业内部决策过程与用户感知的一手数据
未对三种定位策略的实际市场效果进行验证或量化评估
papers.practical_value: 为企业管理者在采用第三方基座模型时如何维护品牌叙事一致性提供决策框架，尤其适用于依赖“自研”作为差异化卖点的AI产品团队，帮助其在技术商品化趋势下平衡透明度与品牌情感资产。
papers.why_it_matters: 随着基座模型日益商品化，越来越多企业面临“自研叙事”与“第三方依赖”之间的张力；该案例以NOMI为切口，提供了讨论品牌真实性、拟人化AI智能体定位与技术战略的鲜活素材，对AI产品与品牌管理者具有现实参考意义。

papers.title: BRIDGE: Bridging the Semantic Quantization Gap for Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation retrieves items by autoregressively generating Semantic IDs(SIDs), where an RQ-VAE quantizes each item into a hierarchical SID sequence that the decoder generates level by level. We identify an overlooked bottleneck in this paradigm: the Semantic Quantization Gap(SQG). Quantization derives SIDs from rich continuous signals, including codebook centroids, local neighborhood geometry, and level-wise entropy. However, the decoder receives only discrete identifiers and loses the semantic structure that shaped them. This mismatch manifests in three ways: a grounding gap, where the decoder lacks semantic anchors when target-side information is limited; a neighborhood gap, where token-level supervision discards inter-item similarity and exacerbates exposure bias; and a difficulty gap, where computation is allocated uniformly despite generation difficulty diminishing with depth. To bridge the SQG, we propose BRIDGE. Codebook-grounded latent reasoning injects frozen quantizer centroids as semantic anchors before SID generation. Privileged EMA self-distillation transfers neighborhood-aware knowledge from a teacher to an on-policy student, preserving inter-item geometry while mitigating exposure bias. Effort-aware recurrence allocates more computation to the challenging early levels and progressively reduces it with depth. Across three Amazon benchmarks, BRIDGE improves Recall@10 and NDCG@10 by 10.9% and 9.7% on average over the strongest baseline (up to 12.6% and 10.7%). In a one-week online A/B experiment on a large-scale e-commerce advertising platform with 5% traffic, BRIDGE improves eCPM by 0.65%.
papers.summary: 该论文识别出生成式推荐中一个被忽视的瓶颈——语义量化鸿沟（SQG）：RQ-VAE 将物品的丰富连续信号（码本质心、局部邻域几何、层级熵）压缩为离散 Semantic ID，而自回归解码器只接收离散标识符，丢失了塑造这些标识符的语义结构。该鸿沟表现为 grounding gap（解码器缺乏语义锚点）、neighborhood gap（token 级监督丢弃物品间相似性并加剧曝光偏差）和 difficulty gap（计算均匀分配，但生成难度随层级加深而下降）。作者提出 BRIDGE，通过码本锚定的隐式推理、特权 EMA 自蒸馏和难度感知递归三条路径分别弥合三类鸿沟。在三个 Amazon 基准上，Recall@10 与 NDCG@10 平均提升 10.9% 和 9.7%（最高 12.6% 和 10.7%）；在某大型电商广告平台 5% 流量的为期一周在线 A/B 实验中，eCPM 提升 0.65%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: BRIDGE 通过把量化器语义结构重新注入解码器，弥合 Semantic ID 生成中的语义量化鸿沟，并在离线基准与在线广告 A/B 中同时取得提升。
papers.core_method: 论文将 SQG 分解为 grounding、neighborhood、difficulty 三类鸿沟并分别设计组件：码本锚定的隐式推理在 SID 生成前注入冻结量化器质心作为语义锚点；特权 EMA 自蒸馏将教师模型的邻域感知知识迁移到 on-policy 学生模型，以保留物品间几何并缓解曝光偏差；难度感知递归为难度较高的早期层级分配更多计算，并随深度递减。
innovation_points: 首次形式化提出生成式推荐中的语义量化鸿沟（SQG），并拆解为 grounding gap、neighborhood gap 与 difficulty gap 三类可诊断的失配
用冻结量化器质心作为解码前的语义锚点，使解码器重新获得量化阶段丢失的连续语义结构
采用特权 EMA 自蒸馏在 on-policy 学生上保留物品间邻域几何，同时缓解自回归生成的曝光偏差
难度感知递归按层级难度非均匀分配计算，匹配生成难度随深度递减的特性
experiment_results: 三个 Amazon 基准上，Recall@10 与 NDCG@10 相对最强基线平均提升 10.9% 和 9.7%，最高提升 12.6% 和 10.7%
某大型电商广告平台 5% 流量、为期一周的在线 A/B 实验中 eCPM 提升 0.65%
摘要未给出各消融组件的单独增益、训练成本或推理延迟数据
limitations: 在线收益幅度较小（eCPM +0.65%），且仅报告单一平台、5% 流量、一周的实验，外推性有限
方法依赖 RQ-VAE 量化器质心与教师模型，引入额外的蒸馏与递归计算开销，摘要未披露效率数据
SQG 的三类鸿沟划分及对应组件在摘要中缺少逐项消融证据，各组件贡献尚不明确
papers.practical_value: 面向以 Semantic ID 自回归生成做召回的工业推荐系统，BRIDGE 提供了一套可直接叠加在现有 RQ-VAE + 解码器管线上的改进：无需重训量化器即可注入语义锚点，自蒸馏缓解曝光偏差，难度感知计算分配可降低深层冗余计算。在线广告 A/B 的 eCPM 正向收益表明其具备线上落地可行性。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作把生成式推荐的一个隐性工程问题——量化与生成之间的信息断层——显式化并给出可组合的解法，同时提供了离线基准与真实广告系统在线 A/B 的双重验证，对研究 Semantic ID 生成范式的瓶颈与工业落地均有参考价值。

papers.title: Generative Search and Recommendation at Shopify
papers.abstract: Search and recommendation at Shopify require retrieving relevant products from a changing catalog of billions of products under strict latency constraints. We present SID-LLM, which casts both tasks as generating semantic IDs: short sequences of content-derived tokens representing products. We jointly pre-train SID-LLM on catalog and behavioral data, giving search and recommendation a shared representation and training objective. We show that reinforcement learning further improves judged search relevance. Furthermore, distillation from task-specific experts improves recommendation quality over joint supervised fine-tuning without a statistically detected loss in search quality. Finally, for efficient serving, we pair multi-token prediction with a lightweight ranker, improving retrieval quality over our autoregressive baseline while reducing latency. We evaluate SID-LLM both as a standalone retriever and as a component of Shopify's production search and recommendation systems. As a standalone search system, SID-LLM achieves quality comparable to Shopify's existing multi-model search stack while meeting production latency requirements. Integrating SID-LLM into the search and recommendation stacks provides significant gains in both offline evaluations and online A/B tests. Together, these results demonstrate the practical value of semantic-ID generation as a unified approach to product discovery at scale.
papers.summary: Shopify 面临在数十亿级动态商品目录和严格延迟约束下同时完成搜索与推荐的挑战。本文提出 SID-LLM，将两个任务统一建模为生成语义 ID（由内容派生 token 组成的短序列），并在商品目录与行为数据上联合预训练，使搜索与推荐共享表示和训练目标。方法上进一步用强化学习提升搜索相关性，用任务专家蒸馏改善推荐质量且不损失搜索质量，并采用多 token 预测加轻量级排序器降低服务延迟。评估覆盖独立检索器与生产系统集成两种形态：独立搜索质量与现有多模型搜索栈相当并满足生产延迟，集成后离线评估与线上 A/B 测试均有显著提升。
papers.one_line_takeaway: SID-LLM 用统一的语义 ID 生成框架在 Shopify 生产规模上同时服务搜索与推荐，并在线上 A/B 中取得显著收益。
papers.core_method: 将商品表示为内容派生的短 token 序列（语义 ID），在商品目录与用户行为数据上联合预训练一个生成式模型，使搜索与推荐共享表示与训练目标；搜索侧用强化学习优化相关性判断，推荐侧从任务特定专家模型蒸馏；服务侧结合多 token 预测与轻量级排序器提升检索质量并降低延迟。
innovation_points: 把搜索与推荐统一为语义 ID 生成任务，共享预训练表示与目标，而非分别建模
在生成式检索框架内引入强化学习提升搜索相关性，并用任务专家蒸馏提升推荐质量且不牺牲搜索
多 token 预测配合轻量级排序器，在降低延迟的同时优于自回归基线
experiment_results: 作为独立搜索系统，质量与 Shopify 现有多模型搜索栈相当，并满足生产延迟要求
集成到搜索与推荐栈后，离线评估和线上 A/B 测试均取得显著提升
蒸馏相比联合监督微调提升推荐质量，且未检测到搜索质量损失
limitations: 摘要未披露具体延迟数值、A/B 提升幅度与统计细节
语义 ID 依赖内容派生 token，商品目录快速变化下的表示维护成本未讨论
强化学习与蒸馏的额外训练开销及线上稳定性未给出数据
papers.practical_value: 为大规模电商平台提供了一条可落地的统一检索路线：用语义 ID 生成替代多模型搜索栈，在满足生产延迟的同时获得线上收益，并展示了强化学习、蒸馏与多 token 预测在真实业务系统中的工程组合方式。
papers.why_it_matters: 它给出了生成式推荐/检索从离线指标走向生产 A/B 的完整证据链，说明语义 ID 统一建模在数十亿商品规模下可行，对关注生成式推荐工程落地的研究者与工业界团队具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: La-JEPA: Compact Robot Policies with Latent World Modeling
papers.abstract: World-action models adapt pretrained video generators, and vision-language-action models build on pretrained vision-language backbones; both tie policy architecture and inference cost to large transformers designed for generation rather than control. It remains unclear how much these generation-oriented choices affect control. In this work, we introduce Latent Action JEPA (La-JEPA), a compact world-action model whose policy transformer is trained from scratch in the feature space of a pretrained V-JEPA 2.1 encoder. Following Fast-WAM, La-JEPA learns to predict future features jointly with actions during training and generates only actions at inference. Among policies without embodied pretraining, La-JEPA achieves state-of-the-art performance in clean and randomized RoboTwin 2.0 scenes and on LIBERO-Plus with correct instructions, while using far fewer parameters than the strongest competing policies. It runs substantially faster than Fast-WAM at comparable performance and outperforms the closest JEPA-based methods, LeapBot-WA and JEPA-WAM, on LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin 2.0 without their pretrained policy backbones. On four real-robot tasks, its average success is comparable to pi0.5 and above non-embodied-pretrained baselines. Through a design study of the choices behind La-JEPA, we show that JEPA features outperform video VAE latents, most clearly out of distribution, and that training-time future prediction choices significantly impact the policy even when future prediction is skipped at inference. We correct the LIBERO-Plus instructions, as the officially released evaluator corrupts them for most variants, and re-evaluate several strong open baselines. Without a generative pretrained policy backbone, La-JEPA is better and faster than far larger policies, suggesting that robot foundation models may benefit from architectures designed for control rather than inherited from generation.
papers.summary: La-JEPA面向机器人策略架构过度依赖生成式大模型的问题，提出紧凑世界-动作模型：策略Transformer从零训练于预训练V-JEPA 2.1编码器特征空间，训练时联合预测未来特征与动作，推理时仅生成动作。在无具身预训练策略中，于RoboTwin 2.0干净与随机场景及LIBERO-Plus正确指令下达SOTA，参数量远少于最强竞品；性能相近时推理显著快于Fast-WAM，并超越LeapBot-WA与JEPA-WAM。四个真机任务平均成功率与pi0.5相当，高于无具身预训练基线。设计研究表明JEPA特征优于视频VAE潜变量，尤其分布外；训练期未来预测选择显著影响策略，即使推理跳过。作者还修正LIBERO-Plus指令并重评多个开源基线。
papers.one_line_takeaway: La-JEPA表明：不依赖生成式预训练策略骨干，仅以JEPA特征空间从零训练紧凑策略，即可在仿真与真机上更小、更快地超越大模型策略。
papers.core_method: 以预训练V-JEPA 2.1编码器特征空间为策略Transformer输入，从零训练紧凑世界-动作模型；沿用Fast-WAM思路，训练时联合预测未来特征与动作，推理时仅输出动作，不生成未来帧。
innovation_points: 策略Transformer从零训练于JEPA特征空间，摆脱生成式大模型骨干对架构与推理成本的绑定
训练期联合未来特征预测、推理期仅生成动作，兼顾世界建模与低推理开销
系统设计研究比较JEPA特征与视频VAE潜变量，并分析训练期未来预测选择对策略的影响
修正LIBERO-Plus官方评估器指令损坏问题并重评多个强开源基线
experiment_results: 无具身预训练策略中，RoboTwin 2.0干净与随机场景及LIBERO-Plus正确指令下达SOTA，参数量远少于最强竞品
性能相近时推理显著快于Fast-WAM；在LIBERO-Plus与RoboTwin 2.0上超越LeapBot-WA和JEPA-WAM，且无需其预训练策略骨干
四个真机任务平均成功率与pi0.5相当，高于无具身预训练基线；JEPA特征优于视频VAE潜变量，分布外更明显
limitations: 依赖预训练V-JEPA 2.1编码器，未验证完全从零视觉表征下的表现
真机仅四个任务，平均成功率与pi0.5相当而非超越，泛化边界未充分展开
未与具身预训练策略在同等参数量下做系统对比，架构优势的归因仍需更细消融
papers.practical_value: 为机器人策略提供更小、更快、无需生成式预训练骨干的替代路线，降低部署算力与推理延迟；JEPA特征空间训练对分布外场景更鲁棒，利于真实产线随机扰动下的稳定控制。
papers.why_it_matters: 它挑战“机器人基础模型必须继承生成式大模型”的默认假设，用受控设计研究说明面向控制的紧凑架构可在更小参数与更快推理下达到或超越大模型策略，为具身智能架构选型提供实证依据。

papers.title: Meituan-Robotics-0: A Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Desktop Manipulation
papers.abstract: We present Meituan-Robotics-0 (MR0), a vision-language-action foundation model and embodied-agent system for stationary-base desktop manipulation. MR0 combines 147 million vision-language samples with 15,060 hours of curated robot trajectories spanning 12 embodiments. A three-stage training recipe aligns multimodal representations with robot behavior through discrete action-token pre-training, transfers these priors to continuous cross-embodiment control through flow-matching mid-training, and adapts the policy through real-world post-training. We introduce Rollback, which pairs replaced policy segments with human corrections to provide positive and negative supervision for CFG-DAgger without value learning or advantage labeling. A unified end-effector interface supports heterogeneous embodiments, while asynchronous action-chunk merging maintains smooth execution under variable inference latency. An event-driven agent maintains persistent task events and reassesses plans when progress or feasibility changes, enabling cross-task retrieval and conditional task resumption. MR0 achieves 93.6% success on RoboTwin 2.0 and ranks fifth in the RoboDojo VLA track. Under matched HG-DAgger post-training, MR0 achieves higher average success rate and progress score than $π_{0.5}$ across three real-robot tasks. On Ethernet insertion, CFG-DAgger trained with Rollback data reaches 70% success and a progress score of 0.90. Qualitative agent deployments demonstrate cross-task event retrieval and recovery from temporarily unsatisfied task conditions.
papers.summary: 美团机器人团队提出MR0，一个面向固定底座桌面操作任务的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基础模型与具身智能体系统。研究问题在于如何将大规模视觉语言预训练知识有效迁移到跨异构机器人的连续控制，并在真实部署中保持稳定执行与任务级恢复能力。技术路线采用三阶段训练：先用1.47亿视觉语言样本与15060小时、覆盖12种本体的机器人轨迹做离散动作token预训练，对齐多模态表征与机器人行为；再用流匹配中训练将先验迁移到连续跨本体控制；最后通过真实世界后训练适配策略。系统层面引入Rollback数据机制，将替换的策略片段与人工纠正配对，为CFG-DAgger提供正负监督而无需价值学习或优势标注；统一末端执行器接口支持异构本体，异步动作块合并保证变推理延迟下的平滑执行；事件驱动智能体维护持久任务事件并在进度或可行性变化时重新规划。结果显示RoboTwin 2.0成功率93.6%，RoboDojo VLA赛道排名第五；在匹配HG-DAgger后训练下，三个真实机器人任务的平均成功率和进度分均高于π0.5；以太网插入任务中，使用Rollback数据的CFG-DAgger达到70%成功率和0.90进度分。
papers.one_line_takeaway: MR0以离散动作token预训练、流匹配跨本体中训练和Rollback增强的真实后训练三阶段路线，将VLA基础模型落地到桌面操作并兼顾工程部署稳定性。
papers.core_method: 三阶段训练配方：大规模视觉语言与多本体机器人轨迹的离散动作token预训练；流匹配中训练实现连续跨本体控制迁移；真实世界后训练适配策略。配套Rollback数据机制为CFG-DAgger提供正负监督，统一末端执行器接口与异步动作块合并支撑异构本体和变延迟执行，事件驱动智能体实现跨任务检索与条件任务恢复。
innovation_points: 提出离散动作token预训练到流匹配连续控制的三阶段VLA训练配方，衔接视觉语言先验与跨本体机器人行为
Rollback机制将替换策略片段与人工纠正配对，为CFG-DAgger构造正负监督，避免价值学习和优势标注
统一末端执行器接口与异步动作块合并，解决异构本体接入和变推理延迟下的平滑执行问题
事件驱动智能体维护持久任务事件，支持跨任务检索与条件满足后的任务恢复
experiment_results: RoboTwin 2.0仿真成功率93.6%，RoboDojo VLA赛道排名第五
匹配HG-DAgger后训练下，三个真实机器人任务的平均成功率和进度分均高于π0.5
以太网插入任务中，使用Rollback数据的CFG-DAgger达到70%成功率和0.90进度分
limitations: 摘要未给出与π0.5对比的具体数值差距和任务级明细，真实机器人评测规模有限
方法面向固定底座桌面操作，未验证移动底盘或更复杂动态环境下的泛化性
事件驱动智能体的跨任务检索与恢复仅提供定性部署展示，缺乏系统性量化评估
papers.practical_value: MR0面向企业真实桌面操作场景，提供从大规模预训练到真实后训练的完整工程路径。Rollback机制降低人工纠正数据的标注成本，统一末端执行器接口和异步动作块合并直接回应异构机器人与推理延迟波动的部署约束，事件驱动智能体支持长程任务中断恢复，对产线桌面装配、插入类精细操作等场景具有线上落地参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作展示了VLA基础模型从仿真基准走向真实机器人后训练与智能体部署的完整链路，其Rollback监督构造和跨本体工程接口设计对生成式推荐之外的具身智能落地具有方法借鉴意义，也提供了美团在机器人基础模型方向的技术布局信号。

papers.title: Bridging VLMs and Embodied Intelligence with Deliberate Practice Policy Optimization
papers.abstract: Developing a versatile embodied brain is fundamentally challenged by severe task heterogeneity, where discrete reasoning and continuous numerical perception tasks coexist with radically different data densities, creating imbalanced training distributions that resist straightforward scaling solutions. Conventional post-training pipelines that apply SFT sequentially before RL are not architected for this regime: their uniform treatment of task distributions suppresses underrepresented capabilities and exacerbates catastrophic forgetting in data-sparse tasks. In response, we introduce Deliberate Practice Policy Optimization (DPPO), an iterative post-training framework tailored for the heterogeneous, data-sparse embodied setting. Rather than applying SFT and RL in sequence, DPPO repurposes RL rollouts as a difficulty-aware triage mechanism: rollouts that expose unresolved weaknesses route the corresponding samples to SFT for targeted knowledge injection, while already-mastered data is filtered out to avoid redundant supervision. Each SFT round in turn consolidates a stronger baseline for the next RL round to probe, forming a self-reinforcing cycle that compounds gains across iterations, mitigates catastrophic forgetting, and maximizes utility from finite embodied data. Conceptually, DPPO is grounded in the complementary roles of SFT and RL: SFT consolidates knowledge from positive expert exemplars, while RL expands capability boundaries through comparative rollout trajectories, and their iterative interplay converts diagnosed weaknesses into structured supervision signals for continual policy reinforcement. Empirically, our DPPO-trained model, Pelican-VL 72B, yields a 20.3% performance improvement over its base model, outperforms open-source models at the 100B scale by 10.6%, and remains competitive with substantially larger proprietary models, providing a self-improving framework for the community.
papers.venue: ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM)
papers.summary: 该论文针对具身智能训练中任务异质性强、数据密度差异大、训练分布不均衡的问题，提出 Deliberate Practice Policy Optimization（DPPO）迭代式后训练框架。DPPO 不再按顺序先做 SFT 再做 RL，而是把 RL rollout 作为难度感知的分诊机制：对暴露未解决弱点的样本路由到 SFT 进行定向知识注入，对已掌握数据则过滤以避免冗余监督；每轮 SFT 又为下一轮 RL 提供更强基线，形成自我强化循环，从而缓解灾难性遗忘并提升有限具身数据的利用率。基于该框架训练的 Pelican-VL 72B 相比基座模型提升 20.3%，在 100B 规模开源模型中领先 10.6%，并与更大规模闭源模型保持竞争力。
papers.one_line_takeaway: DPPO 用 RL rollout 诊断弱点并驱动定向 SFT，把 SFT 与 RL 从串行流水线改造成迭代互补循环，在数据稀疏的具身任务上显著提升 72B 模型表现。
papers.core_method: DPPO 是一种面向异质、数据稀疏具身场景的迭代后训练框架。它利用 RL rollout 作为难度感知分诊器：rollout 中暴露未解决弱点的样本被送入 SFT 做定向知识注入，已掌握样本被过滤掉；每轮 SFT 巩固更强基线供下一轮 RL 探测，形成 SFT 与 RL 交替迭代、自我强化的训练循环。
innovation_points: 将 RL rollout 重新用作难度感知分诊机制，而非仅作为策略优化信号，实现样本级定向监督。
打破传统 SFT→RL 串行后训练流水线，构建 SFT 与 RL 迭代互补、自我强化的训练循环。
针对具身任务异质性与数据稀疏性设计，通过过滤已掌握数据缓解灾难性遗忘并提升有限数据利用率。
在 72B 规模模型上验证框架可扩展性，产出 Pelican-VL 72B 具身大脑模型。
experiment_results: Pelican-VL 72B 相比其基座模型性能提升 20.3%。
在 100B 规模开源模型中领先 10.6%。
与更大规模闭源模型保持竞争力；摘要未给出具体基准名称与逐项分数。
limitations: 摘要未披露具体评测基准、任务集合与统计显著性，结果可复现性信息有限。
DPPO 依赖多轮 RL rollout 与 SFT 迭代，训练计算开销与工程复杂度可能较高。
方法面向具身异质数据场景，向其他模态或通用 LLM 后训练的迁移性尚未验证。
papers.practical_value: DPPO 为具身智能模型后训练提供可落地的迭代式流程：用 rollout 诊断弱点并定向补数据，能在有限具身数据下减少冗余监督和灾难性遗忘，适合企业构建持续自我改进的具身大脑训练管线，并已在 72B 规模模型上展示相对基座与同级开源模型的线上可用增益。
papers.why_it_matters: 它重新定义了 SFT 与 RL 在后训练中的关系：RL 不只是优化策略，还可作为数据分诊与课程信号来源，为数据稀疏、任务异质的具身智能训练提供可扩展的自我改进范式，对基座模型后训练系统设计有直接参考价值。

papers.title: MMaDA-VLA: Large Diffusion Vision-Language-Action Model with Unified Multi-Modal Instruction and Generation
affiliations: East China University of Science and Technology
The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map visual observations and natural-language instructions to robot actions; however, hierarchical and autoregressive paradigms often incur architectural overhead, accumulate long-horizon errors, and require auxiliary modules to capture environment dynamics. To this end, we present MMaDA-VLA, a fully native, pretrained discrete diffusion VLA that unifies multi-modal understanding and generation. Specifically, MMaDA-VLA uses a shared discrete token space to jointly denoise a future goal observation and an action chunk, grounding actions in predicted visual outcomes without an auxiliary world model. In this way, parallel, order-free refinement improves long-horizon consistency. Extensive experiments and comprehensive analyses demonstrate that MMaDA-VLA achieves an average success rate of 98.0% on LIBERO and an average successful sequence length of 4.78 on CALVIN, while performing strongly in real-world settings. The project page is available at https://yliu-cs.github.io/MMaDA-VLA.

papers.title: SSL-R1: Self-Supervised Visual Reinforcement Post-Training for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has demonstrated the great potential of enhancing the reasoning abilities in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, the reliance on language-centric priors and expensive manual annotations prevents MLLMs' intrinsic visual understanding and scalable reward designs. In this work, we introduce SSL-R1, a generic self-supervised RL framework that derives verifiable rewards directly from images. To this end, we revisit self-supervised learning (SSL) in visual domains and reformulate widely-used SSL tasks into a set of verifiable visual puzzles for RL post-training, requiring neither human nor external model supervision. Training MLLMs on these tasks substantially improves their performance on multimodal understanding and reasoning benchmarks, highlighting the potential of leveraging vision-centric self-supervised tasks for MLLM post-training. We think this work will provide useful experience in devising effective self-supervised verifiable rewards to enable RL at scale. Project page: https://github.com/Jiahao000/SSL-R1.
papers.venue: ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM)
papers.summary: 该论文针对多模态大模型强化学习后训练过度依赖语言中心先验与昂贵人工标注、难以激发内在视觉理解的问题，提出SSL-R1通用自监督强化学习框架。其核心是将视觉领域经典自监督学习任务重新表述为一组可验证的视觉谜题，直接从图像本身构造可验证奖励，无需人工标注或外部模型监督，并以此对MLLM进行RL后训练。作者称在这些任务上训练能显著提升多模态理解与推理基准表现，强调以视觉为中心的自监督任务用于MLLM后训练具有潜力，并为设计可扩展的自监督可验证奖励提供经验。

papers.title: SLA: Scaling Spatial-Language-Action Model via Continual Pre-training
affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
papers.abstract: Reliable robotic manipulation requires both semantic understanding and precise control in three-dimensional space. However, vision-language-action (VLA) foundations largely inherit visual representations from 2D vision-language pre-training, while spatial supervision is often introduced only during task-specific adaptation. Developing spatial understanding as a transferable foundation-model capability therefore calls for learning from broader robot experience. We present SLA, a Spatial-Language-Action Model that scales implicit spatial alignment to continual pre-training and maintains it during downstream post-training. Initialized from a pretrained pi05 policy, SLA jointly optimizes action prediction and alignment between intermediate visual embeddings and spatial representations from a frozen 3D perception model. We curate and unify heterogeneous robot datasets to support spatial learning across diverse embodiments, tasks, and scenes. To accommodate this diversity, we introduce feature-dependent gates that adaptively aggregate visual embeddings from multiple VLA layers for spatial supervision. The teacher further exploits partially available depth and camera calibration alongside RGB observations, enabling effective use of heterogeneous geometric annotations. Probabilistic state dropout encourages reliance on visual cues and mitigates overfitting to demonstration trajectories. All auxiliary components are used only during training, allowing direct reuse of pretrained VLA weights and preserving the original inference architecture.
papers.summary: SLA针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基础模型空间理解能力不足的问题——现有VLA多继承2D视觉-语言预训练的视觉表征，空间监督往往只在任务适配阶段引入——提出将隐式空间对齐扩展到持续预训练，并在下游后训练中保持。方法以预训练pi05策略为初始化，联合优化动作预测与中间视觉嵌入对冻结3D感知模型空间表征的对齐；统一异构机器人数据集以覆盖多本体、多任务、多场景；引入特征相关门控自适应聚合多层VLA视觉嵌入用于空间监督；教师模型利用部分可得的深度与相机标定辅助RGB观测；概率状态丢弃促使模型依赖视觉线索。所有辅助组件仅在训练时使用，推理架构与预训练权重可直接复用。
papers.one_line_takeaway: SLA把空间对齐从任务适配阶段前移到持续预训练，在不改变推理架构的前提下为VLA注入可迁移的3D空间理解能力。
papers.core_method: 以预训练pi05策略为初始化，在统一异构机器人数据上进行持续预训练，联合优化动作预测损失与中间视觉嵌入对冻结3D感知模型空间表征的对齐损失；用特征相关门控自适应聚合多个VLA层的视觉嵌入作为空间监督对象；教师侧利用部分可得的深度与相机标定增强RGB观测；训练时施加概率状态丢弃；全部辅助模块仅用于训练，推理时保持原始VLA结构。
innovation_points: 将隐式空间对齐从任务特定适配扩展到持续预训练，并在下游后训练中维持，把空间理解作为可迁移的基础模型能力来构建
特征相关门控自适应聚合多层VLA视觉嵌入用于空间监督，适配异构数据与多层级表征差异

experiment_results: 摘要与元数据未给出具体量化结果；仅说明方法在统一异构机器人数据集上完成持续预训练并保持下游后训练，未报告成功率、泛化或消融数值
limitations: 依赖冻结3D感知模型作为空间监督教师，其几何表征质量与覆盖范围构成能力上限
需要统一异构机器人数据集并处理部分可得的深度与标定标注，数据整理与对齐成本较高
给定材料未提供量化实验证据，空间对齐在下游任务上的实际增益幅度尚不明确
papers.practical_value: 面向真实机器人操作场景，SLA在训练阶段引入空间监督而不改动推理架构，可直接复用预训练VLA权重，便于在现有pi05类策略上增量升级；对深度与相机标定仅部分可得的工程条件做了适配，降低了对完整几何标注的依赖，有利于在多本体、多场景的产线数据上做持续预训练。
papers.why_it_matters: 它指出VLA空间能力不足的根源在于预训练阶段缺乏3D监督，并给出不增加推理开销的持续预训练方案，为空间理解作为基础模型能力而非任务适配技巧提供了可复用的技术路线。

papers.title: VICTR: Value-Informed In-Context Learning for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Recent advances in robot foundation models have highlighted the potential of in-context learning (ICL) for adapting robot behavior from demonstrations without further fine-tuning. Previous work has used retrieval-based post-training to equip pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models with the capability for ICL by teaching them to condition action predictions on retrieved visually-relevant demonstration chunks. However, the effectiveness of retrieval hinges on selecting context relevant to the current execution stage, which visual similarity alone may not capture. We introduce VICTR, a framework enabling in-context learning in VLAs via progress-informed context retrieval built around an In-Context Value Function Estimator (IC-VFE). IC-VFE conditions on a reference demonstration video, a language instruction and the current observation to estimate task-relative progress. By conditioning progress estimation on a reference demonstration, IC-VFE can align the current state with a demonstrated execution even for tasks unseen during training. VICTR uses the estimated progress to select demonstration chunks at corresponding stages of execution and supplies them to a $π_{0.5}$ policy post-trained for in-context action generation. On unseen out-of-domain real-world manipulation tasks, VICTR raises the success rate from 6.2% for a fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ baseline to 23.8% and more than doubles the task progress rate, from 28.9% to 55.5%. Project page with code, data and videos: https://ai4ce.github.io/VICTR/
papers.summary: VICTR针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在上下文学习（ICL）中检索演示片段时仅依赖视觉相似性、难以对齐当前执行阶段的问题，提出以任务进度为条件的检索框架。其核心是上下文价值函数估计器（IC-VFE），以参考演示视频、语言指令和当前观测为输入估计任务相对进度，从而在训练中未见任务上也能将当前状态与演示执行阶段对齐。VICTR利用估计进度选取对应阶段的演示片段，并输入经后训练支持上下文动作生成的π0.5策略。在域外真实机器人操作任务上，该方法将成功率从微调π0.5基线的6.2%提升至23.8%，任务进度率从28.9%提升至55.5%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 用参考演示条件下的进度估计替代纯视觉相似度检索，可显著提升VLA模型在未见真实操作任务上的上下文学习效果。
papers.core_method: 构建In-Context Value Function Estimator（IC-VFE），以参考演示视频、语言指令和当前观测为条件估计任务相对进度；据此从演示中检索与当前执行阶段对应的片段，作为上下文输入给经后训练支持上下文动作生成的π0.5策略。
innovation_points: 提出进度感知的上下文检索，弥补仅靠视觉相似性选择演示片段的不足
IC-VFE以参考演示为条件，使进度估计可泛化到训练中未见的任务
将价值/进度估计与VLA的上下文动作生成后训练相结合，形成检索-估计-生成闭环
experiment_results: 在域外真实机器人操作任务上，成功率从微调π0.5基线的6.2%提升至23.8%
任务进度率从28.9%提升至55.5%，提升超过一倍
摘要未报告训练数据规模、消融实验及推理开销等细节
limitations: 依赖参考演示视频，缺少演示或演示质量差时进度估计与检索可能受限
仅在摘要所述域外真实操作任务上报告结果，未给出多任务规模与消融分析
未报告IC-VFE估计与检索带来的推理延迟和工程开销
papers.practical_value: 为机器人基础模型提供无需额外微调即可从演示中适配新任务的路径，进度感知检索有助于在真实操作场景中提升执行阶段对齐与任务完成率，对演示驱动部署具有工程参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 它指出VLA上下文学习的关键瓶颈在上下文选择而非仅策略生成，并给出可泛化到未见任务的进度估计方案，为机器人基础模型的演示适配提供了新思路。

papers.title: OptST: Optimizing Semantic Tokenization for LLM-Enhanced Recommendation
papers.abstract: Semantic information can enrich the identifiers and structured fields used by recommender systems. Semantic tokenization provides a structured representation of this information by converting LLM-derived user profiles into discrete tokens. In the common two-stage pipeline, the tokenizer is trained before the recommender. Its token assignments are then treated as fixed input features during recommendation training. As a result, the downstream recommender can learn how to use the assigned indices, but it cannot revise the semantic partition that produced them. Making this partition task-aware is difficult because nearest-code assignment is discrete, and unconstrained adaptation may also distort the geometry learned during pretraining. Moreover, a fixed token depth exposes the same semantic resolution to every interaction. We thus propose OptST (Optimizing Semantic Tokenization), which makes a pretrained tokenizer responsive to downstream recommendation. To revise token assignments without directly updating the pretrained encoder or base codebooks, OptST learns a low-rank deformation whose drift is limited by an anchor regularizer. Recommendation supervision reaches this transformation through a straight-through estimator, while prediction retains hard nearest-code assignments. Beyond adapting the assignments themselves, OptST selects an interaction-conditioned prefix to control how much residual detail is exposed to the recommender. Experiments on four public datasets show that OptST achieves the highest AUC among conventional and LLM-enhanced baselines. Its improvements also persist across different recommendation backbones. These results establish task-aware semantic tokenization as an effective interface between LLM-derived profiles and downstream recommendation models.
papers.summary: 该论文研究LLM增强推荐中语义分词器的任务适配问题。常见两阶段流程先训练分词器、再训练推荐模型，导致下游推荐无法修正语义划分。OptST提出在冻结预训练编码器与基础码本的前提下，学习低秩形变并加锚点正则约束漂移，通过直通估计器把推荐监督传回该变换，同时保留硬最近码分配；此外引入交互条件前缀，控制暴露给推荐器的残差细节量。在四个公开数据集上，OptST在传统与LLM增强基线中取得最高AUC，且改进在不同推荐骨干上持续存在。
papers.one_line_takeaway: OptST用低秩形变与交互条件前缀让冻结的语义分词器感知推荐任务，在不破坏预训练几何的前提下提升AUC。
papers.core_method: 冻结预训练语义编码器与基础码本，学习一个受锚点正则约束的低秩形变来修正token分配；推荐监督经直通估计器回传至该形变，预测时仍使用硬最近码分配；并选择交互条件前缀控制残差细节的暴露深度。
innovation_points: 将语义分词器从固定输入特征变为可受推荐监督调优的组件，同时避免直接更新预训练编码器与基础码本

通过直通估计器解决最近码分配的离散不可导问题，预测阶段保留硬分配
引入交互条件前缀，使不同交互获得不同语义分辨率，而非固定token深度
experiment_results: 在四个公开数据集上，OptST在传统与LLM增强基线中取得最高AUC
改进在不同推荐骨干上持续存在

papers.practical_value: 为LLM用户画像到推荐模型的接口提供可训练的分词适配层，可在不重训编码器与码本的情况下让语义ID贴合下游任务，并可按交互调节语义分辨率，具备接入现有两阶段推荐流水线的工程可行性。
papers.why_it_matters: 它指出语义分词器固定分配是LLM增强推荐的隐性瓶颈，并给出兼顾离散分配、预训练几何保持与任务监督回传的轻量方案，对语义ID与生成式推荐的分词器设计有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Discovering Diverse Planning Policies for Multimodal Embodied Agents with Quality-Diversity Optimization
affiliations: Nanjing University of Information Science and Technology
papers.abstract: Multimodal embodied agents are increasingly required to solve long-horizon tasks by integrating visual observations, textual goals, and interaction history into closed-loop decision making. However, state-of-the-art large-model-based planners often rely on a single dominant planning style during execution. Once this execution mode becomes ineffective, the agent may remain stalled for many steps, repeatedly interacting with the environment without making meaningful progress. We address this limitation by proposing a Quality-Diversity (QD) framework for discovering diverse planning policies for multimodal embodied agents. The proposed method treats planning-policy templates as evolvable individuals and organizes them into a behavior-indexed archive rather than collapsing search to a single prompt style. In the offline stage, rollout trajectories are summarized into structured success and failure experiences, which guide policy variation through recombination and experience-guided mutation. The resulting policies are mapped into a behavior space defined by interaction intensity and goal-directedness, and the highest-quality policy in each niche is retained in the archive. In the online stage, the agent executes one policy at a time while monitoring task progress. When persistent stall is detected, the system rolls back to the latest checkpoint and switches to a behaviorally distinct archive policy to resume execution. Experiments on the ThreeDWorld transport benchmark show that the proposed framework improves both task success and interaction efficiency over representative baseline planners. These results suggest that discovering diverse policy repertoires is an effective way to support adaptive multimodal planning and online failure recovery. Code is available at https://github.com/EvoNexusX/2026XuQD-Plan.git.
papers.venue: ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM)
papers.summary: 针对多模态具身智能体在长程任务中依赖单一主导规划风格、一旦失效便长时间停滞的问题，本文提出基于质量-多样性（QD）优化的规划策略发现框架。该方法将规划策略模板视为可进化个体，在离线阶段把 rollout 轨迹总结为结构化成功与失败经验，通过重组与经验引导变异生成策略，并映射到由交互强度与目标导向性定义的行为空间，在每个行为小生境中保留最高质量策略形成档案库。在线阶段逐次执行策略并监测任务进度，检测到持续停滞时回滚至最近检查点并切换到行为上不同的档案策略继续执行。在 ThreeDWorld 运输基准上的实验表明，该框架在任务成功率与交互效率上均优于代表性基线规划器，说明发现多样化策略库是支持自适应多模态规划与在线失败恢复的有效途径。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 用质量-多样性优化构建行为索引的规划策略档案库，使多模态具身智能体在单一规划风格失效时能回滚并切换策略，从而提升长程任务成功率与交互效率。
papers.core_method: 将规划策略模板作为可进化个体，离线阶段用 rollout 轨迹总结结构化成功/失败经验，指导策略重组与经验引导变异；以交互强度和目标导向性构建行为空间，按小生境保留最高质量策略形成档案库；在线阶段逐策略执行并监测进度，检测到持续停滞时回滚到最近检查点并切换到行为上不同的档案策略。
innovation_points: 将质量-多样性优化引入多模态具身规划，以行为索引档案库替代单一提示风格的搜索坍缩
利用结构化成功/失败经验引导策略重组与变异，而非仅靠随机变异
定义交互强度与目标导向性二维行为空间，显式维持策略行为多样性
在线停滞检测结合检查点回滚与行为差异策略切换，形成可恢复的闭环执行机制
experiment_results: 在 ThreeDWorld 运输基准上，所提框架在任务成功率与交互效率两项指标上均优于代表性基线规划器
摘要未给出具体数值、消融结果或统计显著性，需查阅原文获取定量数据
limitations: 仅在 ThreeDWorld 运输单一基准上验证，跨任务与跨环境泛化性未知
行为空间维度（交互强度、目标导向性）的定义与离散化方式可能影响档案库覆盖质量
离线经验总结与在线停滞检测依赖阈值设定，摘要未说明其敏感性分析
papers.practical_value: 为基于大模型规划器的具身智能体提供一种可插拔的失败恢复机制：无需重训基座模型，通过维护多样化策略档案库并在停滞时回滚切换，即可提升长程任务执行鲁棒性与交互效率，适合工程部署中应对单一规划风格失效的线上场景。
papers.why_it_matters: 它指出现有大模型规划器在长程具身任务中的关键脆弱点——单一主导规划风格导致长时间停滞，并给出以质量-多样性优化构建策略库的系统性解法，为自适应多模态规划与在线失败恢复提供了可复现的开源框架。

papers.title: MSU Team at the Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge 2026: Grounded Artifact Evidence for Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract: Recent advances in generative image models have made many manipulated images highly realistic, raising the need for detectors that are not only accurate but also able to provide visual evidence for their decisions. In this paper, we present our solution to the Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge [2] on the XPlainVerse dataset [1], where systems are required to predict whether an image is real or fake and generate both complex and simple explanations grounded in visible forensic cues. Our method follows a modular detection-and-explanation design. For the real/fake decision, we build a multi-backbone detector that combines several DINOv3 models with Mesorch manipulation-localization features, bringing together pretrained visual representations, DCT-aware cues, and multi-scale forensic information. To inject explanation evidence into the detector, we use a Grounding-DINO-based pseudo-mask generation pipeline that converts local artifact descriptions from training explanations into weak patch-level supervision for an Artifact Evidence Map. We further introduce a local patch-level contrastive objective that separates artifact and authenticity evidence in the detector feature space without requiring paired images or pixel-level manipulation masks. For language output, we use class-conditional Qwen3-VL models to generate complex explanations for fake and real predictions, followed by a GRPO-optimized text simplification model. The proposed methods were trained and evaluated on the challenge subset of XPlainVerse. On the full test split, our submission achieves 0.9349 detection accuracy, 0.5571 explanation score, and a 0.7456 final challenge score.
papers.venue: ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM)
categories: Generative Adversarial Networks and Image Synthesis
papers.summary: 本文是MSU团队在ACM MM举办的Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge 2026上的参赛方案，任务是在XPlainVerse数据集上同时完成真伪判别与可解释证据生成。方法采用模块化检测与解释分离设计：检测端融合多个DINOv3骨干与Mesorch篡改定位特征，结合预训练视觉表征、DCT感知线索与多尺度取证信息；解释端利用Grounding-DINO将训练解释中的局部伪影描述转为弱块级监督，构建伪影证据图，并引入局部块级对比目标在特征空间分离伪影与真实性证据，无需配对图像或像素级掩码；语言输出用类别条件Qwen3-VL生成复杂解释，再经GRPO优化的文本简化模型产出简单解释。在挑战赛测试集上取得0.9349检测准确率、0.5571解释分数与0.7456最终得分。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 该方案以多骨干取证检测器加弱监督伪影证据图与GRPO文本简化，在统一框架内兼顾深伪检测精度与可解释证据生成。
papers.core_method: 模块化检测-解释架构：检测端为多DINOv3骨干与Mesorch篡改定位特征融合的多尺度取证检测器；解释端先用Grounding-DINO把训练解释中的局部伪影描述转成弱块级伪掩码，监督伪影证据图，并加入局部块级对比损失分离伪影与真实性特征；语言端用类别条件Qwen3-VL生成复杂解释，再由GRPO优化的简化模型输出简单解释。
innovation_points: 将自然语言伪影描述经Grounding-DINO转为弱块级监督，构建伪影证据图，把解释证据注入检测器特征空间
提出局部块级对比目标，在无配对图像与像素级掩码条件下分离伪影证据与真实性证据
融合DINOv3多骨干、Mesorch定位特征与DCT感知线索，形成多尺度取证检测器
采用类别条件Qwen3-VL加GRPO文本简化模型的两级语言生成，兼顾解释复杂度与可读性
experiment_results: 完整测试集检测准确率0.9349
解释分数0.5571
最终挑战赛得分0.7456
limitations: 解释分数0.5571明显低于检测准确率，解释质量仍是主要瓶颈
伪影证据图依赖训练解释经Grounding-DINO生成的弱块级伪掩码，监督信号较粗
仅在XPlainVerse挑战子集上训练评估，跨数据集泛化性未验证
papers.practical_value: 为内容审核与取证场景提供可同时输出真伪判定与可视化伪影证据的检测器，弱监督证据图路线降低了对像素级篡改标注的依赖，语言解释分级生成便于面向不同受众的取证报告落地。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作展示了如何把解释证据反向注入检测器特征空间，而非仅在输出端附加文本解释，为可解释深伪检测提供了检测与解释联合建模的工程化参考，并给出挑战赛完整评测结果。

papers.title: Generate-then-Rank: Learning Symbolic Goal Interpretation for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract: Goal interpretation is to translate a natural language instruction into a formal symbolic goal that a planner can execute. It is critical for embodied agents because any error here propagates to every downstream planning and action step. Doing it well requires both generating suitable candidates and reliably selecting among them. We present a two-stage generate-then-rank approach to Goal Interpretation in the Embodied Agent Interface (EAI). First, supervised fine-tuning adapts a Large Language Model (LLM) to EAI's output convention. Second, Candidate-Output Ranking from Errors (CORE) learns preferences over complete outputs from the model's own generated alternatives. We conducted experiments on the household scenes of the Embodied Agent Interface Benchmark. Multiple open source LLMs including DeepSeek-V3 chat, DeepSeek-Reasoner, and Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen2.5-72B were evaluated. The proposed method outperformed the baseline models including LLMs with simple prompting, chain-of-thought, and knowledge graph based approaches.
papers.summary: 该论文研究具身智能体中的目标解释问题，即把自然语言指令翻译为规划器可执行的符号目标，并指出该环节的错误会传播到后续所有规划与动作步骤。作者在Embodied Agent Interface（EAI）上提出两阶段“先生成后排序”方法：第一阶段用监督微调让大语言模型适配EAI的输出约定；第二阶段提出Candidate-Output Ranking from Errors（CORE），利用模型自身生成的候选输出学习对完整输出的偏好排序。实验在EAI家庭场景基准上进行，评估了DeepSeek-V3 chat、DeepSeek-Reasoner、Qwen2.5-7B和Qwen2.5-72B等开源模型，所提方法优于简单提示、思维链和基于知识图谱的基线。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 用监督微调对齐输出格式、再用CORE从自身错误候选中学习排序，可显著提升具身智能体的符号目标解释质量。
papers.core_method: 两阶段框架：先对LLM进行监督微调以适配EAI的符号目标输出约定；再通过CORE方法，从模型自身生成的多个完整候选输出中学习偏好排序，从而在生成后可靠选择最优符号目标。
innovation_points: 将目标解释拆解为“生成候选+排序选择”两阶段，显式处理生成与选择的双重需求
提出CORE，利用模型自身生成的错误候选构建偏好学习信号，对完整输出进行排序
在EAI基准上系统评估多种开源LLM，并与提示、思维链、知识图谱方法对比
experiment_results: 在EAI家庭场景基准上，所提方法优于简单提示、思维链和知识图谱基线
评估覆盖DeepSeek-V3 chat、DeepSeek-Reasoner、Qwen2.5-7B和Qwen2.5-72B等开源模型
摘要未给出具体数值指标，需查阅全文获取量化结果
limitations: 实验仅限EAI家庭场景，未验证其他具身环境或任务域的泛化性
CORE依赖模型自身生成的候选分布，候选质量可能限制排序上限
摘要未报告具体量化提升幅度与统计显著性
papers.practical_value: 为具身智能体提供可落地的目标解释流水线：先微调对齐输出格式，再用排序模块过滤错误符号目标，降低错误向规划与执行环节的传播风险。
papers.why_it_matters: 目标解释是具身智能体规划链路的入口，错误会逐级放大；该工作把“生成”与“选择”解耦，并利用模型自身错误构造偏好学习，为提升符号目标解释可靠性提供了可复用的两阶段范式。

papers.title: RoboARCade: Benchmarking Agentic Robot Control
papers.abstract: Improvements in multi-modal capabilities have enabled agents to act directly as robot policies, a setting we refer to as agentic robot control (ARC). We introduce RoboARCade, a benchmark of long-horizon manipulation tasks across three embodiments designed to test in-context adaptation, memory, and reasoning for precise control. The tasks build on existing open-source benchmarks, which we make harder by widening the range of initial conditions. RoboARCade is easy to use and extend: all tasks run on a single simulation backend, MuJoCo, each task is a self-contained data pack, and agents connect through interchangeable interfaces, so new tasks, agents, and interfaces can be added independently. The benchmark separates leading agents: GPT-6 Astra achieves 49.8% compared with 43.6% for Claude Fable 5.1, leaving substantial room for improvement. Comparing two interfaces, we find that a richer visual interface adds only 1.5 to 6.8 points at 1.7 to 2.3 times the cost. Failures stem mostly from choosing a poor manipulation strategy or executing a good one imprecisely, rarely from misunderstanding the scene, and agents incorrectly claim success on 24% to 39% of attempted subtasks. Agents can also improve without human input: one successful demonstration in context raises Astra's score from 53.5% to 73.0% on a five-task subset, and a prompt the agent writes and revises itself reaches 72.0%. Code, videos and full traces are available at roboarcade.org.
papers.summary: RoboARCade 提出“智能体机器人控制”（ARC）评测基准，考察多模态大模型直接作为机器人策略时的长程操作能力。基准包含跨三种本体（embodiment）的长程操作任务，在现有开源基准上扩大初始条件范围以提升难度，统一运行于 MuJoCo 单一仿真后端；每个任务为自包含数据包，智能体通过可互换接口接入，任务、智能体与接口可独立扩展。评测聚焦上下文适应、记忆与精确控制推理。结果显示领先智能体间存在差距：GPT-6 Astra 得分 49.8%，Claude Fable 5.1 为 43.6%，仍有较大提升空间。更丰富的视觉接口仅带来 1.5 至 6.8 分提升，成本却增至 1.7 至 2.3 倍。失败主要源于操作策略选择不当或执行不精确，而非场景理解错误；智能体在 24% 至 39% 的尝试子任务上错误宣称成功。上下文加入一次成功演示可使 Astra 在五任务子集上从 53.5% 提升至 73.0%，智能体自行编写并修订的提示词达到 72.0%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: RoboARCade 用统一 MuJoCo 长程操作基准揭示：多模态智能体作为机器人策略的主要瓶颈在策略选择与精确执行，而非场景理解，且存在严重的虚假成功报告。
papers.core_method: 构建跨三种本体的长程操作任务基准，基于开源基准扩大初始条件范围提升难度；所有任务运行于单一 MuJoCo 仿真后端，每个任务为自包含数据包，智能体通过可互换接口连接，支持任务、智能体与接口独立扩展；评测维度覆盖上下文适应、记忆与推理精确控制，并比较不同接口丰富度与上下文演示、自写提示词等改进手段。
innovation_points: 提出“智能体机器人控制”（ARC）评测设定，将多模态智能体直接作为机器人策略进行系统评测
统一仿真后端与自包含数据包、可互换接口的设计，使任务、智能体和接口可独立扩展，便于使用与扩展
通过扩大初始条件范围提升长程操作任务难度，聚焦上下文适应、记忆与精确控制推理
系统比较接口丰富度与成本权衡，并量化智能体虚假成功报告率
experiment_results: GPT-6 Astra 得分 49.8%，Claude Fable 5.1 得分 43.6%，领先智能体间存在明显差距且整体仍有较大提升空间
更丰富的视觉接口仅带来 1.5 至 6.8 分提升，成本为 1.7 至 2.3 倍
上下文加入一次成功演示使 Astra 在五任务子集上从 53.5% 提升至 73.0%，智能体自写并修订的提示词达到 72.0%；智能体在 24% 至 39% 的尝试子任务上错误宣称成功
limitations: 所有任务运行于 MuJoCo 单一仿真后端，未涉及真实机器人平台验证
基准任务基于现有开源基准扩展，任务覆盖范围受原有基准限制
摘要未报告跨本体泛化、记忆机制消融等更细粒度的分析结果
papers.practical_value: 为机器人策略智能体的研发提供可扩展、易用的标准化评测平台，帮助企业识别智能体在长程操作中的真实短板——策略选择与精确执行，而非感知理解；虚假成功报告率提示线上部署需引入成功验证机制；上下文演示与自写提示词的低成本改进路径对工程落地有直接参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 随着多模态智能体直接充当机器人策略，亟需能区分领先系统、暴露真实失败模式的评测基准。RoboARCade 不仅给出排名，还揭示失败主要来自策略与执行而非理解，并量化虚假成功与接口成本权衡，为后续研究与工程部署提供可复现的诊断工具。

papers.title: Self-evolving Embodied AI
affiliations: Beijing National Research Center for Information Science and Technology
papers.abstract: Abstract Embodied Artificial Intelligence (AI) is an intelligent system formed by agents and their environment through active perception, embodied cognition, and action interaction. Existing embodied AI remains confined to human-crafted setting, in which agents are trained on given memories and construct models for given tasks, enabling fixed physical embodiments to interact with relatively static environments. Such methods fail in in-the-wild setting characterized by variable physical embodiments and dynamic open environments. This paper introduces self-evolving embodied AI, a new paradigm in which agents operate based on their changing physical embodiment and environment through five software-level components, namely memory self-updating, task self-switching, environment self-prediction, embodiment self-adaptation, and model self-evolution, together with a hardware-level component for physical embodiment evolution, aiming to achieve continually adaptive intelligence through software-hardware co-evolution. Specifically, we present the definition, framework, components, mechanisms, roadmap, and evaluation indicators of self-evolving embodied AI, systematically review state-of-the-art works for realized components, discuss practical applications, and point out future research directions. We believe that self-evolving embodied AI enables agents to autonomously learn and interact with environments in a human-like manner and provides a new perspective toward general artificial intelligence.
papers.summary: 该论文提出“自演化具身AI”新范式，以解决现有具身AI局限于人工设定、固定物理形态和静态环境的问题。作者从定义、框架、组件、机制、路线图和评价指标等方面系统阐述该范式，提出五个软件层组件（记忆自更新、任务自切换、环境自预测、具身自适配、模型自演化）和一个硬件层组件（物理具身演化），通过软硬件协同演化实现持续自适应智能。论文还系统综述了各组件已实现的代表性工作，讨论实际应用并指出未来研究方向。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 论文提出自演化具身AI范式，通过软硬件协同演化使智能体在变化形态与开放环境中持续自适应。
papers.core_method: 以综述与框架构建为主：定义自演化具身AI，提出包含记忆自更新、任务自切换、环境自预测、具身自适配、模型自演化五个软件层组件及物理具身演化硬件层组件的框架，并给出机制、路线图与评价指标，系统梳理各组件相关研究。
innovation_points: 提出自演化具身AI新范式，突破人工设定、固定形态与静态环境的局限
构建软件层五组件加硬件层物理具身演化的软硬件协同演化框架
给出该范式的定义、机制、路线图与评价指标体系
系统综述各组件已实现工作并指出未来方向
experiment_results: 本文为框架与综述性论文，摘要未报告具体实验数据或量化结果。
limitations: 论文以概念框架和综述为主，未提供自演化具身AI系统的完整实现与实证验证
各组件仅综述已有工作，组件间协同演化机制尚缺乏统一验证
评价指标体系停留在提出层面，缺少实际基准测试结果
papers.practical_value: 为具身智能在真实开放环境与多变物理形态下的持续自适应提供系统化设计参考，指导记忆、任务、环境预测、形态适配与模型演化等模块的工程化组织，并给出评价维度，便于企业规划具身智能系统架构与研发路线。

papers.title: Don't Prompt Your Agents. Equip Them: Skillware as a Modular Standard for Sovereign, Auditable, and Deterministic Capability Execution for Logical Systems
papers.abstract: Current autonomous logical systems rely on a fragile assumption: that language models should dynamically write code, guess API payloads, and memorize operational constraints through prompt engineering. In practice, this burns massive context windows, inflates API bills, and produces brittle agents that fail unpredictably in production. In this work, we present Skillware, an open architectural framework and capability registry that formally separates what an agent wants to do from how that task is executed. Instead of prompting models with loose text instructions or markdown files baptized as 'skills', Skillware equips them with modular, versioned software capability bundles. Much like skill hotkeys in video games that execute deterministically under fixed world rules, each bundle combines a typed JSON input contract, deterministic Python code, task directives, bundled datasets, and automated unit tests. In-process adapters translate these capabilities into native tool declarations for any model, from frontier cloud APIs to local open-weight runtimes with zero network latency. Evaluating 23 frontier and open-weight models across 368 benchmark conditions, we show that small local models (3B to 8B parameters) equipped with Skillware consistently outperform unequipped frontier models on complex multi-step workflows. They cut token usage by up to 84.8%, slash inference costs by up to 97.3%, and eliminate parameter errors entirely. True agent reliability does not come from larger models or longer prompts, but from equipping logical systems with verified, deterministic software. Finally, we articulate the trajectory of capability bundles across an invariant continuum of information processing systems: from digital logical systems today, to IoT, drones, and embodied robotics tomorrow, establishing a foundation for auditable, real-time capability execution.
papers.summary: 论文针对当前自主逻辑系统依赖语言模型动态写代码、猜测API载荷并通过提示工程记忆操作约束的脆弱假设，提出Skillware开放架构框架与能力注册表，将智能体“想做什么”与“如何执行”形式化分离。每个能力包由类型化JSON输入契约、确定性Python代码、任务指令、捆绑数据集和自动单元测试组成，并通过进程内适配器转换为任意模型的原生工具声明，支持前沿云API与本地开源权重运行时且零网络延迟。作者在368个基准条件下评估23个前沿与开源权重模型，声称3B至8B本地小模型配备Skillware后在复杂多步工作流上持续优于未配备的前沿模型，token用量最多降低84.8%，推理成本最多降低97.3%，并完全消除参数错误。论文还讨论了能力包从数字逻辑系统向IoT、无人机和具身机器人扩展的连续谱系。

papers.title: A Meta-Analysis of the Effect of General-Purpose Generative AI Use on Depressive Symptoms in Older Adults
papers.abstract: Depressive symptoms are among the most common mental health problems in later life, and general-purpose generative AI (GenAI) applications — large language models such as ChatGPT and Gemini — are increasingly available to older adults for conversation and emotional support. Existing meta-analyses have mostly pooled these tools with specialized therapy chatbots, voice assistants, or social robots, so the specific effect of general-purpose GenAI remains unclear. This systematic review and meta-analysis will synthesize experimental and quasi-experimental studies examining the effect of text-based or voice-based use of general-purpose GenAI applications on depression or depressive symptoms among adults aged 60 years and older. APA PsycINFO, Web of Science, PubMed, Scopus, ACM Digital Library, and Google Scholar will be searched. Effect sizes (Hedges' g) will be pooled using a random-effects model, with subgroup analysis by mode of use (voice/text) and meta-regression where enough studies are available. Risk of bias will be assessed with RoB 2, ROBINS-I, and the NIH Pre-Post Tool, and the certainty of evidence with GRADE. The review will follow the PRISMA 2020 guidelines.
papers.summary: 该预印本提出一项系统综述与元分析的研究方案，旨在单独估计通用生成式AI（如ChatGPT、Gemini等大语言模型应用）对60岁及以上老年人抑郁症状的影响。作者指出，既有元分析多将通用GenAI与专用治疗聊天机器人、语音助手或社交机器人混合合并，导致通用GenAI的独立效应不明。方案计划检索APA PsycINFO、Web of Science、PubMed、Scopus、ACM Digital Library和Google Scholar，纳入实验与准实验研究，以Hedges' g为效应量、采用随机效应模型合并，并按使用模态（语音/文本）做亚组分析、在文献充足时进行元回归；同时使用RoB 2、ROBINS-I和NIH前后测工具评估偏倚风险，以GRADE评价证据确定性，遵循PRISMA 2020。当前材料仅为研究方案，尚未报告任何合并结果或数据。

papers.title: Open-HumanWAM: An Open Recipe for Scaling Human and Robot Experience for Embodied Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Egocentric human video offers a scalable source of manipulation priors for robot learning, yet translating raw data scale into generalizable robot policies demands rigorous data curation and training recipes. We introduce Open-HumanWAM, the first fully open recipe for scaling egocentric pretraining to 50,000 hours, anchored by Open-HumanWAM-50K---a curated egocentric video corpus densely annotated with hand motion and natural language. Leveraging this corpus, we systematically investigate pure human pretraining via closed-loop simulation evaluations and uncover an empirical log-linear scaling law linking pretraining data hours to downstream robot success rates. Grounded in these findings, we develop HumanWAM-Vanilla, a world--action model pretrained exclusively on 50k hours of egocentric human video. Upon robot post-training, HumanWAM-Vanilla reaches 92.08% success on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean2Clean and 68.88% on Clean2Random, alongside a 14.17% mean success rate and a 19.00 mean progress score on RoboDojo. To push the capability frontier further, we explore joint human--robot pretraining with HumanWAM-Goal, a visual-goal-conditioned world--action model. Hybrid data scaling unlocks broad zero-shot generalization across both simulation and physical benchmarks, propelling post-trained RoboTwin 2.0 performance to new state-of-the-art levels: 92.70% on Clean2Clean and a substantial leap to 84.60% on Clean2Random. On physical robots, HumanWAM-Goal further exhibits emergent embodied in-context learning, dynamically adapting its manipulation behavior to unseen visual goals without parameter updates. To support reproducible scaling research in embodied AI, we open-source the Open-HumanWAM-50K corpus, data curation and pretraining pipelines, alongside the pretrained and post-trained HumanWAM checkpoints, inference code, and simulation evaluation suites.
papers.summary: Open-HumanWAM 提出首个完全开放的第一人称人类视频预训练配方，将数据规模扩展至 5 万小时，并构建了密集标注手部运动与自然语言的 Open-HumanWAM-50K 语料。作者通过闭环仿真系统研究纯人类视频预训练，发现预训练数据小时数与下游机器人成功率之间存在经验对数线性扩展规律。基于此训练了仅用人类视频预训练的 world-action 模型 HumanWAM-Vanilla，机器人后训练后在 RoboTwin 2.0 和 RoboDojo 上取得明确结果。进一步提出视觉目标条件化的 HumanWAM-Goal，探索人-机器人联合预训练，混合数据扩展带来仿真与物理基准上的零样本泛化提升，并在物理机器人上展现无需参数更新的具身上下文学习能力。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 首个全开放 5 万小时第一人称人类视频预训练配方，揭示数据规模与机器人成功率间的对数线性扩展规律，并通过人-机器人联合预训练实现强零样本泛化与具身上下文学习。
