limitations: 效用信号依赖曝光后行为（分享、长观看、完播等），存在曝光选择偏差与效用信号快速变化的建模风险
摘要未报告离线实验的具体指标与对比基线细节，效用增强语义码相对纯语义SID的增益幅度缺乏量化说明
线上收益为0.206%观看时长，绝对幅度较小，需结合长期生态与多目标权衡进一步评估
papers.practical_value: 面向大规模工业生成式推荐系统，UAGR在不改变SID长度、词表规模和解码成本的前提下把业务效用引入检索环节，工程改造成本低、可增量更新，并已在快手全量部署，为生成式召回与下游多目标效用对齐提供了可直接落地的方案。
papers.why_it_matters: 它指出了生成式推荐中两个常被忽视的工程痛点：语义SID丢失效用信息，以及生成似然与业务效用错位导致beam剪枝误杀高价值候选；并给出不增加线上解码开销的解法，附真实流量A/B与全量部署证据，对做生成式召回落地的团队具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: RoboColosseum: Evaluating Physical Intelligence at Scale In-The-Wild
papers.abstract: General-purpose robot policies must work across robots, tasks, and environments, yet the variation that makes physical trials informative also makes them difficult to reproduce. We introduce RoboColosseum, a distributed evaluation framework that combines unified policy serving and standardized protocols across a network of locally operated robots in diverse environments. Our initial study evaluates five vision-language-action (VLA) policies and three frontier AI agents across four embodiments (SO-101, Franka, Bimanual-YAM, and G1 Humanoid). The Open Track compares models without task-specific adaptation in blinded, pairwise trials under matched local conditions. The Fine-tune Track measures how well VLA policies adapt to 20 tasks across all four embodiments when each policy receives the same 100 demonstrations per task. Across 5,699 pairwise Open Track comparisons at 124 sites, frontier agents rival specialized VLA policies, while all systems struggle to complete open-world tasks reliably. After fine-tuning, GR00T N1.7 leads on SO-101 and pi0.5 leads on Franka and Bimanual-YAM. Policy rankings show weak agreement across embodiment-specific task suites (Kendall W = 0.24). Open Track rankings poorly predict relative performance after fine-tuning, with substantial rank reversals on all three embodiments shared between tracks. Measuring partial progress reveals differences that task success alone misses. On the G1 Humanoid, no policy completes any of the five tasks, yet average progress ranges from 13.3% to 23.2% across policies. Open Track rankings stabilize as trials accumulate, and active matchmaking achieves comparable ranking agreement with substantially fewer physical trials than uniform sampling. These results show how distributed physical evaluation can reveal where robot policies generalize, how well they adapt to new tasks, and how far they progress on tasks they fail to complete.
papers.summary: RoboColosseum 提出分布式物理智能评测框架，将统一策略服务与标准化协议部署到多地本地运行的机器人网络上，以解决物理试验难以复现的问题。首轮研究覆盖 SO-101、Franka、Bimanual-YAM 和 G1 Humanoid 四种本体，评测五个 VLA 策略与三个前沿 AI 智能体。Open Track 在匹配的本地条件下进行盲测成对比较，不做事先任务适配；Fine-tune Track 为每个策略在每项任务上提供相同的 100 条演示，衡量 20 项任务的适配能力。基于 124 个站点、5,699 次成对比较，前沿智能体与专用 VLA 策略表现相当，但所有系统在开放世界任务上均难以可靠完成；微调后 GR00T N1.7 在 SO-101 领先，pi0.5 在 Franka 与 Bimanual-YAM 领先。跨本体任务套件的策略排名一致性弱（Kendall W=0.24），Open Track 排名对微调后相对表现预测较差，三个共享本体上均出现显著名次反转。部分进度指标揭示成功率之外的差异：G1 Humanoid 上无策略完成五项任务，但平均进度在 13.3% 至 23.2% 之间。Open Track 排名随试验累积趋于稳定，主动匹配以显著更少物理试验达到相近排名一致性。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 分布式真实环境评测揭示：前沿智能体与专用 VLA 策略在开放任务上均不可靠，且跨本体排名与微调后表现难以互相预测。
papers.core_method: 构建分布式评测框架，在多地本地机器人上统一策略服务与标准化协议；设计 Open Track 盲测成对比较与 Fine-tune Track 等量演示微调两条赛道，并引入部分进度度量与主动匹配采样。
innovation_points: 分布式真实环境评测网络，跨 124 个站点、四种本体执行标准化协议，提升物理试验可复现性
双赛道设计：Open Track 零适配盲测对比与 Fine-tune Track 等量演示适配，分离泛化与适配能力
引入部分进度指标，在任务成功率为零时仍能区分策略差异
主动匹配采样在保持排名一致性的同时显著减少物理试验次数
experiment_results: 5,699 次 Open Track 成对比较覆盖 124 个站点，前沿智能体与专用 VLA 策略相当，但所有系统开放世界任务可靠性低
微调后 GR00T N1.7 在 SO-101 领先，pi0.5 在 Franka 与 Bimanual-YAM 领先；跨本体任务套件排名一致性弱（Kendall W=0.24）
G1 Humanoid 五项任务无一完成，但平均进度在 13.3% 至 23.2% 之间；Open Track 排名随试验累积稳定，主动匹配以更少试验达到相近一致性
limitations: 初始研究仅覆盖五个 VLA 策略与三个前沿智能体、四种本体，规模有限
Open Track 排名对微调后表现预测较差，跨本体排名一致性弱，评测结论的外推性受限
部分进度指标虽揭示差异，但任务成功率整体偏低，开放世界任务完成能力仍不足
papers.practical_value: 为机器人策略提供可复现的分布式真实环境评测基础设施，帮助企业在大规模物理试验前以更少试验获得稳定排名，并通过部分进度与双赛道设计区分泛化、适配与推进能力，指导模型选型与微调投入。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把物理智能评测从单点实验室推向分布式真实环境，并揭示成功率之外的进度差异与跨本体排名不一致，对 VLA 策略评估方法论和机器人基础模型选型具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Localizing and Editing the Goal Representation of a Vision-Language-Action Model: code
papers.abstract: Code and analysis outputs for the paper Localizing and Editing the Goal Representation of a Vision-Language-Action Model (SPAIS Workshop at the 10th Conference on Robot Learning, CoRL 2026). The code studies OpenVLA-7B fine-tuned on LIBERO-Goal. It labels the goal that each closed-loop rollout executes, tests negated and redirected instructions, localizes the goal with activation patching, edits it with patches and steering vectors, and evaluates goal read-outs as runtime monitors.
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.summary: 该工作围绕视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）中目标表征的可解释性与可控性展开，以在LIBERO-Goal上微调的OpenVLA-7B为对象，构建了一套从行为标注到表征干预的闭环分析流程。作者先为每次闭环rollout执行的目标打标签，再测试否定与重定向指令下的行为变化，随后用激活修补定位承载目标信息的内部表征，并通过补丁替换与引导向量对目标表征进行编辑，最后评估目标读出信号作为运行时监控器的可行性。研究问题在于VLA的目标意图是否在模型内部形成可定位、可编辑的显式表征，以及该表征能否用于在线行为监测。技术路线属于机制可解释性与表征工程，而非训练新基座或新架构；结果层面仅能从元数据确认完成了上述实验流程，具体定位层位、编辑成功率与监控指标数值未在给定材料中披露。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 该代码库提供了在OpenVLA-7B上定位、编辑并监控目标表征的完整可复现实验流程，但具体量化结论需查阅原论文。
papers.core_method: 以LIBERO-Goal微调的OpenVLA-7B为对象，先对闭环rollout执行的目标进行行为标注，再用否定/重定向指令做行为探测；采用activation patching定位目标表征，通过补丁替换与steering vectors实施表征编辑，并将目标read-out作为运行时监控信号进行评估。
innovation_points: 将目标意图作为VLA内部可分析变量，串联行为标注、指令扰动、表征定位与编辑的闭环流程
同时使用activation patching与steering vectors两类干预手段，兼顾定位与因果编辑
把目标表征读出转化为运行时监控器，连接可解释性与在线安全监测
experiment_results: 给定材料仅说明在OpenVLA-7B（LIBERO-Goal微调）上完成目标标注、否定/重定向指令测试、激活修补定位、补丁与引导向量编辑及监控评估流程
未提供定位层位、编辑成功率、行为改变比例或监控指标等具体数值，需以原论文为准
limitations: 仅覆盖单一模型OpenVLA-7B与单一任务族LIBERO-Goal，跨模型与跨任务泛化性未知
证据来源为标题、摘要与元数据，缺少定量结果与统计显著性信息
目标表征编辑的因果效应与监控器的误报/漏报特性未在给定材料中量化
papers.practical_value: 为具身智能系统提供了一条可复用的目标意图审计路径：可在部署前定位并修正VLA的目标表征偏差，在运行中以目标读出信号监测异常或指令误解，降低闭环执行中的目标漂移风险。
papers.why_it_matters: VLA的目标理解直接决定机器人行为安全，而该工作把目标表征从黑箱行为提升为可定位、可编辑、可监控的对象，为机制可解释性在具身模型上的工程落地提供了可复现的代码与分析范式。

papers.title: RoboScope Kit: Unified Interfaces for Fast and Scalable Embodied-AI Evaluation
papers.abstract: Simulation benchmarks are the standard way to compare robot policies, but each benchmark brings its own evaluator, observation layout, and action convention, and evaluation is slow: 500 RoboTwin Easy episodes with one simulator and one model on one GPU take 359.7 minutes. Profiling the official StarVLA evaluator shows that simulation occupies CPU cores while the GPU averages 14.3% utilization. RoboScope Kit wraps each model once in a Python class called a Policy, and each benchmark once in an adapter around the benchmark's own evaluator, so the benchmark's rules and scoring stay unchanged. Scheduling runs simulator workers and Policy replicas as separate pools, sizes both from measured probes, and shards work deterministically across GPU instances; runtime optimization renders only the observations an action-chunk Policy reads. Adapters cover six benchmark families. On LIBERO-Long with a StarVLA checkpoint on one 48 GiB RTX 4090, the concurrency search selects twelve simulator workers sharing three Policy replicas, which evaluate 500 episodes 4.45$\times$ faster than the official StarVLA evaluation with equivalent success rates, 2.78$\times$ faster than RLinf, and 1.52$\times$ faster than vla-eval at its tuned configuration. With CUDA MPS, which lets the replicas run their kernels concurrently, the search selects sixteen workers sharing four replicas, 6.16$\times$ faster than StarVLA, 3.85$\times$ faster than RLinf, and 2.10$\times$ faster than vla-eval. On RoboTwin Easy, four GPUs with chunk-boundary observation complete the 500 episodes in 14.4 minutes, 25.04$\times$ faster than the single-GPU baseline, with identical success outcomes and terminal steps.
papers.summary: RoboScope Kit 针对具身智能策略评估中仿真基准接口不统一、评估速度慢的问题，提出统一评估框架。每个模型被封装为 Policy 类，每个基准通过适配器包裹其原生评估器，保持基准规则与评分不变。调度将仿真器 worker 与 Policy 副本作为独立资源池，基于实测探针确定规模，并确定性分片到多 GPU 实例；运行时仅渲染动作块策略实际读取的观测。适配器覆盖六类基准家族。在 LIBERO-Long 上，单张 48 GiB RTX 4090 下并发搜索选出 12 个仿真 worker 共享 3 个 Policy 副本，500 回合评估比官方 StarVLA 快 4.45 倍且成功率一致；启用 CUDA MPS 后快 6.16 倍。RoboTwin Easy 上四 GPU 完成 500 回合仅 14.4 分钟，比单 GPU 基线快 25.04 倍，成功结果与终止步数完全一致。
papers.one_line_takeaway: RoboScope Kit 通过统一模型与基准接口、分离调度仿真与策略资源池，在保持评分一致的前提下将具身策略评估加速最高 25 倍。
papers.core_method: 将每个模型封装为 Policy 类，每个基准用适配器包裹其原生评估器以保持规则与评分不变；调度器把仿真器 worker 和 Policy 副本作为两个独立池，基于实测探针确定池大小，并确定性分片到多 GPU 实例；运行时优化仅渲染动作块策略实际读取的观测。
innovation_points: 统一接口设计：Policy 封装模型、适配器封装基准原生评估器，不改变基准规则与评分
资源池分离调度：仿真 worker 与 Policy 副本独立扩缩容，基于实测探针确定规模并确定性分片
运行时观测裁剪：仅渲染动作块策略实际读取的观测，减少无效仿真开销
多基准覆盖：适配器覆盖六类基准家族，支持跨基准可扩展评估
experiment_results: LIBERO-Long 单张 48 GiB RTX 4090：并发搜索选出 12 个仿真 worker 共享 3 个 Policy 副本，500 回合比官方 StarVLA 快 4.45 倍、比 RLinf 快 2.78 倍、比调优后 vla-eval 快 1.52 倍，成功率一致
启用 CUDA MPS 后选出 16 个 worker 共享 4 个副本，比 StarVLA 快 6.16 倍、比 RLinf 快 3.85 倍、比 vla-eval 快 2.10 倍
RoboTwin Easy 四 GPU 完成 500 回合仅 14.4 分钟，比单 GPU 基线快 25.04 倍，成功结果与终止步数完全一致
limitations: 实验主要基于 StarVLA 检查点与 LIBERO-Long、RoboTwin Easy 等基准，对其他模型与基准家族的加速效果未在摘要中给出
CUDA MPS 等运行时优化依赖特定 GPU 与驱动环境，跨平台可移植性未说明
适配器需为每个基准单独实现，新基准接入仍需工程投入
papers.practical_value: 为具身智能策略评估提供统一、可扩展且高效的工程接口，显著缩短大规模仿真评估时间，降低多基准对比的集成成本，适合需要频繁评测机器人策略的研发团队。
papers.why_it_matters: 具身智能评估长期受限于各基准接口割裂与仿真效率低下，该工作在不改变基准评分的前提下实现显著加速，为策略迭代与基准对比提供了可复用的工程基础设施。

papers.title: Right Ranking, Wrong Scale: Reproducing the Robotic World Model's Dynamics Model and Testing the Uncertainty of Its Follow-up
papers.abstract: We reimplement the dynamics model of the Robotic World Model (RWM) and test the uncertainty estimate that its follow-up, RWM-U, uses to penalize reward in offline policy optimization. Our implementation matches the released model's gradients. On held-out data, training on the model's own rollouts beats one-step training at the preregistered long horizon for all ten episodes, but loses on short one-step windows. RWM-U's ensemble disagreement ranks rollout errors better than forecast step (Spearman rho = 0.90 at 100 steps), yet its spread substantially understates error: one-sigma coverage on the released checkpoint is 4.6% at 100 steps, versus 68% for a calibrated Gaussian. Rolling ensemble members on their own predictions raises coverage to 33%. The implemented squared-error loss on sampled predictions drives each member's variance toward zero. A horizon-specific rescaling restores one-sigma coverage under leave-one-episode-out evaluation, but not two-sigma coverage. We also identify two defects in the released evaluation pipeline. The study covers one robot, one gait and one dataset; it trains no policy.
papers.summary: 该论文复现了Robotic World Model（RWM）的动力学模型，并检验其后续工作RWM-U在离线策略优化中用于惩罚奖励的不确定性估计。作者实现与发布模型的梯度一致。在留出数据上，按预注册的长时域，用模型自身rollout训练在全部十个episode上优于单步训练，但在短时域单步窗口上表现更差。RWM-U的集成分歧对rollout误差的排序优于预测步数（100步时Spearman rho=0.90），但其分布宽度显著低估误差：发布检查点100步时1σ覆盖率为4.6%，而校准高斯为68%；滚动集成成员在其自身预测上可将覆盖率提升至33%。采样预测上的平方误差损失使各成员方差趋近于零。按horizon重缩放可在留一episode评估下恢复1σ覆盖，但无法恢复2σ覆盖。作者还指出发布评估流程中的两个缺陷。研究仅覆盖一个机器人、一种步态和一个数据集，且未训练策略。
papers.one_line_takeaway: RWM动力学模型可复现且长时域rollout训练有效，但RWM-U的不确定性估计排序正确却严重低估误差尺度，需校准而非直接用于奖励惩罚。
papers.core_method: 复现RWM动力学模型并验证梯度一致性；在留出数据上比较基于模型自身rollout训练与单步训练；评估RWM-U集成分歧对rollout误差的排序能力与覆盖率；分析平方误差损失导致方差坍缩的问题，并尝试滚动集成与horizon重缩放校准。
innovation_points: 首次独立复现RWM动力学模型并验证梯度与发布模型一致
系统诊断RWM-U不确定性估计的排序能力与尺度校准分离现象
揭示采样预测平方误差损失导致集成方差趋近零的机制
提出horizon特定重缩放以部分恢复覆盖率
experiment_results: 长时域rollout训练在全部十个episode上优于单步训练，但短时域单步窗口上更差
100步时集成分歧排序rollout误差的Spearman rho=0.90，但1σ覆盖率仅4.6%（校准高斯为68%）
滚动集成成员自身预测将覆盖率提升至33%；horizon重缩放恢复1σ但未恢复2σ覆盖
limitations: 仅覆盖一个机器人、一种步态和一个数据集，泛化性有限
未训练策略，无法验证不确定性惩罚对策略优化的端到端影响
重缩放仅恢复1σ覆盖，2σ覆盖仍未校准
papers.practical_value: 为使用世界模型不确定性进行离线策略优化提供校准警示：排序信号可用但尺度不可直接作为奖励惩罚，需进行horizon特定校准；同时指出发布评估流程缺陷，有助于后续复现与工程部署。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作揭示世界模型不确定性估计中排序正确但尺度错误的关键问题，避免下游策略优化因过度惩罚而失效，对基于模型的离线强化学习实践具有直接校准价值。

papers.title: TriPhysBench: Evaluating Physical Intelligence for Embodied Agents
affiliations: Zhongnan University of Economics and Law
Huazhong University of Science and Technology
papers.abstract: Embodied agents need physical intelligence to understand their surroundings through physical perception, physical knowledge retrieval, and physical reasoning. These capabilities must work together to interpret events and make quantitative judgments. Existing benchmarks advance physical understanding and general-purpose tool use, yet the coordination of these capabilities in physical scenarios remains insufficiently characterized. Inspired by Popper's Three Worlds, we introduce TriPhysBench, a benchmark of 410 questions from 200 videos that brings physical perception, physical knowledge retrieval, and physical reasoning into a shared evaluation setting. Its measurement-grounded and knowledge-grounded subtasks impose complementary demands on obtaining observations and acquiring external specifications, then applying them to quantitative problems. Among six representative vision-language models, the best achieves an answer accuracy of only 50.38%, revealing limited performance on tasks that require these capabilities to work together. We further introduce TriPhys, a framework that learns a unified policy for physical perception, knowledge retrieval, and quantitative reasoning from complete tool-integrated trajectories. The policy uses intermediate reasoning to guide retrieval and computation, then incorporates tool feedback into subsequent physical inference. On 110 questions from videos excluded from training, TriPhys improves answer and solution scores across three Qwen configurations, with a 17.7% relative gain in answer accuracy for TriPhys-27B over its Qwen3.6-27B backbone. This work provides a benchmark and a learning pathway toward embodied agents that move beyond recognizing events to understanding and reasoning about the physical processes behind them.
papers.summary: 该论文针对具身智能体在物理场景中协同运用物理感知、物理知识检索与物理推理的能力缺乏系统评测的问题，提出TriPhysBench基准，包含来自200个视频的410道问题，受波普尔三个世界理论启发，将三类能力纳入统一评测框架，并设置测量型与知识型子任务以施加互补要求。作者评测六个代表性视觉语言模型，最佳答案准确率仅50.38%，显示协同能力明显不足。进一步提出TriPhys框架，从完整工具集成轨迹中学习统一策略，用中间推理引导检索与计算，并将工具反馈纳入后续物理推断；在110道训练外视频问题上，三种Qwen配置的答案与解答得分均提升，TriPhys-27B相对Qwen3.6-27B骨干答案准确率相对提升17.7%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: TriPhysBench揭示现有视觉语言模型在物理感知、知识检索与定量推理协同上仅约五成准确率，TriPhys以工具集成轨迹学习给出可提升路径。
papers.core_method: 构建TriPhysBench统一评测基准，含410题、200视频，分测量型与知识型子任务；提出TriPhys框架，从完整工具集成轨迹学习统一策略，以中间推理引导知识检索与计算，并将工具反馈融入后续物理推断。
innovation_points: 受波普尔三个世界理论启发，将物理感知、物理知识检索与物理推理纳入同一评测设置
设计测量型与知识型互补子任务，分别考察获取观测与获取外部规格并用于定量问题
提出从完整工具集成轨迹学习统一策略的TriPhys框架，使工具反馈参与后续物理推断
experiment_results: 六个代表性视觉语言模型中最佳答案准确率仅50.38%
在110道训练外视频问题上，TriPhys在三种Qwen配置上提升答案与解答得分
TriPhys-27B相对Qwen3.6-27B骨干答案准确率相对提升17.7%
limitations: 基准规模为410题、200视频，覆盖范围有限
评测仅涉及六个代表性视觉语言模型，模型覆盖面有限
TriPhys验证限于三种Qwen配置与110道训练外问题，泛化性证据有限
papers.practical_value: 为具身智能体物理理解能力提供可复用的评测基准与工具集成学习范式，有助于诊断感知、检索与推理协同短板，并指导面向真实物理场景的模型训练与系统设计。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作指出具身智能体不能仅识别事件，还需理解并推理物理过程；其基准与学习路径为从事件识别走向物理过程理解提供了可量化评测与训练参考。

papers.title: Beyond Validation Loss: Coverage and Reliability Dynamics in Robot Policy Pretraining
papers.abstract: In modern robot learning, generative robot policies are first pretrained through supervised learning from demonstrations, then refined through reinforcement learning, supervised finetuning, or other forms of posttraining. Yet conventional pretraining metrics, such as validation loss and average task success, provide an incomplete account of which policies support both effective direct deployment and subsequent posttraining. In this work, we study closed-loop pass@k, which evaluates the probability that k rollouts from the same initial condition attain at least one success. Thus, pass@1 measures mean task success; large-k pass@k measures whether success remains reachable under repeated sampling. Across a wide range of posttraining recipes, we show that large-k pass@k reveals posttraining differences not captured by pass@1. In particular, checkpoints with similar pass@1 but different large-k pass@k have different posttraining performance. Moreover, we show pass@k peaks at different checkpoints during supervised pretraining, revealing a coverage-reliability tradeoff over the course of training. Based on these observations, we propose two practical interventions: (1) a purely offline checkpoint-selection criterion that balances coverage and reliability without closed-loop evaluation, and (2) a generative data augmentation procedure that expands supervision beyond the finite demonstration set, preserving large-k pass@k while maintaining or improving pass@1 and raising the observed coverage-reliability Pareto frontier. Together, our results motivate evaluation, checkpoint selection, and training procedures that explicitly account for posttraining. Blog post, visualizations, and code are available at https://zhanyisun.github.io/robot-policy-learning-dynamics/.
papers.summary: 该论文研究机器人策略预训练阶段的评估与检查点选择问题。作者指出，验证损失和平均任务成功率（pass@1）无法完整刻画策略在直接部署与后续后训练中的潜力，因此提出闭环pass@k指标：同一初始条件下k次rollout至少成功一次的概率，大k值反映重复采样下成功是否仍可达。实验覆盖多种后训练方案，发现pass@1相近但大k pass@k不同的检查点，后训练表现存在显著差异；监督预训练过程中pass@k在不同检查点达到峰值，揭示覆盖度与可靠性之间的权衡。基于此，作者提出两项实用干预：纯离线检查点选择准则，无需闭环评估即可平衡覆盖与可靠；生成式数据增强，扩展有限示范集之外的监督，在保持或提升pass@1的同时维持大k pass@k，并抬升覆盖-可靠性帕累托前沿。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 大k闭环pass@k能揭示平均成功率掩盖的预训练检查点差异，并指导检查点选择与数据增强以兼顾部署与后训练。
papers.core_method: 提出闭环pass@k评估指标（pass@1为均值成功率，大k衡量重复采样下成功可达性）；在多种后训练配方下比较检查点；分析监督预训练中pass@k随训练进程的峰值变化；设计纯离线检查点选择准则与生成式数据增强流程。
innovation_points: 用大k闭环pass@k刻画策略覆盖度，弥补验证损失和pass@1的评估盲区
发现pass@1相近的检查点在后训练表现上存在显著差异，且pass@k峰值位置不同，揭示覆盖-可靠性权衡
提出无需闭环评估的离线检查点选择准则，平衡覆盖与可靠
提出生成式数据增强扩展示范监督，抬升覆盖-可靠性帕累托前沿
experiment_results: 在多种后训练配方下，pass@1相近但大k pass@k不同的检查点后训练表现不同
监督预训练中pass@k在不同检查点达到峰值，呈现覆盖-可靠性权衡
生成式数据增强在保持或提升pass@1的同时维持大k pass@k，并抬升覆盖-可靠性帕累托前沿；具体数值未在给定材料中提供
limitations: 摘要未给出具体任务、数据集规模与量化提升幅度，实验细节需查阅原文
离线检查点选择准则与数据增强的通用性仍需在更广泛机器人任务上验证
大k pass@k评估需多次闭环rollout，计算成本较高
papers.practical_value: 为机器人策略预训练提供更贴近部署与后训练需求的评估指标和检查点选择方法，降低仅依赖验证损失或平均成功率带来的选型风险；生成式数据增强可在有限示范下提升策略覆盖度，对工业机器人学习流水线具有工程参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作将预训练评估从单次成功率推进到覆盖度与可靠性维度，直接关联后训练效果，为机器人基座策略的检查点管理和数据扩展提供了可操作准则。

papers.title: Route-Guided CBF-QP Repair for Safe Vision-Language-Action Models
affiliations: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can generate task-oriented robot actions, but they do not guarantee safe execution in obstacle-rich manipulation scenes. Although CBF-QP safety filters can locally project unsafe actions into a safe set, such correction may push the robot away from the learned task trajectory and leave the VLA policy without a reliable recovery direction. We propose Route-Guided CBF-QP Repair, a post-hoc repair module that uses the short-horizon action chunk predicted by the VLA to detect blocked nominal trajectories and generate entry-exit-rejoin guidance around obstacles. The selected route is added to the CBF-QP objective as a soft guidance term, while the CBF safety constraint remains hard. On SafeLIBERO, our method improves collision avoidance, task success, and SafeSuccess compared with AEGIS. Our project page is available at GitHub.
papers.summary: 该论文研究视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在障碍密集操作场景中缺乏安全执行保证的问题。现有CBF-QP安全滤波器虽能将不安全动作局部投影到安全集，但修正可能使机器人偏离学习到的任务轨迹，且VLA策略缺乏可靠恢复方向。作者提出Route-Guided CBF-QP Repair，一种事后修复模块：利用VLA预测的短时域动作块检测被阻塞的标称轨迹，围绕障碍生成进入-退出-回归引导路线；将选定路线作为软引导项加入CBF-QP目标，同时保持CBF安全约束为硬约束。在SafeLIBERO上，该方法相比AEGIS提升了避碰、任务成功率和SafeSuccess。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 用VLA短时动作块生成绕障回归路线作为CBF-QP软引导，在保持硬安全约束的同时修复被障碍阻塞的任务轨迹。
papers.core_method: 事后修复模块：以VLA预测的短时域动作块检测标称轨迹是否被障碍阻塞；若阻塞，则生成进入-退出-回归的绕障引导路线；将该路线作为软引导项加入CBF-QP优化目标，CBF安全约束保持硬约束，从而在安全投影中保留任务恢复方向。
innovation_points: 将VLA短时域动作块用于检测被阻塞的标称轨迹，并生成进入-退出-回归的绕障引导
把路线引导作为CBF-QP目标中的软项，同时保持CBF安全约束为硬约束，兼顾安全与任务恢复
作为事后修复模块，不改变原VLA策略，可附加到已有策略上
experiment_results: 在SafeLIBERO上，相比AEGIS，避碰、任务成功率和SafeSuccess均有提升（摘要未给出具体数值）
limitations: 仅在SafeLIBERO仿真基准上评估，未报告真实机器人实验
摘要未提供具体量化指标与统计显著性
依赖VLA短时域动作块的质量来检测阻塞与生成路线
papers.practical_value: 为已部署的VLA操作策略提供可附加的安全修复层，在不重训策略的前提下降低障碍密集场景中的碰撞风险并维持任务完成率，适合作为机器人操作安全部署的事后保障模块。
papers.why_it_matters: 它直面CBF安全滤波修正导致任务轨迹偏离且缺乏恢复方向的关键矛盾，提出软引导加硬约束的折中方案，对VLA安全部署与安全滤波研究具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Xiaomi Auto World Model 2.0: Causal World Models for Real-World Driving and Embodied Intelligence
papers.abstract: We present Xiaomi Auto World Model 2.0, a unified streaming causal world model for Physical AI. It models and generates causal physical evolution in the real world, and unifies heterogeneous conditioning inputs for view-consistent generation. The architecture integrates View-Temporal Attention (VTA) to capture cross-view spatial dependencies and temporal dynamics, together with Multi-view Rotary Position Encoding (RoPE) to encode positional relationships across views and time. WorldRec 2.0 reconstructs static and dynamic 3D Gaussians from multi-view, multi-temporal observations in a single forward pass and uses their renderings as explicit scene context to preserve geometry and appearance during long-horizon generation. Conditioning inputs are fused through VAE latent concatenation in a shared representation space. We incorporate Gated Linear Attention (GLA) into the temporal layers of VTA for efficient streaming inference, reducing computation and KV-cache memory during multi-view rollouts. A physical-interaction data pipeline covers diverse interactions and long-tailed events. From Pre-train onward, these data are combined with large-scale videos and heterogeneous visual modalities to learn visual, geometric, and dynamic priors. During Mid-train, training across diverse view configurations further improves the model's ability to capture how actions and object states shape subsequent scene evolution. After distillation-based Post-train, we apply the model to closed-loop simulation, closed-loop training, and World Action Model (WAM) applications. These applications generate physically consistent future states and support world-state prediction, policy learning, and action generation for Physical AI.
categories: Generative Adversarial Networks and Image Synthesis
papers.summary: 小米汽车世界模型2.0提出统一的流式因果世界模型，面向真实驾驶与具身智能，建模并生成物理世界的因果演化，同时统一异构条件输入以实现视角一致的生成。架构上引入视图-时间注意力（VTA）捕捉跨视角空间依赖与时间动态，并用多视角RoPE编码跨视角与时间的位置关系；WorldRec 2.0在单次前向中从多视角多时刻观测重建静态与动态3D高斯，以其渲染结果作为显式场景上下文，在长时程生成中保持几何与外观一致。条件输入通过VAE隐变量拼接在共享表示空间融合；在VTA时间层引入门控线性注意力（GLA）以支持高效流式推理，降低多视角推演中的计算与KV缓存开销。数据侧构建物理交互数据管线覆盖多样交互与长尾事件，从预训练起与大规模视频及异构视觉模态联合学习视觉、几何与动态先验，中训练跨多样视角配置增强对动作与物体状态如何塑造后续场景演化的建模，蒸馏式后训练后用于闭环仿真、闭环训练与世界动作模型应用。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 以因果流式世界模型统一多视角条件生成与3D高斯场景上下文，服务真实驾驶闭环仿真与具身策略学习。
papers.core_method: 统一流式因果世界模型：VTA视图-时间注意力加多视角RoPE编码跨视角与时间位置；WorldRec 2.0单次前向重建静态/动态3D高斯并以渲染作显式场景上下文；条件输入经VAE隐变量拼接融合；时间层引入GLA实现高效流式推理；物理交互数据管线支撑预训练、中训练与蒸馏后训练。
innovation_points: 将视图-时间注意力与多视角RoPE结合，统一建模跨视角空间依赖与时间动态
WorldRec 2.0单次前向重建静态与动态3D高斯，以渲染结果作为显式场景上下文保障长时程几何与外观一致性
在VTA时间层引入门控线性注意力，降低多视角流式推演的计算与KV缓存开销
构建覆盖多样交互与长尾事件的物理交互数据管线，并贯穿预训练、中训练与后训练
experiment_results: 摘要未提供定量实验结果与评测指标，仅说明模型应用于闭环仿真、闭环训练与世界动作模型，生成物理一致的未来状态并支持世界状态预测、策略学习与动作生成
limitations: 摘要未给出定量评测与基线对比，生成质量与效率收益缺乏数据支撑
长尾事件与物理交互数据的覆盖范围与真实性未在摘要中量化说明
闭环仿真与闭环训练中的实际部署效果未提供验证细节
papers.practical_value: 面向真实驾驶与具身智能场景，提供可流式推理的多视角一致世界模型，支撑闭环仿真、闭环训练与世界动作模型，用于世界状态预测、策略学习与动作生成，降低长时程生成中的几何漂移并控制推理显存开销。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作把因果世界建模、显式3D高斯场景上下文与高效流式注意力结合，指向物理AI中可闭环使用的世界模型，对驾驶仿真与具身策略学习具有参考价值。

papers.title: Same Path, Less Time: Training-Free Fast Execution of Vision-Language-Action Models under Inference Latency
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models predict chunks of future actions, yet deployed robots waste time in two ways that are independent of model capability: they halt while the next chunk is inferred, and they move at the speed of slow, cautious demonstrations. Existing remedies remove one loss each, and stacking them fails, because asynchrony and speed-up each change the correspondence between planned progress and executed motion. We present Path-preserving Time Scaling (PTS), a training-free execution layer for frozen action-chunking policies built on one principle: the robot's motion is a time reparameterization of a reference path, and the path changes only in response to new observations. A path layer decodes every replan deterministically in one step and enters it at the progress consumed during inference. A time layer sums the planned increments, keeps the arm at 1x while the gripper moves, and caps the rate by the actuator's linear range and by chunk feasibility under latency. We show that misaligned entry and stochastic sampling add a bias and a variance to the continuation error, and derive a break-even success rate that states when speeding up pays off. On LIBERO with two frozen VLAs under injected inference latency, PTS raises task throughput over the strongest deployable baseline by 33% for pi0.5 and 104% for SmolVLA while matching or improving the success rate, is best on all six model-suite combinations, and exceeds zero-latency 1x execution. Against asynchronous 1x execution with the same one-step decoder, the time layer alone adds 28% and 38%. On LIBERO-Dynamic it improves on stop-and-wait execution by 38% and is comparable to asynchronous 1x execution.
papers.summary: 该论文关注视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在真实机器人部署中的推理延迟问题：动作分块策略在等待下一块推理时会停顿，且执行速度受保守示教数据限制。作者提出免训练的执行层PTS（Path-preserving Time Scaling），基于“机器人运动是参考路径的时间重参数化、路径仅随新观测改变”的原则，将执行拆为路径层与时间层：路径层对每次重规划做确定性一步解码，并从推理期间已消耗的进度处进入；时间层累加计划增量，在夹爪运动时保持机械臂1x速度，并按执行器线性范围与延迟下分块可行性限速。作者分析了入口错位与随机采样带来的偏差和方差，并推导出加速收益的盈亏平衡成功率。在LIBERO上对两个冻结VLA注入推理延迟，吞吐较最强可部署基线分别提升33%（pi0.5）和104%（SmolVLA），成功率持平或更优，六种模型-套件组合均最优，并超过零延迟1x执行；仅时间层相对同一步解码器的异步1x执行提升28%和38%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: PTS以免训练的时间重参数化执行层，在保持路径与成功率的前提下显著提升冻结VLA策略在推理延迟下的任务吞吐。
papers.core_method: 将冻结动作分块策略的执行解耦为路径层与时间层：路径层对每次重规划做确定性一步解码，并从推理期间已消耗的进度处进入，消除入口错位；时间层累加计划增量，夹爪运动时机械臂保持1x，按执行器线性范围与延迟下分块可行性限速，实现路径保持的时间缩放。
innovation_points: 提出免训练执行层，将机器人运动视为参考路径的时间重参数化，路径仅随新观测更新，从而统一处理异步与加速两类时间损失
路径层以确定性一步解码并按已消耗进度进入，避免入口错位与随机采样引入的偏差和方差
时间层结合夹爪/机械臂分工与执行器线性范围、延迟下分块可行性限速，给出可部署的加速规则
推导加速收益的盈亏平衡成功率，为何时加速提供判据
experiment_results: LIBERO注入推理延迟下，任务吞吐较最强可部署基线提升33%（pi0.5）与104%（SmolVLA），成功率持平或更优
六种模型-套件组合均最优，并超过零延迟1x执行
仅时间层相对同一步解码器的异步1x执行提升28%与38%；LIBERO-Dynamic上较停等执行提升38%，与异步1x执行相当
limitations: 实验限于LIBERO仿真与两个冻结VLA，未提供真实机器人平台验证
方法依赖动作分块策略与执行器线性范围等先验，对非分块或强非线性执行器场景的适用性未验证
盈亏平衡成功率基于偏差-方差分析推导，实际收益仍受延迟分布与任务成功率基线影响
papers.practical_value: 为已部署的冻结VLA策略提供即插即用的执行层，无需重新训练即可在推理延迟下提升吞吐并保持成功率，降低停等与保守示教速度带来的时间浪费，适合工程落地中的延迟补偿与执行加速。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把VLA部署中的推理延迟与执行速度问题从模型能力中剥离，给出免训练、可分析且可部署的执行层方案，对真实机器人系统的吞吐优化具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: When Embodied AI Infers Too Much
papers.abstract: As embodied AI systems enter homes, hospitals, and public spaces, they introduce a new class of privacy risks—not by recording more, but by inferring more. Drawing on modalities such as thermal imaging, radio-frequency sensing, chemical analysis, and pressure mapping, these systems can construct rich behavioural and physiological models of individuals, often without explicit user awareness or consent. While each signal may appear innocuous in isolation, sensor fusion can enable powerful inferences about health, habits, and emotional states. This article examines how current legal frameworks only partially address this shift from observation to inference, and explores how sensor design, regulatory oversight, and user-facing transparency can mitigate the risks. We argue that safeguarding privacy in the age of embodied AI requires recognising inference itself as a site of regulation and design—before silent insights become structural intrusions.
categories: Ethics and Social Impacts of AI
papers.summary: 本文关注具身AI系统在进入家庭、医院和公共空间时带来的新型隐私风险：风险核心不在于记录更多数据，而在于推断出更多信息。作者指出，热成像、射频感知、化学分析和压力映射等模态可被融合，用于构建个体的行为与生理模型，且常在用户不知情或未同意的情况下进行；单一信号看似无害，但传感器融合能对健康、习惯和情绪状态形成强推断。文章分析现行法律框架只部分覆盖从观察到推断的转变，并探讨传感器设计、监管监督和面向用户的透明度如何缓解风险，主张将推断本身视为监管与设计的对象。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 具身AI的隐私风险正从记录转向推断，因此推断本身应成为监管与设计的核心对象。
papers.core_method: 概念分析与政策讨论：以热成像、射频感知、化学分析、压力映射等传感模态为例，分析传感器融合如何产生健康、习惯与情绪推断；评估现行法律框架的覆盖缺口；提出传感器设计、监管监督与用户透明度三类缓解路径。
innovation_points: 将具身AI隐私问题重新界定为从观察到推断的转变，而非单纯的数据采集量增加
强调多模态传感器融合可使孤立无害信号组合成强推断能力
主张把推断本身作为监管与设计的独立对象，而非仅规制数据收集
提出传感器设计、监管监督与用户透明度相结合的缓解框架
experiment_results: 本文为概念与政策分析文章，未报告实验数据或定量结果
limitations: 未提供实证数据或用户研究来量化推断风险
对具体法律条款和跨司法辖区差异的讨论较为概括
所提缓解路径缺乏可操作的技术实现细节与评估指标
papers.practical_value: 为具身AI产品团队、隐私工程师和监管者提供风险识别框架：在传感器选型与融合设计阶段即评估推断能力，将透明度与同意机制嵌入系统，并为隐私影响评估提供从记录转向推断的新视角。
papers.why_it_matters: 随着具身AI进入家庭、医院和公共空间，隐私治理若仍只关注数据采集将留下结构性缺口；本文提示研究者和从业者把推断能力纳入设计与合规考量，避免静默洞察演变为结构性侵入。

papers.title: Beyond Ensemble Disagreement: Predictive STL Monitoring of RL Locomotion under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract: RL locomotion policies trained under nominal simulation conditions may encounter distribution shifts that compromise safety. Predictive monitors could anticipate violations, but their world-model forecasts may become unreliable under shift, and ensemble disagreement is not calibrated. We evaluate predictive Signal Temporal Logic (STL) monitoring for frozen Ant-v5 and HalfCheetah-v5 policies using closed-loop world-model rollouts and a three-model ensemble. Across external-force, observation-noise, and mass shifts, predicted robustness ranks HalfCheetah's future STL violations strongly, whereas disagreement does not reliably track observation prediction error or violations. Under severe noise, violations remain common ($64.2\pm24.4\%$ at $K{=}20$ across three PPO seeds), yet current-state robustness without prediction comes within $0.03$ AUROC of predictive robustness. Penalizing predicted robustness by disagreement does not consistently improve ranking. Ant provides complementary per-specification evidence, but its composite target has no positive violations and its any-violation target is single-class in most evaluated seed-condition slices. Overall, predictive robustness provides useful STL-specific ranking but little demonstrated additional ranking value over the current state; these findings caution against treating ensemble disagreement as a reliable indicator of safety uncertainty.
papers.summary: 本文研究在分布偏移下，用预测式STL监控评估冻结的Ant-v5与HalfCheetah-v5强化学习运动策略的安全性。方法采用闭环世界模型推演与三模型集成，在外部力、观测噪声和质量偏移下比较预测鲁棒性、集成分歧与当前状态鲁棒性。结果显示，预测鲁棒性对HalfCheetah未来STL违规有较强排序能力，而集成分歧并不能可靠跟踪观测预测误差或违规；严重噪声下违规仍常见（K=20时64.2±24.4%），但无预测的当前状态鲁棒性AUROC仅差0.03。用分歧惩罚预测鲁棒性也未稳定提升排序。Ant提供逐规范补充证据，但其复合目标无正违规、任一违规目标多为单类。结论是预测鲁棒性有STL特定排序价值，但相对当前状态增益有限，不宜把集成分歧当作安全不确定性可靠指标。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 预测式STL鲁棒性可排序未来违规，但集成分歧不可靠，且相对当前状态鲁棒性增益有限。
papers.core_method: 对冻结的Ant-v5和HalfCheetah-v5策略，用闭环世界模型推演和三模型集成计算预测STL鲁棒性，并在外部力、观测噪声和质量偏移下与集成分歧、当前状态鲁棒性比较排序能力。
innovation_points: 将预测式STL监控用于RL运动策略在分布偏移下的安全评估
系统检验集成分歧作为安全不确定性指标的校准性
对比预测鲁棒性与当前状态鲁棒性的排序增益
在多个PPO种子和偏移条件下做逐规范与复合目标分析
experiment_results: HalfCheetah上预测鲁棒性对未来STL违规排序较强，分歧不能可靠跟踪观测预测误差或违规
严重噪声下K=20违规率64.2±24.4%，当前状态鲁棒性AUROC仅比预测鲁棒性低0.03
分歧惩罚未稳定提升排序；Ant复合目标无正违规，任一违规目标多为单类
limitations: 预测鲁棒性相对当前状态鲁棒性的额外排序价值证据有限
Ant的复合目标无正违规且任一违规目标多为单类，限制评估
仅评估两个冻结策略和三类偏移，未覆盖训练动态或更多任务
papers.practical_value: 为RL运动策略部署时的安全监控选型提供警示：可优先考虑当前状态STL鲁棒性，谨慎将集成分歧当作安全不确定性信号。
papers.why_it_matters: 它直接挑战了集成分歧作为安全不确定性代理的常见假设，并量化预测式监控相对简单当前状态监控的边际收益，对安全监控设计有参考价值。

papers.title: Control Barrier Functions for Safety-Aware Latent-Space Motion Planning
papers.abstract: Latent-space path planning (LSPP) compresses the configuration space of a robotic manipulator into a compact, differentiable manifold learned by a variational autoencoder, enabling fast gradient-based planning without explicit inverse kinematics. Existing LSPP frameworks enforce obstacle avoidance with a binary collision classifier, whose saturated gradients near obstacle boundaries and lack of temporal structure cause the optimizer to stall and provide no forward-invariance guarantee. We replace the classifier with a neural control barrier function (CBF) learned directly in the latent space. The barrier is trained with a three-term objective that combines safe and unsafe sign constraints with a discrete-time decrease condition evaluated on transitions of an obstacle-blind nominal planner, and it is enforced at planning time by a closed-form, first-order correction that projects each goal-directed latent step back onto the CBF constraint. On a 7-DoF Franka Panda manipulator, the CBF planner achieves a 75.6\% success rate on a fixed-obstacle task, 12.0 percentage points above the best of 35 tuned classifier configurations, and 83.8\% on a multi-position task. A sweep of the decay rate $α$ characterizes the safety--performance trade-off, with the best operating points in $α\in [0.10, 0.20]$. In a fully general random-obstacle setting, success drops to 33.0\%, which we trace to covariate shift between the obstacle-blind training transitions and the states visited by the corrected planner.
papers.summary: 该论文针对潜在空间路径规划（LSPP）中二值碰撞分类器梯度饱和、缺乏时间结构与前向不变性保证的问题，提出在VAE学习的潜在流形上直接学习神经控制屏障函数（CBF）。屏障训练采用三项损失：安全/不安全符号约束，以及在障碍盲标称规划器转移上评估的离散时间衰减条件；规划时用闭式一阶校正将目标导向的潜在步投影回CBF约束集。在7自由度Franka Panda上，固定障碍任务成功率达75.6%，比35组调优分类器最佳配置高12.0个百分点；多位置任务达83.8%。衰减率α扫描显示最佳区间为[0.10,0.20]。完全随机障碍场景成功率降至33.0%，作者归因于训练转移与校正规划器访问状态间的协变量偏移。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 用潜在空间神经控制屏障函数替代二值碰撞分类器，为LSPP提供前向不变性约束，在固定障碍任务上显著提升成功率，但随机障碍下受协变量偏移限制。
papers.core_method: 在VAE压缩的潜在空间上学习神经控制屏障函数，训练目标由安全/不安全符号约束和基于障碍盲标称规划器转移的离散时间衰减条件三项组成；规划时对每个目标导向潜在步施加闭式一阶投影校正，使其满足CBF约束。
innovation_points: 将控制屏障函数引入潜在空间运动规划，替代二值碰撞分类器，缓解边界梯度饱和问题
设计三项训练目标，在障碍盲标称规划器转移上评估离散时间衰减条件，赋予约束时间结构
规划时采用闭式一阶校正投影，计算轻量且无需显式逆运动学
experiment_results: 7-DoF Franka Panda固定障碍任务成功率75.6%，比35组调优分类器最佳配置高12.0个百分点
多位置任务成功率83.8%
完全随机障碍场景成功率降至33.0%，归因于协变量偏移；α最佳区间为[0.10,0.20]
limitations: 随机障碍场景成功率仅33.0%，训练与部署状态分布存在协变量偏移
仅在7自由度Franka Panda仿真环境验证，未涉及真实机器人实验
CBF约束依赖标称规划器转移分布，泛化到新障碍布局时需重新训练或校正
papers.practical_value: 为机械臂潜在空间规划提供了一种可微、计算轻量的安全约束机制，闭式投影校正适合在线部署；固定障碍或多位置工业场景下成功率提升明显，但随机障碍场景需先解决协变量偏移问题。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作将安全控制理论与生成式潜在规划结合，指出二值分类器约束的梯度饱和与前向不变性缺失问题，并给出可操作的CBF替代方案；其随机障碍下的性能下降也揭示了潜在空间安全约束的分布偏移挑战，对后续研究有参考价值。

papers.title: Vision-Language Models Are Joint Denoisers in Robotic Action Generation
affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
papers.abstract: Diffusion-based vision-language-action (VLA) models cascade pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) with diffusion action experts, but typically restrict the VLM to providing static conditioning. This separation limits how much pretrained perception and reasoning can guide action generation, especially in out-of-distribution settings. We introduce JADE, a Joint Action DEnoiser that enables the VLM and action expert to jointly refine actions. Our key insight is that structured action latents allow the VLM to read the current noisy action together with visual observations and language instructions. At every denoising step, the VLM contextualizes the noisy action and guides the action expert through gated cross-attention, so that its guidance evolves with the action being generated. We further supervise the VLM to recover clean action latents from noisy ones, which gives it a direct action-learning signal and couples perception with control. Additionally, joint denoising enables JADE to generate actions with fewer sampling steps, helping offset the additional cost of VLM participation. An adaptive step-size schedule further balances task performance and inference latency. On RoboDojo, JADE achieves an average success rate of 12.67%, the highest among the evaluated $π_{0.5}$-based methods, and is competitive with recent VLA and WAM foundation models pretrained at scale. It also improves performance on RoboTwin 2.0 and raises the average success rate across four real-world bimanual tasks by 20.8 percentage points compared with $π_{0.5}$.
papers.summary: 该论文针对扩散式视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中预训练VLM仅提供静态条件、感知推理无法随去噪过程动态引导动作生成的问题，提出JADE（Joint Action DEnoiser）。其核心思路是构造结构化动作潜变量，使VLM在每一步去噪中同时读取当前噪声动作、视觉观测与语言指令，并通过门控交叉注意力向动作专家提供随生成过程演化的引导；同时监督VLM从噪声动作潜变量恢复干净动作，赋予其直接的动作学习信号，将感知与控制耦合。联合去噪还支持更少采样步数，配合自适应步长调度平衡性能与推理延迟。在RoboDojo上，JADE取得12.67%的平均成功率，为所评估的基于π0.5的方法中最高，并与大规模预训练的近期VLA与WAM基础模型具有竞争力；在RoboTwin 2.0上亦有提升，并在四个真实双臂任务上将平均成功率相对π0.5提高20.8个百分点。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 让VLM在每一步去噪中联合精炼动作潜变量，而非仅作静态条件，可显著提升扩散式VLA的分布外泛化与真实双臂任务成功率。
papers.core_method: JADE将动作编码为结构化动作潜变量，在扩散去噪的每一步把当前噪声动作与视觉观测、语言指令一同输入预训练VLM；VLM通过门控交叉注意力向动作专家传递随去噪进程演化的引导，并接受从噪声动作恢复干净动作潜变量的监督，从而获得直接动作学习信号；联合去噪支持更少采样步数，并引入自适应步长调度以平衡任务表现与推理延迟。
innovation_points: 将预训练VLM从静态条件提供者转变为联合去噪器，使其引导随动作生成过程动态演化
设计结构化动作潜变量与门控交叉注意力机制，使VLM能读取并上下文化噪声动作
对VLM施加从噪声动作恢复干净潜变量的监督，把感知与控制耦合进同一学习信号
联合去噪减少采样步数，配合自适应步长调度抵消VLM参与带来的额外推理成本
experiment_results: RoboDojo上平均成功率12.67%，为所评估的基于π0.5的方法中最高，并与大规模预训练的近期VLA与WAM基础模型具有竞争力
在RoboTwin 2.0上取得性能提升（摘要未给出具体数值）
四个真实世界双臂任务上，平均成功率相对π0.5提升20.8个百分点
limitations: VLM参与每一步去噪带来额外计算开销，虽通过减少采样步数与自适应调度缓解，但未给出与纯动作专家的完整延迟对比数据
真实世界评估仅覆盖四个双臂任务，跨本体与更广泛场景的泛化性尚未验证
摘要未报告与大规模预训练基线在参数量与训练数据规模上的可比性细节
papers.practical_value: 面向机器人操作的真实业务场景，JADE在真实双臂任务上相对π0.5提升20.8个百分点，说明在工程部署中可复用预训练VLM的感知与推理能力直接改善控制成功率；其少步采样与自适应步长调度针对线上推理延迟约束提供了可调的性能—时延折中，对需要实时响应的操作任务具有部署参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作挑战了扩散式VLA中VLM仅作静态条件的惯例，给出让预训练感知推理深度参与动作去噪的具体架构与监督方案，并在仿真与真实双臂任务上验证收益，对VLA架构设计与预训练模型复用方式具有直接启发。

papers.title: Auriga Technical Report: A Task-Agnostic Agent Harness for Zero-Shot Embodied Manipulation
papers.abstract: Vision-language models can interpret instructions and plan manipulation tasks, yet struggle when acting directly as robot policies. On RoboDojo, a large planning-execution gap separates high-level task decisions from physical execution: removing arm execution raises GPT-6 Astra's success rate from 22.5% under the reference control interface to 76.2%. We present Auriga, a task-agnostic agent harness that closes 68.3% of this gap in zero-shot manipulation without target-task trials or resets. In Auriga, the model makes all task decisions over an explicit task belief and acts through either direct tool calls or synthesized multi-step Python programs, while the harness supplies calibrated 3D measurements, finger-referenced dual-arm control, and a single admission gateway to the robot. Before motion, the model inspects a visual trajectory preview while simulation is paused; during execution, the harness checks declared stage tolerances and grasp bounds, stopping the robot on divergence and returning the measured discrepancy for in-place recovery. Developed across 13 cross-task capability iterations and frozen for evaluation, Auriga ranks first on the RoboDojo leaderboard with a 57.7% success rate (64.0 Score), more than doubling the reference harness on the same model, and remains first under scene randomization while learned policies drop by up to 33.9%. On RoboCasa365, the same frozen harness reaches a 73.2% success rate, outperforming VLA-assisted agents by up to 23.1% on composite tasks. Project page: https://auriga.stelledge.com/ Code: https://github.com/lose4578/Auriga
papers.summary: Auriga技术报告针对视觉语言模型直接作为机器人策略时存在的规划-执行鸿沟问题，提出任务无关的智能体执行框架。在RoboDojo基准上，移除机械臂执行后GPT-6 Astra成功率从22.5%升至76.2%，揭示高层决策与物理执行间的巨大落差。Auriga让模型基于显式任务信念做决策，通过直接工具调用或多步Python程序执行，框架提供校准3D测量、手指参考双臂控制和单一准入网关。运动前模型在仿真暂停时检查视觉轨迹预览，执行中框架校验阶段容差与抓取边界，偏离时停机并返回测量差异供原地恢复。经13轮跨任务能力迭代后冻结评估，RoboDojo排行榜以57.7%成功率（64.0分）居首，同模型下为参考框架两倍以上，场景随机化下仍第一而学习策略最多下降33.9%；RoboCasa365上同一冻结框架达73.2%成功率，复合任务超VLA辅助智能体最多23.1%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Auriga用任务无关执行框架弥合VLM规划与机器人执行的鸿沟，零样本操作成功率翻倍且跨基准领先。
papers.core_method: 提出任务无关智能体执行框架Auriga：模型在显式任务信念上做全部任务决策，通过直接工具调用或合成多步Python程序行动；框架提供校准3D测量、手指参考双臂控制和单一机器人准入网关；运动前在仿真暂停时检查视觉轨迹预览，执行中校验声明阶段容差与抓取边界，偏离时停机并返回测量差异供原地恢复；经13轮跨任务能力迭代后冻结评估。
innovation_points: 任务无关执行框架设计，将任务决策与物理执行解耦，模型仅通过显式任务信念和工具/程序接口行动
执行前视觉轨迹预览与执行中阶段容差、抓取边界校验结合，偏离时停机并返回测量差异支持原地恢复
单一准入网关与校准3D测量、手指参考双臂控制，提升零样本操作的可控性与安全性
跨任务能力迭代后冻结评估，验证框架在场景随机化下的鲁棒性
experiment_results: RoboDojo排行榜第一，成功率57.7%（64.0分），同模型下为参考框架两倍以上
场景随机化下仍居第一，学习策略成功率最多下降33.9%
RoboCasa365上同一冻结框架达73.2%成功率，复合任务超VLA辅助智能体最多23.1%
RoboDojo上移除机械臂执行后GPT-6 Astra成功率从22.5%升至76.2%，量化规划-执行鸿沟
limitations: 摘要未报告真实物理机器人部署结果，评估主要在仿真基准完成
框架依赖校准3D测量与视觉轨迹预览，感知误差对执行的影响未量化
零样本成功率57.7%仍有提升空间，复杂长程任务可靠性未充分说明
papers.practical_value: 为企业机器人操作提供任务无关执行中间层，可复用同一冻结框架跨任务与场景，降低对目标任务试错和重置的依赖；执行中容差校验与停机恢复机制提升线上安全性与可运维性，适合零样本部署和快速任务切换场景。
papers.why_it_matters: 它量化了VLM作为机器人策略的规划-执行鸿沟，并给出不依赖目标任务试错的通用执行框架，在多个基准上以冻结状态领先，对具身智能落地和智能体系统工程有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Leap-VLA: High-Rate Robot Control from a Low-Rate VLM Backbone
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models re-encode the full observation through a multi-billion-parameter vision-language model (VLM) at every control step, even though scene semantics evolve at roughly 1 Hz while reactive control requires 20-50 Hz. We present a VLA that decouples the two: a VLM runs as a low-frequency semantic anchor whose cached context is reused across control steps, while a flow-matching action expert operates at high frequency, consuming the cached semantics with a fresh, low-latency visual stream from a compact encoder pretrained on robot video with masked reconstruction, optical flow, and depth. The measured age $τ$ of the cache conditions the expert through adaptive layer normalization. Reusing the cache makes the policy a function of its age, and training covers that function explicitly: cache ages sampled from real episode history, plus an age-ramped pixel corruption that erases the stale snapshot the way deployed staleness corrupts content. On the asynchronous deployment stack, the recipe closes most of the staleness gap: on LIBERO-Spatial, 61.4% to 95.5% at a 2 s semantic refresh (95.9% at 1 s, within 1.6 points of the frequency-matched anchor); averaged over the four LIBERO suites, the deployed policy holds 95.2% at a 1 s refresh and 94.5% at 2 s against a 96.3% matched anchor. A forward-only chunk-boundary correction (soft-nudge), an autograd-free reformulation of real-time-chunking guidance, carries per-control-step re-planning without loss (97.1%) at zero added latency. The same lens exposes a second defect: under an instruction-scene mismatch the policy keeps manipulating the scene, and a chain-of-thought verdict gate trained on zero-cost negative episodes freezes execution exactly on mismatched instructions without hurting feasible success.
papers.summary: 该论文针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人控制中每步都需通过数十亿参数VLM重编码全观测、导致高频控制延迟大的问题，提出Leap-VLA。其核心是解耦语义与反应控制：VLM以约1Hz低频运行作为语义锚点并缓存上下文，供后续控制步复用；高频流匹配动作专家以20-50Hz运行，结合缓存语义与紧凑编码器提供的新鲜低延迟视觉流。缓存年龄τ通过自适应层归一化条件化动作专家，训练时显式覆盖该函数：从真实episode历史采样缓存年龄，并施加年龄递增的像素损坏以模拟部署中的陈旧性。在异步部署栈上，LIBERO-Spatial在2秒语义刷新下从61.4%提升至95.5%，1秒下95.9%；四个LIBERO套件平均在1秒和2秒刷新下分别保持95.2%和94.5%（匹配锚点96.3%）。此外，提出无梯度的前向块边界修正（soft-nudge）实现零额外延迟的每步重规划，并利用零成本负样本训练思维链裁决门，在指令-场景不匹配时冻结执行。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Leap-VLA通过低频VLM语义缓存与高频流匹配动作专家解耦，并显式建模缓存年龄，在异步部署下大幅缩小陈旧性带来的性能差距。
papers.core_method: 低频VLM作为语义锚点缓存上下文，高频流匹配动作专家消费缓存语义与紧凑编码器的新鲜视觉流；缓存年龄τ经自适应层归一化条件化专家；训练时从真实episode历史采样缓存年龄并施加年龄递增像素损坏；部署时采用前向soft-nudge块边界修正与思维链裁决门。
innovation_points: 解耦低频语义锚点与高频反应控制，复用VLM缓存上下文以降低每步重编码开销
显式将缓存年龄τ作为条件输入，并通过真实历史采样与年龄递增像素损坏训练策略对陈旧性的鲁棒性
提出无梯度的前向块边界修正（soft-nudge），实现零额外延迟的每控制步重规划
利用零成本负样本训练思维链裁决门，在指令-场景不匹配时冻结执行
experiment_results: LIBERO-Spatial在2秒语义刷新下从61.4%提升至95.5%，1秒下95.9%（匹配锚点差距1.6点）
四个LIBERO套件平均：1秒刷新95.2%，2秒刷新94.5%，匹配锚点96.3%
soft-nudge在零额外延迟下保持97.1%成功率；裁决门在指令不匹配时冻结执行且不损害可行任务成功率
limitations: 摘要未报告真实机器人平台上的闭环部署结果，主要评估在LIBERO仿真基准
缓存年龄条件化与像素损坏训练依赖对部署陈旧性分布的假设，跨场景泛化性未充分验证
思维链裁决门依赖零成本负样本的构造质量，其误冻结率与漏冻结率未量化
papers.practical_value: 为高频机器人控制提供了一种可落地的异步VLA部署方案：通过缓存复用显著降低VLM推理频率与延迟，同时以年龄条件化和训练时损坏保持策略对陈旧语义的鲁棒性；soft-nudge与裁决门以零额外延迟增强重规划与安全冻结能力，适合对实时性要求高的工业与服务机器人场景。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作直面VLA部署中语义更新频率与反应控制频率不匹配的核心工程矛盾，给出了从训练到部署的完整配方，并量化了缓存陈旧性对成功率的影响，对推动VLA从仿真走向实时机器人系统具有参考价值。

papers.title: MOST: Memory of Object States and Task Progress for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
affiliations: Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications
papers.abstract: Long-horizon embodied manipulation requires policies to act on information that is no longer visible. Modified objects may leave the field of view, while completed subtasks continue to constrain future actions. Existing approaches extend temporal context through recurrent state updates, test-time training, or storage and retrieval of past observations. As horizons grow, these mechanisms can still leave the policy to infer task state from long, redundant, and viewpoint-dependent visual experience. We argue that long-horizon agents benefit not merely from remembering more, but from remembering task-relevant state changes and progress. We propose Memory of Object States and Task Progress (MOST), a policy-internal memory framework that compresses multi-view observations into temporal tokens. Historical and predictive future tokens are explicitly supervised with object states and subtask progress, structuring memory around what has changed in the world and what has already been accomplished. The resulting memory directly conditions action generation within a single end-to-end policy, without an external planner or retrieval stage. We further introduce RoboCasa-Long, a benchmark of multi-minute, multi-stage mobile manipulation tasks. Across RoboCasa365, RoboCasa-Long, and real-world robot experiments, MOST consistently outperforms Xiaomi-Robotics-1 (XR-1), the previous state-of-the-art model. It raises average success from 65.9% to 72.1% on RoboCasa365, average maximum task progress from 20.83% to 42.22% on RoboCasa-Long, and real-world success from 6.66% to 43.33%. MOST also outperforms a matched visual-history memory variant, showing that effective long-horizon memory depends not only on how much experience is retained, but on whether it preserves decision-relevant progress and world-state changes.
papers.summary: 长时程具身操作要求策略基于已不可见的信息行动：被操作物体可能离开视野，已完成子任务仍约束后续动作。现有方法通过循环状态更新、测试时训练或历史观测存储检索扩展时间上下文，但随任务变长，策略仍需从冗长、冗余且依赖视角的视觉经验中推断任务状态。作者提出MOST，一种策略内部记忆框架，将多视角观测压缩为时序token，并用物体状态与子任务进度显式监督历史与预测未来token，使记忆围绕世界变化与已完成事项结构化，直接条件化动作生成，无需外部规划器或检索阶段。作者还构建RoboCasa-Long多分钟多阶段移动操作基准。在RoboCasa365、RoboCasa-Long和真实机器人实验中，MOST一致优于此前最优模型Xiaomi-Robotics-1：RoboCasa365平均成功率从65.9%升至72.1%，RoboCasa-Long平均最大任务进度从20.83%升至42.22%，真实世界成功率从6.66%升至43.33%；并优于匹配的视觉历史记忆变体，表明有效长时程记忆不仅取决于保留多少经验，更取决于是否保留决策相关的进度与世界状态变化。
papers.one_line_takeaway: MOST用物体状态与子任务进度显式监督策略内部时序记忆，让长时程移动操作记住“什么变了、做到了哪”，而非堆叠更多历史观测。
papers.core_method: 将多视角观测压缩为时序token，构建策略内部记忆；对历史token和预测未来token同时施加物体状态与子任务进度监督，使记忆结构化编码世界状态变化与任务完成度；记忆直接条件化单一端到端策略的动作生成，不依赖外部规划器或检索阶段；并构建RoboCasa-Long多分钟多阶段移动操作基准用于评测。
innovation_points: 提出以物体状态变化和子任务进度为核心监督信号的策略内部记忆，而非单纯扩展历史上下文或检索过去观测
对历史与预测未来时序token同时进行状态与进度监督，使记忆兼具回顾与前瞻结构
记忆直接嵌入端到端策略并条件化动作生成，省去外部规划器与检索阶段
构建RoboCasa-Long长时程多阶段移动操作基准，覆盖多分钟任务尺度
experiment_results: RoboCasa365平均成功率由65.9%提升至72.1%
RoboCasa-Long平均最大任务进度由20.83%提升至42.22%
真实世界成功率由6.66%提升至43.33%；并优于匹配的视觉历史记忆变体
limitations: 摘要未给出记忆压缩带来的计算与存储开销数据
真实世界实验规模与任务多样性未在摘要中量化
监督信号依赖物体状态与子任务进度标注，标注获取成本未讨论
papers.practical_value: 为长时程移动操作机器人提供无需外部规划器的端到端记忆方案，直接提升多阶段任务完成度与真实场景成功率，对家庭服务、仓储搬运等需跨视野跟踪物体与任务进度的场景有工程参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 它指出长时程记忆的关键不是“记得更多”，而是“记得决策相关的状态变化与进度”，并用显式监督验证这一思路，同时给出可复现的长时程基准，对具身智能记忆设计有直接启发。

papers.title: Reflex: Fast Robot Policy Serving by Reusing and Correcting Past Actions
papers.abstract: Modern robot policies often perform expensive inference to generate action chunks, making serving a latency bottleneck for real-time control and a throughput bottleneck for multi-robot serving. Building on the success of caching in image, video, and audio generation, recent robot-policy advances have reported promising speedups by reusing intermediate denoising states to avoid redundant computation. Surprisingly, we find that such reuse often offers little advantage over simply running fewer denoising steps from fresh noise, without any cache. Moreover, accelerating denoising leaves the expensive policy backbone intact, which can account for 70% of GPU time. We present Reflex, a serving layer that turns past policy executions into a backbone-free path for future decisions. Rather than reusing intermediate computations, Reflex caches complete action chunks to bypass both the backbone and action head. This introduces two challenges: similar observations can demand different actions, and small action deviations (errors) in reuse can compound into execution stalls. Reflex addresses these through two-level cache correction. At the action level, it learns action-aware similarity from past policy decisions, assembles compatible chunks, and applies lightweight residual correction to limit action mismatch. At the execution level, it captures task progress and adaptively refreshes the original policy to limit accumulated errors and balance inference cost. Without modifying the underlying policy, Reflex improves inference latency by 1.4x to 11x and throughput by 2.0x to 2.2x on representative workloads and real robots, while preserving comparable task success.
papers.summary: Reflex 针对机器人策略推理中动作块生成开销大、成为实时控制与多机服务瓶颈的问题，重新审视了复用中间去噪状态这一常见加速思路，发现其相对从新噪声少跑几步去噪并无明显优势，且无法绕过占 GPU 时间约 70% 的策略骨干。为此，Reflex 提出一种服务层方案：缓存完整动作块，使未来决策走无骨干路径，同时绕过骨干与动作头。为应对相似观测可能对应不同动作、以及复用误差累积导致执行停滞两大挑战，Reflex 设计两级缓存校正：动作级学习动作感知相似度、组装兼容动作块并施加轻量残差校正；执行级捕捉任务进度并自适应刷新原策略以限制累积误差、平衡推理成本。在不修改底层策略的前提下，Reflex 在代表性负载与真实机器人上将推理延迟降低 1.4 至 11 倍、吞吐提升 2.0 至 2.2 倍，并保持可比的任务成功率。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Reflex 用完整动作块缓存加两级校正替代中间状态复用，在不改策略的前提下显著降低机器人策略服务延迟并提升吞吐。
papers.core_method: 将历史策略执行结果缓存为完整动作块，未来决策直接复用缓存以绕过策略骨干与动作头；通过动作级相似度学习、兼容块组装与轻量残差校正，以及执行级任务进度感知的自适应策略刷新，控制动作偏差与累积误差。
innovation_points: 指出复用中间去噪状态相对少步去噪优势有限，且无法绕过占 GPU 时间约 70% 的骨干网络
以完整动作块缓存构建无骨干推理路径，同时绕过骨干与动作头
提出动作级与执行级两级缓存校正，分别限制动作不匹配与累积误差
作为服务层方案，无需修改底层策略即可部署
experiment_results: 在代表性负载与真实机器人上，推理延迟降低 1.4 至 11 倍
吞吐提升 2.0 至 2.2 倍
任务成功率保持可比；具体数值未在给定材料中提供
limitations: 依赖历史执行缓存，任务分布剧烈变化时缓存命中与校正效果可能受限
执行级自适应刷新需平衡误差与推理成本，参数调节可能影响收益
材料未给出成功率的具体量化对比与更多任务场景的验证
papers.practical_value: 为机器人策略在线服务提供无需改模型的加速层，可同时缓解实时控制延迟与多机器人服务吞吐瓶颈，便于在现有策略栈上部署。
papers.why_it_matters: 它挑战了中间状态复用这一流行加速假设，并给出绕过昂贵骨干的缓存校正路线，对机器人策略服务系统设计有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Beyond Semantic IDs: Atomic Creator Tokens for Large-Scale Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract: Recommending creators that a user does not yet follow is a cold-start problem: from hundreds of thousands of popular creators and only a short trail of prior engagements, the system must predict the next creator worth surfacing. The prevailing generative recommendation recipe tokenizes each creator into a \emph{Semantic ID} (SID) by quantizing a frozen embedding and trains a language model to generate SIDs. We show that this SID layer, not the language model, is the binding constraint. The creator-to-SID map is many-to-one, so colliding creators must be resolved by a popularity tie-break that caps creator-level recall and favors already-popular creators, and the frozen quantizer stops the training gradient from reaching the creator representation. We propose Atomic Creator Token (ACT), which gives every creator its own vocabulary token trained end-to-end. The map is bijective, so collisions are impossible and inference is a direct top-$k$ over creator logits. In a controlled comparison on production data in which the token layer is the only variable, ACT improves creator-level Recall@15 by 19.8 points ($1.84\times$) over a matched SID baseline, still leads when the SID codebook is enlarged $64\times$, and serves at ${\sim}2.7\times$ lower per-user latency. The advantage carries over to the public KuaiRand dataset, where ACT is the only method that beats a global-popularity baseline, provided each creator token sees enough training examples. In a live A/B test, ACT is directionally positive on every reported metric against both the SID-enhanced and the classic production rankers.
papers.summary: 该论文针对大规模生成式推荐中推荐用户未关注创作者的冷启动问题，指出主流做法将创作者量化为语义ID（SID）再让语言模型生成SID的流程中，真正的瓶颈是SID层而非语言模型：创作者到SID的映射是多对一，碰撞创作者只能靠热度打破平局，从而限制创作者级召回并偏向已热门创作者；同时冻结的量化器阻断了训练梯度回传到创作者表示。作者提出原子创作者Token（ACT），为每个创作者分配独立词表Token并端到端训练，使映射成为双射、碰撞不可能发生，推理时直接在创作者logits上取top-k。在生产数据受控对比中，仅改变Token层，ACT的创作者级Recall@15比匹配的SID基线提升19.8个百分点（1.84倍），即使SID码本扩大64倍仍领先，且每用户延迟降低约2.7倍；在公开KuaiRand数据集上，ACT是唯一超过全局热度基线的方法（前提是每个创作者Token有足够训练样本）；线上A/B测试中，ACT相对SID增强版和经典生产排序器在所有报告指标上均为正向。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 生成式推荐的瓶颈在语义ID层而非语言模型，为每个创作者分配独立且端到端训练的原子Token可同时提升召回并降低延迟。
papers.core_method: 为每个创作者分配一个独立的词表Token（原子创作者Token），替代基于冻结嵌入量化得到的语义ID；整个模型端到端训练，使梯度可回传到创作者表示；创作者到Token的映射为双射，推理时直接在创作者logits上取top-k，无需热度平局或码本解码。
innovation_points: 识别出语义ID层是多对一映射和冻结量化器造成的绑定约束，而非语言模型本身
提出原子创作者Token，实现创作者与Token一一对应，从根本上消除碰撞
端到端训练使创作者表示可被推荐目标直接优化，推理简化为创作者logits上的top-k
在受控对比中仅改变Token层即验证方法优势，并覆盖公开数据集与线上A/B测试
experiment_results: 生产数据受控对比：ACT的创作者级Recall@15比匹配SID基线提升19.8个百分点（1.84倍）
SID码本扩大64倍后ACT仍领先；每用户延迟降低约2.7倍
公开KuaiRand数据集上ACT是唯一超过全局热度基线的方法，但需每个创作者Token有足够训练样本；线上A/B测试对所有报告指标均为方向性正向
limitations: ACT依赖每个创作者Token获得足够训练样本，长尾创作者可能样本不足
线上A/B测试仅报告方向性正向，未给出具体显著性指标或提升幅度
方法在创作者推荐场景验证，向其他实体类型或更大规模词表的泛化性未充分讨论
papers.practical_value: 为大规模创作者推荐提供了一种更简单且更有效的Token化方案：消除SID碰撞与热度偏置，提升创作者级召回，同时显著降低线上推理延迟，适合直接替换现有生成式推荐中的SID层。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作挑战了生成式推荐中语义ID的默认设计，用受控实验和线上证据表明Token层才是关键瓶颈，为后续生成式推荐系统设计提供了新的基线思路和工程可落地的改进方向。

papers.title: Experts Exhibit Structured Redundancy: Structure-Preserving Expert Pruning for Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Sparse MoE mechanism significantly improves the trade-off between model capacity and inference efficiency. However, practical deployment still requires storing all experts, resulting in substantial memory overhead. We show that expert outputs in MoE layers exhibit structured redundancy. Across different models and task categories, the stable rank and entropy effective rank of expert outputs are consistently far below the nominal number of experts, while expert output distributions also exhibit fewer effective modes. Motivated by these observations, we reformulate expert pruning as a structure-preserving expert subset selection problem and efficiently optimize it via a greedy strategy, rather than only independently scoring and ranking individual experts or exhaustively searching over expert combinations. We propose two expert pruning methods under the unified structure-preserving framework: Projection Energy Expert Pruning (PEEP), which preserves the functional subspace by maximizing weighted projection energy, and Distributional Coverage Expert Pruning (DCEP), which preserves the distributional geometry by minimizing weighted coverage error. Both methods incorporate router-derived weights as priors, enabling them to jointly preserve the global structural relationships among experts while accounting for the local importance of individual experts. Experiments on DeepSeek-V2-Lite and Qwen3-30B-A3B demonstrate that, at the expert retention ratios of 75% and 50%, our methods outperform the state-of-the-art baselines on the majority of benchmarks and consistently achieve the best average performance across both general tasks and mathematical reasoning tasks.
papers.summary: 该论文研究MoE大语言模型部署中的专家存储内存开销问题，发现MoE层专家输出存在结构化冗余：在不同模型和任务类别上，专家输出的稳定秩与熵有效秩均远低于名义专家数，输出分布的有效模态也更少。基于此，作者将专家剪枝重新表述为结构保持的专家子集选择问题，并用贪心策略高效优化，而非仅独立打分排序或穷举组合。在统一框架下提出两种方法：PEEP通过最大化加权投影能量保持功能子空间，DCEP通过最小化加权覆盖误差保持分布几何，二者均以路由器权重为先验，兼顾全局结构关系与局部重要性。在DeepSeek-V2-Lite和Qwen3-30B-A3B上，75%和50%保留率下多数基准优于SOTA，通用与数学推理平均性能最佳。
papers.one_line_takeaway: MoE专家输出存在结构化冗余，将剪枝建模为结构保持的子集选择问题可优于独立打分排序。
papers.core_method: 先实证分析专家输出的稳定秩、熵有效秩和有效模态数远低于专家数，揭示结构化冗余；再将专家剪枝形式化为结构保持的专家子集选择，用贪心策略优化；提出PEEP（最大化加权投影能量以保持功能子空间）和DCEP（最小化加权覆盖误差以保持分布几何），均以路由器权重为先验融合全局结构与局部重要性。
innovation_points: 发现并量化MoE专家输出的结构化冗余，用稳定秩、熵有效秩和有效模态数刻画
将专家剪枝从独立打分排序重构为结构保持的专家子集选择问题，并用贪心策略高效求解
提出PEEP和DCEP两种互补方法，分别从功能子空间和分布几何角度保持专家间结构关系
引入路由器权重作为先验，联合考虑全局结构关系与个体专家局部重要性
experiment_results: 在DeepSeek-V2-Lite和Qwen3-30B-A3B上，75%和50%专家保留率下，多数基准优于现有最优基线
在通用任务和数学推理任务上均取得最佳平均性能
摘要未给出具体数值指标，仅报告相对排名结论
limitations: 实验仅覆盖DeepSeek-V2-Lite和Qwen3-30B-A3B两个MoE模型，泛化性证据有限
摘要未报告具体性能数值、内存节省量和推理加速比等量化结果
贪心策略虽高效，但未讨论其相对穷举搜索的近似最优性保证
papers.practical_value: 面向MoE大模型实际部署中专家全量存储带来的内存开销，提供结构保持的专家剪枝方案，可在保持通用与数学推理性能的同时降低专家保留率至50%-75%，对内存受限的推理部署具有直接工程价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作从专家输出结构化冗余这一新视角切入MoE剪枝，把剪枝从个体重要性排序提升为结构保持的子集选择，为MoE压缩提供了可解释且可扩展的框架，对关注MoE部署效率与模型压缩的研究者和工程师有参考价值。

papers.title: SACQ: Structure-Aware Codebook Quantization for Ultra-Low-Bit Vision-Language-Action Models
affiliations: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable capable robot behavior, but their large memory footprint limits deployment on resource-constrained robotic platforms. Weight quantization is a natural remedy, yet post-training quantization (PTQ) recipes inherited from large language models degrade when applied to VLAs at ultra-low precision. Existing low-bit PTQ methods often fail to explicitly account for the structure of downstream operations and allocate precision without considering its effect on the policy actions. We introduce SACQ, an ultra- low-bit weight-only vector-codebook quantization framework for VLAs. SACQ combines (1) structure-aware codebook fitting with role-specific quadratic metrics that reflect input statistics and downstream sensitivity; (2) action-aware mixed-bit allocation based on the increase in final-action error as individual layers are compressed; and (3) two-stage post-quantization refinement that reassigns codeword indices with second-order error compensation and calibrates codebooks and row-group scales against the decoded action. Using GR00T N1.7, SACQ achieves 93.85% average success across four LIBERO suites at 1.5 bits per language/action weight while reducing model memory by 4.83x. With INT8 activation quantization and low-precision attention, it retains 93.55% success while running 1.51x faster than BF16. On SimplER, SACQ further achieves 63.76% and 52.27% success under Visual Matching and Variant Aggregation at 2 bits per language/action weight, compared to 58.90% and 53.45% for BF16, respectively.
papers.summary: SACQ针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在资源受限机器人平台上部署时内存占用大的问题，提出超低位仅权重量化框架。作者指出，从大语言模型继承的训练后量化（PTQ）方法在VLA超低精度下会退化，且现有低比特PTQ未显式考虑下游算子结构，也未按对策略动作的影响分配精度。SACQ包含三部分：结构感知码本拟合，使用反映输入统计与下游敏感性的角色特定二次度量；基于逐层压缩引起最终动作误差增量的动作感知混合比特分配；两阶段量化后精炼，通过二阶误差补偿重排码字索引，并针对解码动作校准码本与行组缩放。在GR00T N1.7上，语言/动作权重1.5比特时LIBERO四个套件平均成功率93.85%，内存降低4.83倍；结合INT8激活量化与低精度注意力，保持93.55%成功率且比BF16快1.51倍。SimplER上2比特时Visual Matching和Variant Aggregation成功率分别为63.76%和52.27%，BF16为58.90%和53.45%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: SACQ通过结构感知码本、动作感知混合比特分配和两阶段精炼，在超低比特下显著压缩VLA模型内存并保持甚至提升任务成功率。
papers.core_method: 仅权重量化向量码本框架：结构感知码本拟合采用角色特定二次度量；动作感知混合比特分配依据逐层压缩导致的最终动作误差增量；两阶段量化后精炼包括二阶误差补偿的码字索引重排，以及针对解码动作的码本与行组缩放校准。
innovation_points: 提出结构感知码本拟合，用反映输入统计和下游敏感性的角色特定二次度量替代LLM继承的通用PTQ度量
设计动作感知混合比特分配，以逐层压缩对最终动作误差的影响为依据分配精度
引入两阶段量化后精炼，结合二阶误差补偿重排码字索引并校准码本与行组缩放
在VLA超低比特仅权重量化中同时考虑算子结构与策略动作敏感性
experiment_results: GR00T N1.7上语言/动作权重1.5比特时，LIBERO四个套件平均成功率93.85%，模型内存降低4.83倍
结合INT8激活量化和低精度注意力，保持93.55%成功率，运行速度比BF16快1.51倍
SimplER上2比特时Visual Matching成功率63.76%（BF16为58.90%），Variant Aggregation成功率52.27%（BF16为53.45%）
limitations: 摘要未说明在真实机器人硬件上的端到端部署延迟与能耗数据
实验主要基于GR00T N1.7和LIBERO/SimplER基准，未覆盖更多VLA架构或真实业务场景
Variant Aggregation任务上2比特成功率略低于BF16，说明部分任务存在精度回退
papers.practical_value: 为资源受限机器人平台部署VLA模型提供超低比特仅权重量化方案，在显著降低内存的同时保持任务成功率，并可与INT8激活量化结合获得实际推理加速，适合边缘机器人部署场景。
papers.why_it_matters: VLA模型内存瓶颈是机器人落地的关键障碍，而LLM继承的PTQ在超低比特下失效。SACQ从算子结构和动作敏感性出发重新设计量化流程，在1.5-2比特下取得有竞争力的成功率与内存收益，为VLA专用量化提供了可借鉴的技术路线。

papers.title: META-Robot: Self-Cognition and Capability Scaling in Agentic Robots
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
papers.abstract: LLM-based robotic agent systems can generate programs for robot control, yet their generalization to new tasks often depends on elaborate scaffolding. Expanding their skill repertoires alone offers limited guidance on how to assess new capabilities or identify what remains beyond their reach. We introduce META-Robot, a framework that couples self cognition with capability scaling by expanding the criteria through which an agent evaluates and develops its skills. At its core, action-level predicates make execution outcomes explicit and available for LLM reasoning. The agent uses these assessments to identify its own limitations, extend relevant evaluation criteria, and guide the structured expansion of its skills. Proprioceptive feedback further grounds this process in the robot's physical state, enriching the evidence available for self-cognition. Experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate stronger overall task performance, generalization to new tasks, continued expansion of skills and evaluation criteria, and effective use of non-visual proprioceptive signals.
papers.summary: META-Robot 关注基于 LLM 的机器人智能体在新任务上泛化依赖复杂脚手架、且单纯扩充技能库无法评估新能力边界的问题，提出将自我认知与能力扩展耦合的框架。其核心是用动作级谓词把执行结果显式化，供 LLM 推理；智能体据此识别自身局限、扩展相关评价标准，并结构化地扩展技能；本体感知反馈进一步把过程锚定在机器人物理状态上，丰富自我认知证据。摘要称在仿真与真实机器人上验证了整体任务表现更强、对新任务泛化、技能与评价标准持续扩展，以及有效利用非视觉本体感知信号；但未给出具体量化指标。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 用动作级谓词让机器人智能体显式评估执行结果，从而在自我认知驱动下持续扩展技能与评价标准。
papers.core_method: 以动作级谓词显式表达执行结果，供 LLM 推理；智能体基于这些评估识别自身能力边界，扩展评价标准并结构化扩展技能库；结合本体感知反馈将自我认知锚定于机器人物理状态。
innovation_points: 提出自我认知与能力扩展耦合的框架，而非仅扩充技能库
用动作级谓词把执行结果显式化，使 LLM 可推理自身成败与局限
让智能体自主扩展评价标准，形成技能与标准的持续共同扩展
引入本体感知等非视觉信号丰富自我认知证据
experiment_results: 摘要称仿真与真实机器人实验显示整体任务表现更强、对新任务泛化更好
摘要称技能与评价标准可持续扩展，并有效利用非视觉本体感知信号
未提供具体量化指标与基线对比数据
limitations: 摘要未给出量化结果与统计显著性，难以判断提升幅度
依赖动作级谓词的覆盖度，谓词设计可能影响自我认知质量
真实机器人实验规模与任务多样性在摘要中未说明
papers.practical_value: 为机器人智能体提供可自我评估、可持续扩展技能与评价标准的工程路径，减少对新任务手工脚手架依赖，并利用本体感知提升执行可靠性。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把机器人智能体的能力扩展从堆技能转向可评估的自我认知闭环，为 LLM 驱动机器人系统的泛化与持续学习提供可借鉴的框架思路。

papers.title: MolmoSpaces-CommonSense: Evaluating Commonsense in Robotic Manipulation Policies
papers.abstract: Real-world robotic manipulation requires reasoning about cluttered scenes, partially observable or hidden objects, and semantically appropriate actions, in addition to low-level execution within those scenes. However, existing simulation benchmarks primarily test the latter and remain dominated by comparatively clean environments with limited clutter and narrowly scoped task structure, leaving many forms of commonsense reasoning untested. We address this by introducing a taxonomy of reasoning processes for robotic manipulation grounded in developmental cognitive science. We operationalize this taxonomy through a new benchmark of robot tasks, MolmoSpaces-CommonSense, that requires reasoning about occlusion, containment, support relations, semantically correct grasp points, spatial affordances, and hidden objects. These evaluations require policies not only to recognize relevant scene structure but also to execute correct actions in them. We evaluate several zero-shot generalist manipulation policies. Across model types and architectures, we observe consistent failures in commonsense reasoning: success rates in cluttered scenes drop by over 50% as distractors increase, policies act on incorrect objects in cluttered settings 30% of the time, and affordance-sensitive grasping remains unreliable even with highly specific language prompts, with correct object part selection happening only about 50% of the time. Further, VLM-based success estimation struggles to reliably evaluate rollouts in these settings, suggesting that the challenge extends beyond control to the broader perception-reasoning-action stack. Our results suggest that existing benchmarks may substantially overestimate zero-shot real-world readiness. Code and policy leaderboard link at https://github.com/allenai/molmospaces.
papers.summary: 该论文针对现有机器人操作仿真基准主要测试低层执行、环境干净且任务结构狭窄的问题，提出一个基于发展认知科学的机器人操作推理分类法，并据此构建新基准 MolmoSpaces-CommonSense，要求策略推理遮挡、容器关系、支撑关系、语义正确抓取点、空间可供性与隐藏物体，同时执行正确动作。作者评估多种零样本通用操作策略，发现跨模型类型与架构存在一致的常识推理失败：干扰物增加时杂乱场景成功率下降超过50%，策略在杂乱环境中30%的时间作用于错误物体，即使语言提示高度具体，可供性敏感抓取仍不可靠，正确物体部件选择仅约50%；基于VLM的成功估计也难以可靠评估这些场景的 rollout。结果表明现有基准可能大幅高估零样本真实世界就绪度。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 现有机器人操作基准高估零样本真实世界能力，MolmoSpaces-CommonSense揭示通用策略在遮挡、支撑、可供性等常识推理上系统性失败。
papers.core_method: 作者从发展认知科学出发构建机器人操作推理分类法，覆盖遮挡、容器、支撑、语义抓取点、空间可供性与隐藏物体；据此在仿真中设计 MolmoSpaces-CommonSense 基准任务，要求策略识别场景结构并执行正确动作，并对多种零样本通用操作策略及基于VLM的成功估计器进行系统评测。
innovation_points: 提出基于发展认知科学的机器人操作常识推理分类法，将遮挡、容器、支撑、可供性等推理形式操作化。
构建 MolmoSpaces-CommonSense 仿真基准，任务同时要求场景结构识别与正确动作执行，弥补现有基准环境干净、任务狭窄的不足。
系统评测多种零样本通用操作策略，揭示跨架构一致的常识推理失败模式。
额外评估基于VLM的 rollout 成功估计，指出挑战超出控制层，延伸至感知-推理-动作全栈。
experiment_results: 干扰物增加时，杂乱场景成功率下降超过50%。
策略在杂乱环境中30%的时间作用于错误物体。
可供性敏感抓取中正确物体部件选择仅约50%，即使语言提示高度具体仍不可靠；VLM成功估计难以可靠评估这些 rollout。
limitations: 评测限于仿真基准，未提供真实机器人部署验证。
仅评估零样本通用策略，未涉及微调或专门训练后的表现。
基准任务覆盖的常识推理类型虽基于分类法，但仍可能未穷尽真实世界全部常识维度。
papers.practical_value: 为机器人操作策略提供更贴近真实杂乱场景的常识推理评测工具，帮助企业识别零样本通用策略在遮挡、支撑、可供性等工程约束下的失效点，避免被干净仿真基准的高分误导，指导数据采集、任务设计与策略选型。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作指出当前仿真基准可能大幅高估零样本真实世界就绪度，并给出可复现的评测基准与排行榜，对机器人操作策略的研发评估和落地决策具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: ResMerge: Residual Policy Learning and Merging for Continual Adaptation of Pre-trained Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Continual adaptation to new tasks is essential for robots deployed in the real world, but adapting pre-trained policies remains challenging due to parameter growth and the need for continual demonstration collection. Parameter-Efficient Continual Fine-Tuning (PECFT) isolates task-specific updates, but adapter-per-task designs require demonstrations and grow with the task set. We propose ResMerge, a two-stage framework that learns mergeable residual policies atop a frozen pre-trained policy: residual reinforcement learning (RL) acquires task-specific corrections without additional expert demonstrations during adaptation, and parameter-space merging consolidates compatible residuals to reduce stored parameters. We introduce Residual-Field Consistency (RFC), a simple, bounded, and interpretable metric that assesses compatibility in residual action-field space by comparing correction direction and magnitude. Experiments on LIBERO across two backbones and on a real-world Franka robot show improved continual learning performance over strong PECFT baselines, while selective merging reduces the residual-parameter footprint. Project website: https://resmerge.github.io/.
papers.summary: ResMerge面向预训练机器人策略的持续适配问题：现有参数高效持续微调（PECFT）为每个任务单独训练适配器，既需要持续采集专家示范，又随任务数增长而膨胀参数。作者提出两阶段框架：先在冻结的预训练策略之上，用残差强化学习（RL）在适配阶段无需额外专家示范即可获得任务特定的动作修正；再通过参数空间合并，把兼容的残差策略整合起来以减少存储参数。为判断残差能否合并，作者提出残差场一致性（RFC）指标，在残差动作场空间中比较修正方向与幅度，具有有界、可解释的特点。实验在LIBERO的两个骨干网络以及真实Franka机器人上进行，结果显示持续学习性能优于强PECFT基线，且选择性合并降低了残差参数占用。
papers.one_line_takeaway: ResMerge用残差强化学习替代示范采集、用残差场一致性指导参数合并，在冻结预训练策略上实现低参数增长的持续适配。
papers.core_method: 冻结预训练机器人策略，在其输出上叠加可学习的残差策略；适配阶段用残差RL优化任务特定修正，避免额外专家示范；随后依据残差场一致性（RFC）指标衡量不同残差在动作场中的方向与幅度兼容性，对兼容残差做参数空间合并，减少每任务参数存储。
innovation_points: 将残差强化学习用于预训练机器人策略的持续适配，适配阶段不依赖新增专家示范
提出残差场一致性（RFC）指标，以有界、可解释的方式度量残差动作场的兼容性
用参数空间合并整合兼容残差，替代adapter-per-task的线性参数增长模式
在仿真多骨干与真实Franka机器人上验证持续学习性能与参数占用优势
experiment_results: 在LIBERO上跨两个骨干网络，持续学习性能优于强PECFT基线
在真实Franka机器人上验证了方法有效性
选择性合并降低了残差参数占用；具体数值未在给定材料中提供
limitations: RFC仅比较修正方向与幅度，对残差兼容性的刻画可能有限
合并依赖残差间兼容性，任务间冲突较强时选择性合并的收益与适用范围待验证
给定材料未提供参数量、成功率等定量细节，难以评估相对提升幅度
papers.practical_value: 面向真实部署机器人，方法减少持续适配中对新任务专家示范的依赖，并通过合并控制每任务参数增长，降低存储与维护成本，适合任务序列不断扩展的线上场景。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把持续适配的两个工程痛点——示范采集成本与参数膨胀——放在同一框架中处理，并给出可解释的合并判据，为预训练机器人策略的低成本持续进化提供了可复用思路。

papers.title: Sensorium: An Open-Source Multimodal Data Collection and Curation Library for Embodied Surgical AI
affiliations: Bundesministerium für Forschung, Technologie und Raumfahrt
papers.abstract: Embodied surgical AI requires reliable multimodal data, yet surgical data collection remains costly, difficult to repeat, and strongly dependent on the hardware setup. We present Sensorium, an open-source Python library for recording, processing, annotating, and curating multimodal surgical data from configurable robot and sensor streams using the Robot Operating System (ROS) and ROS2 middleware. The library combines operator-facing data acquisition, configurable processing, semantic annotation, and episodic dataset generation. We evaluate Sensorium across 1516 recordings of phantom, ex vivo, and in vivo porcine experiments involving multiple surgical tasks and sensing configurations, and report preliminary usability feedback.
papers.summary: Sensorium 面向具身手术 AI 的多模态数据采集与整理难题，指出现有手术数据采集成本高、难以复现且强依赖硬件配置。作者提出开源 Python 库，基于 ROS/ROS2 中间件，从可配置的机器人与传感器流中完成记录、处理、语义标注和按 episode 生成数据集，将面向操作者的采集、可配置处理、语义标注与数据集生成整合为一体。在 1516 次体模、离体与活体猪实验（涵盖多种手术任务与传感配置）上评估了该库，并报告初步可用性反馈。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Sensorium 用开源 ROS/ROS2 工具链把手术多模态数据采集、标注与 episode 数据集生成标准化，降低硬件依赖与复现成本。
papers.core_method: 基于 ROS/ROS2 中间件的开源 Python 库，提供面向操作者的数据采集界面、可配置的数据处理管线、语义标注模块和按 episode 组织的数据集生成流程，支持从可配置机器人与传感器流中记录并整理多模态手术数据。
innovation_points: 将采集、处理、语义标注与 episode 数据集生成整合为统一开源工具链
基于 ROS/ROS2 实现硬件可配置，降低对特定采集装置的强依赖
面向具身手术 AI 的多模态数据整理，强调可重复性与数据策展
experiment_results: 在 1516 次体模、离体与活体猪实验上评估，覆盖多种手术任务与传感配置
报告了初步可用性反馈；摘要未给出量化性能指标
limitations: 评估以可用性反馈为主，缺少量化数据质量或下游任务性能指标
摘要未说明对非 ROS 硬件或临床真实环境的适配程度
papers.practical_value: 为手术机器人与具身 AI 研究团队提供可复用的开源数据采集与策展基础设施，减少重复搭建采集系统的工作量，提升多模态手术数据集的规范性与可复现性。
papers.why_it_matters: 具身手术 AI 的数据瓶颈在采集与策展而非模型本身；该工作提供了工程化、开源且硬件可配置的数据基础设施，值得关注数据管线标准化与可复现性的研究者阅读。

papers.title: When the Simulator Fails, Not the Policy: Auditing Contact Artifacts in Simulated Robot Benchmarks
affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
papers.abstract: Simulation benchmarks score robot policies by success rate, and every failed episode counts against the policy. Many of these failures are the simulator's fault, not the policy's; we find the cause and fix it. Testing a vision language action model and a world action model in simulation, we find that the policy often places the object and the simulator then ejects it, and that the benchmark's own scripted demonstrations fail the same way. We present SimuGuard, an auditing plugin for LIBERO, RoboTwin, RoboCasa and RoboDojo. It leaves the evaluation unchanged. At every physics step, it records the state and flags an object that starts moving at a contact faster than the robot's contact or gravity account for. It replays a recorded episode bit for bit, and it reruns the episode with one simulation parameter changed. With it we trace these episodes on RoboTwin to the collision detection of the physics engine: for geometry one to two centimeters apart, the engine reports a penetration of about two centimeters, and the solver throws the object out at several meters per second. The cause is one constant: the distance algorithm discards triangles below a fixed area threshold, which valid triangles fall below at the centimeter scale. With that constant changed and nothing else, episodes with an artifact fall from 12 in 100 to none, and the success rate on five container tasks rises from 89% to 98%. Success rates in simulation thus count failures that the simulator causes. Benchmarks on PhysX 5.3.1 or earlier should rerun in a repaired engine. Where the engine cannot change, they should report the success rate together with the range it spans when every flagged episode fails or passes: 75.8% to 98.5% around a reported 83.1% for LingBot-VA.
papers.summary: 该论文研究模拟机器人基准中因物理引擎接触伪影导致的策略失败误判问题。作者在LIBERO、RoboTwin、RoboCasa和RoboDojo上测试视觉语言动作模型与世界动作模型，发现策略放置物体后模拟器将其弹飞，且基准自带脚本演示同样失败，说明失败源于模拟器而非策略。为此提出SimuGuard审计插件，在不改变评测的前提下逐步记录状态，标记接触瞬间速度超出机器人与重力解释范围的物体，支持逐位重放与单参数重跑。在RoboTwin上定位到物理引擎碰撞检测：几何间距1至2厘米时引擎报告约2厘米穿透，求解器以数米每秒弹出物体，根因是距离算法丢弃低于固定面积阈值的三角形。仅修改该常量后，含伪影回合从每100次12次降至0，五个容器任务成功率从89%升至98%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 模拟基准中的部分失败由物理引擎接触伪影造成而非策略缺陷，修复引擎常量即可显著提升成功率。
papers.core_method: 提出SimuGuard审计插件，在LIBERO、RoboTwin、RoboCasa和RoboDojo的每个物理步记录状态，标记接触瞬间速度无法由机器人接触或重力解释的物体，并支持逐位重放与单参数重跑以定位根因；最终追溯到物理引擎距离算法中丢弃小面积三角形的固定阈值常量。
innovation_points: 将模拟失败归因从策略转向模拟器，提出可审计的接触伪影检测机制
设计不改变评测流程的插件式审计工具，支持逐位重放与单参数对照重跑
定位到物理引擎距离算法中固定面积阈值这一具体根因，并验证仅改该常量即可消除伪影
提出在引擎不可修复时报告成功率区间而非单点值的评测建议
experiment_results: 在RoboTwin上，几何间距1至2厘米时引擎报告约2厘米穿透，求解器以数米每秒弹出物体
仅修改面积阈值常量后，含伪影回合从每100次12次降至0
五个容器任务成功率从89%升至98%；LingBot-VA报告83.1%的成功率对应区间为75.8%至98.5%
limitations: 根因定位与修复验证主要集中在RoboTwin和特定物理引擎版本，其他基准的覆盖程度未充分说明
审计依赖逐步状态记录与重放，可能带来额外计算与存储开销
成功率区间报告方法仅在LingBot-VA上给出示例，通用性仍需更多验证
papers.practical_value: 为机器人模拟基准提供可插拔的审计工具，帮助研究者和工程团队区分策略失败与模拟器伪影，避免因引擎缺陷低估策略性能；同时给出引擎修复与区间报告两种可操作的评测改进路径，对依赖模拟评测的机器人学习流水线具有直接工程价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 模拟基准的成功率常被直接当作策略能力指标，该工作揭示其中混入模拟器自身造成的失败，并给出可复现的审计与修复方法，提醒社区在PhysX 5.3.1或更早版本上重跑评测或报告成功率区间，对评测可信度有重要影响。

papers.title: CalVLA: Shaping Native Confidence in Vision-Language-Action Policies with Outcome Supervision
papers.abstract: Can a vision-language-action (VLA) policy signal likely task failure from its own action probabilities? We introduce CalVLA, which shapes native action-token confidence using successful and failed rollouts and an Action-Confidence Alignment (ACal) squared margin-ranking loss. Low-rank adapters update OpenVLA-7B without an auxiliary failure detector. Observations are paired within tasks at similar normalized elapsed times, not necessarily equivalent physical progress. On a held-out test split from 500 LIBERO-10 configurations, adapted confidence achieves a joint failure-discrimination AUROC of $0.7392\pm0.0480$ over three seeds, averaging scores at 130 and 260 steps. Frozen-policy probes reach 0.6146--0.6436, but superiority over the linear probe is statistically inconclusive. For the same confidence summary, AUROC rises from 0.4485 before adaptation to 0.7327 after adaptation. Mean task success decreases from 58% to 55%. These results show improved failure discrimination, not improved control or established safety benefits.
papers.summary: 本文研究视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略能否仅凭自身动作概率信号预判任务失败，提出CalVLA：利用成功与失败轨迹，通过动作置信度对齐（ACal）平方边际排序损失，对OpenVLA-7B的原生动作token置信度进行校准，仅用低秩适配器更新，无需额外失败检测器。观测在同一任务内按相近归一化已用时间配对，而非物理进度等价。在LIBERO-10的500个配置留出测试集上，三随机种子下联合失败判别AUROC为0.7392±0.0480（130与260步平均）；冻结策略探针为0.6146–0.6436，但优于线性探针在统计上不显著；同一置信度汇总下AUROC由适配前0.4485升至0.7327，平均任务成功率由58%降至55%。结果表明失败判别改善，而非控制性能或安全收益提升。
papers.one_line_takeaway: CalVLA用结果监督校准VLA原生动作置信度，显著提升失败判别AUROC，但未提升控制成功率，也不构成安全保证。
papers.core_method: 以OpenVLA-7B为基座，冻结主干并注入低秩适配器；用成功/失败rollout构造监督信号，采用ACal平方边际排序损失拉大成功与失败动作token置信度差距；样本在同一任务内按相近归一化已用时间配对，推理时直接读取原生动作置信度作为失败判别分数，不引入辅助检测器。
innovation_points: 将失败预判转化为对VLA原生动作token置信度的结果监督校准，避免额外失败检测器
提出ACal平方边际排序损失，并采用任务内相近归一化时间配对构造正负样本
仅用低秩适配器微调OpenVLA-7B，保持基座参数不变，工程成本较低
experiment_results: LIBERO-10留出测试集三随机种子联合失败判别AUROC为0.7392±0.0480（130与260步平均）
同一置信度汇总下AUROC由适配前0.4485升至适配后0.7327
平均任务成功率由58%降至55%；冻结策略探针AUROC为0.6146–0.6436，但优于线性探针统计不显著
limitations: 仅验证失败判别能力，未证明控制性能或安全收益提升
成功率由58%降至55%，校准带来控制代价
与线性探针相比优势统计不显著，且配对基于归一化时间而非物理进度等价
papers.practical_value: 为VLA策略提供一种低成本、无需额外检测器的在线失败预警信号，可用于机器人任务中的提前中止、人工接管或数据回流筛选；但部署前需评估成功率下降与判别阈值校准问题。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把VLA的置信度校准与结果监督结合，指出原生动作概率可作为失败判别信号，同时诚实报告控制代价与统计不显著之处，对具身智能可靠性与工程落地有参考价值。

papers.title: OmniPiano: Diverse Dexterous Piano-Playing Challenges for Standard, Robust, Safe, and Multi-Agent RL
papers.abstract: Dexterous robotic manipulation remains a major challenge in robotics, exemplified by piano playing, which requires coordinated control of fingers and provides a demanding testbed for reinforcement learning (RL). Although previous work established a benchmark for robotic piano playing, it is restricted to two hands and does not support unified evaluation. To address this gap, we introduce OmniPiano, a benchmark that provides one to up to five Shadow Hands and supports standard, robust, safe, and multi-agent RL within a shared piano-playing task family. OmniPiano is developed for scalable and diverse piano-playing tasks with configurable perturbations, explicit safety constraints, and decentralized cooperation settings. Particularly, to facilitate usability and extendability, OmniPiano adopts a highly modular design and provides comprehensive tasks to support RL study of task performance, robustness, safety, and cooperation in dexterous control. With at least 912 task settings and 36 baseline algorithms, OmniPiano further incorporates LLM-based agents to broaden the evaluation scope and reveal new insights. Extensive evaluations show that state-of-the-art RL algorithms and frontier LLM-based agents still struggle on challenging piano-playing tasks, even under standard RL settings, highlighting substantial room for improvement in dexterous control. The code, dataset, tutorial, and demo are available at https://sail-research-lab.github.io/omnipiano/.
papers.summary: OmniPiano 针对灵巧机器人操作中钢琴演奏这一高难度测试场景，指出现有基准仅限双手且缺乏统一评估的问题，提出一个支持1至5只Shadow Hand、覆盖标准、鲁棒、安全与多智能体强化学习的统一基准。该基准通过可配置扰动、显式安全约束与去中心化协作设置，构建可扩展的多样化钢琴任务族，并采用高度模块化设计以提升可用性与可扩展性。基准包含至少912种任务设置与36个基线算法，同时引入基于LLM的智能体以拓宽评估范围。大量评估显示，即使标准RL设定下，先进RL算法与前沿LLM智能体在挑战性钢琴任务上仍表现不佳，表明灵巧控制仍有显著提升空间。
papers.one_line_takeaway: OmniPiano 将钢琴演奏扩展为支持1至5只手、覆盖标准/鲁棒/安全/多智能体RL的统一灵巧操作基准，并揭示现有RL与LLM智能体仍难以胜任。
papers.core_method: 构建统一钢琴演奏任务族，支持1至5只Shadow Hand；通过可配置扰动、显式安全约束和去中心化协作设置，将标准、鲁棒、安全与多智能体RL纳入同一基准；采用模块化设计提供至少912种任务设置和36个基线算法，并引入LLM智能体扩展评估。
innovation_points: 将钢琴演奏基准从双手扩展到1至5只Shadow Hand，支持更丰富的灵巧控制与协作场景。
在统一任务族中同时覆盖标准、鲁棒、安全与多智能体RL评估，并提供可配置扰动与显式安全约束。
提供至少912种任务设置与36个基线算法，并引入LLM智能体拓宽评估范围。
采用高度模块化设计，提升基准的可用性与可扩展性。
experiment_results: 摘要称大量评估显示先进RL算法与前沿LLM智能体在挑战性钢琴任务上仍表现不佳，即使标准RL设定下也是如此；未给出具体性能数值。
基准包含至少912种任务设置与36个基线算法，但摘要未报告各算法的具体得分或排名。
引入LLM智能体进行评估并揭示新见解，但摘要未提供其具体量化结果。
limitations: 摘要未给出具体实验数值，难以量化现有算法与LLM智能体的性能差距。
基准基于Shadow Hand与钢琴演奏场景，向其他灵巧操作任务的泛化性尚未在摘要中说明。
多智能体与安全约束下的评估细节及任务覆盖范围在摘要中未充分展开。
papers.practical_value: 为灵巧机器人操作研究提供统一、可扩展的强化学习基准，覆盖标准、鲁棒、安全与多智能体协作四类评估需求，便于比较不同RL算法与LLM智能体在复杂协调控制任务上的表现，并推动安全约束与去中心化协作场景下的可复现研究。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作将钢琴演奏从双手基准扩展为多手、多范式统一评估平台，填补了灵巧控制中标准、鲁棒、安全与多智能体RL缺乏统一基准的空白，并通过LLM智能体评估揭示现有方法的不足，为后续研究提供可扩展的测试基础。

papers.title: Human-Centered Vision-Language-Action Models for Collaborative Robotics: Biosignals, Human-State Estimation, and Shared Autonomy — A Systematic Review
papers.abstract: This systematic review will identify, classify, and synthesise research on foundation-model-based robot systems (vision-language-action, vision-language, and large language models) that collaborate with a human partner in physical tasks, with particular attention to human-centered sensing such as surface electromyography and inertial sensing. Two pre-specified search streams are used: a core stream on foundation-model systems in human–robot collaboration, and an adjacent stream on biosignal-informed human-state estimation for physical collaboration. Sources are Scopus, Web of Science Core Collection, IEEE Xplore, and arXiv (core stream only), covering 2015–2026. Screening follows PRISMA 2020 with two independent reviewers, and results are synthesised narratively following the SWiM guideline. The full protocol (v1.2), including validated search strings and pilot results, is attached.
papers.summary: 本文是一篇系统综述研究方案（protocol），而非已完成的实证研究。其研究问题是：如何识别、分类并综合基于基础模型（视觉-语言-动作模型、视觉-语言模型与大型语言模型）的人机协作机器人系统研究，并特别关注以人为中心的感知信号（如表面肌电与惯性传感）如何用于人类状态估计与共享自主。技术路线采用两条预定义检索流：核心流聚焦人机协作中的基础模型系统，邻近流聚焦面向物理协作的生物信号驱动人类状态估计；数据源为Scopus、Web of Science核心合集、IEEE Xplore及arXiv（仅核心流），时间跨度2015–2026年；筛选遵循PRISMA 2020并由两名评审独立完成，综合采用SWiM指南的叙述性方法。当前材料仅提供方案v1.2、检索式与试点结果，尚无纳入研究数量或综合结论。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 这是一份面向基础模型人机协作与生物信号人类状态估计的系统综述方案，尚处协议阶段、无综合结果。
papers.core_method: 遵循PRISMA 2020的系统综述协议：两条预定义检索流（基础模型人机协作核心流、生物信号人类状态估计邻近流），覆盖Scopus、Web of Science核心合集、IEEE Xplore与arXiv，双人独立筛选，按SWiM指南进行叙述性综合。
innovation_points: 将视觉-语言-动作等基础模型系统与生物信号（sEMG、惯性）驱动的人类状态估计两条文献流并置综合
以人为中心感知与共享自主作为人机协作基础模型研究的组织视角
采用PRISMA 2020与SWiM双重规范，并公开含验证检索式与试点结果的完整协议v1.2
experiment_results: 材料为研究方案，未报告任何实证或综合结果数据；仅提及协议含试点结果，但未给出具体数值
limitations: 仅为综述协议，尚无纳入研究、分类结果或综合结论
arXiv仅用于核心流，可能造成邻近流文献覆盖偏差
叙述性综合（SWiM）不做定量元分析，结论强度受限
papers.practical_value: 为研究者和工程团队提供可复用的检索与筛选框架，用于梳理基础模型驱动机器人协作中的人类状态感知与共享自主设计空间，并支撑后续证据整合。
papers.why_it_matters: 基础模型进入物理协作场景时，人类状态感知与共享自主是关键但分散的研究方向；该协议给出了系统化梳理这两条文献流的规范路径，值得关注其后续综合结果。

papers.title: Design and Development of an AI-Based Voice-Controlled Robot for Intelligent Human-Robot Interaction
papers.abstract: Most low-cost voice-controlled robots accept only a handful of fixed words such as “forward” and “stop”, and depend on a smartphone app for speech recognition. This paper presents the design and development of an AI-based voice-controlled mobile robot that holds natural spoken conversations and turns free-form requests into safe movements. The robot is built around an ESP32 microcontroller with an INMP441 I²S MEMS microphone, a MAX98357A I²S class-D amplifier and speaker, an L298N dual H-bridge driving two DC gear motors with wheels, a servo for head and gesture movements, and a 2S pack of 18650 lithium-ion cells with a main switch.
