limitations: 最高成功率仅44%，距离可靠实际部署仍有明显差距
评测仅覆盖LIBERO-10单一基准与固定工具调用接口，结论泛化性有待验证
未报告推理成本的具体量化数据，推理强度与性能的权衡缺乏细粒度分析
papers.practical_value: 为评估通用大模型直接驱动机器人的可行性提供了可复现的标准化框架与基线结果，帮助企业判断在何种任务类型上可尝试免微调的模型直控方案，并提示推理成本与成功率之间的工程权衡。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作将“推理到行动”的转化问题置于标准化机器人基准上量化检验，明确指出通用模型在物理操作中的能力边界与任务不均衡性，为后续基于推理的机器人操作研究提供了可复现的评测基础。

papers.title: AGQ: Action-Guided Ultra-Low-Bit Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to perform tasks specified through natural-language instructions, but their large weight footprint challenges deployment on memory-constrained onboard platforms. Ultra-low-bit quantization reduces this footprint, yet preserving task performance and controlling weight recovery costs remain challenging. We propose Action-Guided Quantization, which combines action sensitivity with a measured proxy for weight recovery cost to allocate matrix bitwidths under storage budgets. Per-channel calibration compensates for quantization error, while a uniform bitwidth within each matrix preserves regular layouts. Bit-dependent grouped lossless coding reduces resident weight storage, and block-wise recovery limits temporary buffers. On LIBERO, AGQ achieves 92.7% task success at W3, exceeding AWQ and GPTQ by 1.2 and 3.7 percentage points, respectively, and retains 70.5% success at W2.5. An asymmetric configuration, denoted W1.5$^{*}$, uses W4 vision weights and a parameter-weighted average of 1.5 bits for language weights. With lossless coding, it achieves $6.10\times$ complete-model compression relative to BF16 while retaining 25.5% task success. Code and experimental results are available at https://github.com/Qiuxu00/AGQ
papers.summary: 该论文针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型权重规模大、难以部署在内存受限的机载平台的问题，提出动作引导量化（AGQ）。AGQ结合动作敏感性与权重恢复代价的实测代理，在存储预算下为各矩阵分配位宽；采用逐通道校准补偿量化误差，并保持每个矩阵内位宽统一以维持规则布局；引入位宽相关的分组无损编码降低常驻权重存储，块级恢复限制临时缓冲区。在LIBERO上，W3位宽下任务成功率达92.7%，分别超过AWQ和GPTQ 1.2和3.7个百分点；W2.5下仍保持70.5%成功率。非对称配置W1.5*（视觉权重W4、语言权重参数加权平均1.5位）结合无损编码实现相对BF16的6.10倍整模型压缩，保留25.5%任务成功率。
papers.one_line_takeaway: AGQ通过动作敏感性与恢复代价引导的混合位宽分配及无损编码，在超低位宽下显著压缩VLA模型并尽量保留任务成功率。
papers.core_method: 以动作敏感性结合权重恢复代价的实测代理，在存储预算约束下为各权重矩阵分配位宽；逐通道校准补偿量化误差，矩阵内统一位宽保持规则布局；位宽相关的分组无损编码降低常驻存储，块级恢复限制临时缓冲区。
innovation_points: 将动作敏感性与权重恢复代价的实测代理结合，用于VLA模型矩阵级位宽分配
在超低位宽量化中兼顾逐通道校准与矩阵内统一位宽的规则布局
引入位宽相关的分组无损编码与块级恢复，降低常驻存储和临时缓冲开销
提出非对称配置W1.5*，对视觉与语言权重采用不同位宽策略
experiment_results: LIBERO上W3位宽任务成功率达92.7%，分别超过AWQ和GPTQ 1.2和3.7个百分点
W2.5位宽下仍保持70.5%任务成功率
W1.5*配置结合无损编码实现相对BF16的6.10倍整模型压缩，保留25.5%任务成功率
limitations: 极低位宽W1.5*下任务成功率仅25.5%，性能下降明显
实验仅在LIBERO基准上验证，未提供其他机器人平台或真实机载部署结果
摘要未给出权重恢复代价代理的具体定义与消融分析
papers.practical_value: 为内存受限的机器人机载平台部署VLA模型提供超低位宽量化方案，在存储预算下按动作敏感性分配位宽，并利用无损编码与块级恢复控制存储和临时缓冲开销，具备工程落地参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: VLA模型部署受限于权重规模，AGQ在超低位宽下兼顾任务性能与存储开销，并给出可复现的压缩配置，对边缘机器人部署研究有直接参考意义。

papers.title: Multimodal Embodied Agents: A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use
papers.abstract: Multimodal agents (MMAs) sustain interaction through reasoning, memory, tools, and feedback, most visibly as computer-use agents, while robotic systems (RSs) couple sensing and actuation under physical dynamics. We define multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs) as goal-directed systems that couple multimodal task reasoning with physical action and revise decisions from the resulting feedback. This raises a central question: what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use? We introduce PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions: Perceive the current state, Anticipate action effects, Plan a feasible course, Act through an interface or body, and Verify the outcome. Defined by function rather than architecture, these capabilities let PAPAV identify what all three share and then compare MMEAs with MMAs and with RSs. Five physical constraints, from partial observability to unverifiable outcomes, leave fewer choices fixed in advance and less room to reverse errors. Across 64 benchmarks, explicit evaluation centers on Act; only 5 assess Anticipate and 3 assess Verify, leaving both largely hidden behind task success. These constraints also frame the open challenges we identify. PAPAV therefore provides a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and measuring progress across all five capabilities rather than task success alone.
papers.summary: 该论文提出以能力为中心的PAPAV框架，将多模态具身智能体（MMEA）定义为耦合多模态任务推理与物理动作、并能依据反馈修正决策的目标导向系统，包含感知状态、预判动作效果、规划可行路径、通过接口或本体执行、验证结果五项功能。作者据此比较计算机使用智能体与机器人系统，指出从计算机使用转向机器人使用时，部分可观测性等五项物理约束使可预先固定的选择更少、纠错空间更小。在64个基准上，显式评估集中于执行，仅5个评估预判、3个评估验证，二者多被任务成功率掩盖。
papers.one_line_takeaway: PAPAV以五项能力而非架构统一刻画具身智能体，揭示从计算机使用到机器人使用时预判与验证能力被任务成功率掩盖的评测缺口。
papers.core_method: 提出PAPAV能力中心框架，按功能而非架构定义感知、预判、规划、执行、验证五项反复出现的功能，用其识别多模态智能体与机器人系统的共性并比较二者差异；结合五项物理约束分析选择空间与纠错空间的变化，并据此梳理开放挑战。
innovation_points: 以功能而非架构统一刻画多模态具身智能体，避免按系统形态割裂比较
提出PAPAV五项能力框架，覆盖感知、预判、规划、执行与验证
系统比较计算机使用智能体与机器人系统，归纳五项物理约束对决策自由度与纠错能力的影响
基于64个基准统计各能力被显式评估的程度，指出预判与验证的评测缺口
experiment_results: 对64个基准的统计显示，显式评估集中于执行能力，仅5个评估预判、3个评估验证
论文未报告新的模型训练或性能对比数据，主要为框架分析与基准统计
limitations: 作为框架性综述，未提供新模型或新实验验证PAPAV各能力的可测性
基准统计仅反映显式评估分布，未量化预判与验证能力对任务成功率的实际贡献
五项物理约束与能力之间的映射关系仍以定性分析为主
papers.practical_value: 为设计可靠的物理智能体提供共同能力基座，指导企业与研究团队在任务成功率之外，分别度量感知、预判、规划、执行与验证能力，尤其补足预判与验证的评测盲区。
papers.why_it_matters: 该文指出具身智能评测过度聚焦执行、忽视预判与验证，为从计算机使用走向机器人使用的智能体研究提供了统一的能力语言与评测改进方向。

papers.title: TARSphere: A Robot-Oriented Full-Stack Framework for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents in Evolving Physical and Social Environments
papers.abstract: Robots must act under physical and social constraints while adapting to changes in their environment and human needs. Existing embodied-agent systems often focus on specified goals or abstract execution into symbolic actions, limiting evaluation in an evolving world. We introduce TARSphere, a robot-oriented full-stack framework for physically and socially grounded long-horizon embodied agents. TARSphere-Infra runs robot policies in a physics simulator with embodied NPCs and constrained dialogue. An event-driven finite-state machine (FSM) uses completed actions and delivered information to update task states and evaluate outcomes. TARSphere-Harness, its embodied brain harness, lets a frozen multimodal large language model (MLLM) act through multi-level executable skills, using observations, hierarchical memory, and execution feedback to revise its decisions. On this foundation, agent-in-the-loop curation aligns task semantics, causal dependencies, and scene geometry to construct TARSphere-Bench: 360 episodes across 30 indoor scenes. Five paired conditions assess perceptual robustness, disruption adaptation, task update, human coordination, and intent understanding for navigate-and-report and fetch-and-deliver tasks. Our evaluation of 8 MLLMs shows that general-purpose models can outperform embodied models, while task updates and human interaction remain difficult. Frequent collisions and falls further motivate evaluating execution safety alongside task success, even with a shared action interface and decision budget.
papers.summary: TARSphere 面向物理与社会约束下、环境与人类需求持续变化的长时程具身智能体，提出机器人导向的全栈框架。其基础设施 TARSphere-Infra 在物理模拟器中运行机器人策略，并引入具身 NPC 与受限对话；事件驱动有限状态机依据已完成动作与已传递信息更新任务状态并评估结果。TARSphere-Harness 作为具身大脑外壳，让冻结的多模态大模型通过多级可执行技能行动，结合观测、分层记忆与执行反馈修正决策。在此基础上以 agent-in-the-loop 方式对齐任务语义、因果依赖与场景几何，构建含 30 个室内场景、360 个回合的 TARSphere-Bench，用五组配对条件考察感知鲁棒性、扰动适应、任务更新、人类协作与意图理解。对 8 个 MLLM 的评测显示通用模型可优于具身模型，任务更新与人机交互仍困难，频繁碰撞与跌倒表明需在任务成功之外评估执行安全。
papers.one_line_takeaway: TARSphere 用物理与社会双重约束的全栈评测揭示：冻结 MLLM 在长时程具身任务中任务更新与人机协作仍是短板，执行安全须与成功率并重。
papers.core_method: 构建机器人导向全栈框架：TARSphere-Infra 在物理模拟器中运行机器人策略，含具身 NPC 与受限对话，并用事件驱动有限状态机根据已完成动作和已传递信息更新任务状态、评估结果；TARSphere-Harness 让冻结 MLLM 通过多级可执行技能行动，依赖观测、分层记忆与执行反馈修正决策；以 agent-in-the-loop 方式对齐任务语义、因果依赖与场景几何，构建 30 个室内场景、360 个回合的 TARSphere-Bench，设置五组配对条件覆盖感知鲁棒性、扰动适应、任务更新、人类协作与意图理解。
innovation_points: 提出物理与社会双重约束下的长时程具身智能体全栈框架，将模拟基础设施、智能体外壳与基准构建统一。
用事件驱动有限状态机以已完成动作和已传递信息驱动任务状态更新与结果评估，支持动态任务语义。
TARSphere-Harness 使冻结 MLLM 通过多级可执行技能、分层记忆与执行反馈闭环行动，无需微调基座。
以 agent-in-the-loop 方式对齐任务语义、因果依赖与场景几何，构建含五组配对条件的 360 回合基准。
experiment_results: 评测 8 个 MLLM，发现通用模型可优于具身模型。
任务更新与人机交互仍是主要难点。
频繁碰撞与跌倒表明需在任务成功之外评估执行安全；材料未给出具体数值指标。
limitations: 评测基于物理模拟器与具身 NPC，未涉及真实机器人部署验证。
基准规模为 30 个室内场景、360 个回合，场景与任务类型覆盖有限。
材料未报告具体量化指标，难以判断各条件间的效应大小。
papers.practical_value: 为机器人长时程任务提供可复用的模拟基础设施、冻结 MLLM 智能体外壳与配对条件基准，便于在部署前系统评估感知鲁棒性、扰动适应、任务更新、人机协作与执行安全，降低真实场景试错成本。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把长时程具身智能体的评测从静态指定目标推进到物理与社会约束下持续变化的世界，并明确将执行安全纳入评估，为 MLLM 驱动机器人系统的能力边界与工程风险提供可比较的参照。

papers.title: VoxProg: 3D Spatial Reasoning through Voxel Programming
papers.abstract: Language models' abilities to interpret tasks and generate programs offer a promising basis for 3D spatial reasoning. Yet following spatial instructions in 3D scenes requires programs to construct geometric references that language leaves implicit. In this work, we introduce VoxProg, which formulates 3D object placement through voxel programming: a language model translates task interpretations into executable programs over local voxel views of scene surfaces. Because these views index surface geometry on regular grids with explicit coordinates and neighborhood relations, an evidence program can isolate task-relevant regions and boundaries directly from scene meshes, and a downstream pose program can measure the resulting geometry to compute a target $SE(3)$ pose. Visual and numerical feedback from execution lets the model inspect intermediate selections and candidate placements to iteratively revise its code. To evaluate open-ended placement across functional use, geometric fit, and contextual arrangements, we introduce the 71-task VoxProg-Bench benchmark along with an evaluation suite pairing perceptual Intent Alignment and 3D Physical Validity. Across VoxProg-Bench and external benchmarks, VoxProg consistently outperforms relation-based, keypoint-based, and mesh-based baselines.
papers.summary: VoxProg 研究如何让语言模型在三维场景中执行空间指令并完成开放式的物体摆放。其核心问题是：语言对空间关系的描述往往隐含几何约束，模型需要自行构造显式的几何参照。为此，作者提出体素编程（voxel programming）范式：语言模型将任务解释转化为可执行程序，在场景表面的局部体素视图上操作。由于体素视图以规则网格和显式坐标、邻域关系索引表面几何，证据程序可直接从场景网格中隔离任务相关区域与边界，位姿程序再对所得几何进行测量，计算出目标 SE(3) 位姿。执行产生的视觉与数值反馈使模型能检查中间选择与候选摆放，并迭代修正代码。为评估功能可用性、几何契合与上下文布局等开放式摆放，作者构建了 71 项任务的 VoxProg-Bench 及配套评测套件，包含感知意图对齐与三维物理有效性两项指标。在 VoxProg-Bench 与外部基准上，VoxProg 一致优于基于关系、关键点和网格的基线方法。
papers.one_line_takeaway: VoxProg 用体素空间上的可执行程序作为语言模型与三维几何之间的中间表示，借助执行反馈迭代修正，实现可解释且可验证的三维物体摆放。
papers.core_method: 将三维物体摆放形式化为体素编程：语言模型把空间指令翻译为在局部体素视图上运行的程序；体素视图以规则网格、显式坐标和邻域关系索引场景表面几何。程序分为证据程序（从场景网格中隔离任务相关区域与边界）和位姿程序（测量几何并计算目标 SE(3) 位姿）。执行返回的视觉与数值反馈用于检查中间选择与候选摆放，并驱动代码迭代修正。
innovation_points: 提出体素编程范式，把语言中隐含的几何参照显式化为在体素视图上可执行的程序，而非直接回归位姿或依赖关系分类
设计证据程序与位姿程序的两阶段结构，分别负责区域/边界隔离与几何测量，使空间推理过程可检查、可修正
利用执行产生的视觉与数值反馈形成代码迭代闭环，让模型自我检视中间选择与候选摆放
构建 71 项任务的 VoxProg-Bench 及配套评测套件，覆盖功能使用、几何契合与上下文布局，并配对意图对齐与三维物理有效性指标
experiment_results: 在 VoxProg-Bench 与外部基准上，VoxProg 一致优于基于关系、关键点和网格的基线方法（摘要未给出具体数值）
摘要未提供消融实验、迭代修正增益或各指标的具体量化结果
limitations: 方法依赖局部体素视图与场景网格，体素化分辨率与局部视图范围对几何精度和计算开销的影响未在摘要中说明
评测集中于物体摆放任务，向更广泛三维空间推理任务的泛化性尚不明确
摘要未报告真实机器人平台或物理执行环境中的验证结果
papers.practical_value: 为具身智能与三维内容创作中的物体摆放提供可解释、可调试的中间表示：程序化输出便于定位错误与人工干预，执行反馈支持自动修正；体素视图上的几何测量直接产出 SE(3) 位姿，具备接入机器人操作或场景编辑流水线的潜力。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作把语言模型的空间推理从隐式端到端预测转向显式程序化几何构造，兼顾可解释性与可验证性；其基准与双指标评测套件也为开放式三维摆放任务提供了可复用的评估框架。

papers.title: UniWALM: Unified World Action Language Model for Embodied Robot Control
papers.abstract: Motivated by the human ability to integrate experience across language, perception, and action, we introduce UniWALM, a unified world-action-language model that learns video, action, and language in a single shared representation, where each modality is both a conditioning signal and a supervision target. We ask: can jointly generating language enrich this shared representation, improving manipulation and supporting memory-dependent behavior? Unlike prior approaches that attach a reasoning or vision-language model to a video-action backbone and run them as distinct stages, UniWALM unifies all three modalities inside a single mixture-of-transformers backbone whose per-modality diffusion heads co-denoise synchronously, decoding subtask and textual memory in the same pass as action with no separate planning stage; the generated language is re-consumed on the next step, closing a language-as-memory loop without an external planner or memory bank. To keep the action stream reliable under this richer objective, we further introduce Flow Matching with Correction (FMC), a training objective that teaches recovery from perturbed action trajectories at no inference-time cost. UniWALM consistently improves over same-backbone baselines (e.g., FastWAM) on compositional pick-and-place (MolmoSpaces) and across the memory-dependent subset of RMBench, where it reaches 34.5% without any pretrained language or reasoning model and exceeds Mem-0's keyframe-equipped setup (28.5%) using only a single anchor frame. On a real-world Find-the-Item task, generating textual memory lifts success from 11.1% to 61.1%, while state-of-the-art VLAs stay at or below chance (<=33.3%).
papers.summary: UniWALM 提出统一世界-动作-语言模型，将视频、动作与语言在单一共享表示中联合学习，每种模态既是条件信号也是监督目标。研究核心问题是：联合生成语言能否丰富共享表示，从而提升操作能力并支持依赖记忆的行为。与将推理或视觉语言模型外挂到视频-动作骨干的两阶段方案不同，UniWALM 在单一 mixture-of-transformers 骨干内统一三模态，各模态扩散头同步去噪，在同一次前向中解码子任务、文本记忆与动作，无需独立规划阶段；生成的语言在下一步被重新消费，形成语言即记忆的闭环。为在更丰富目标下保持动作流可靠，作者提出 Flow Matching with Correction（FMC），在不增加推理成本的前提下学习从扰动动作轨迹中恢复。实验显示其在组合式抓放与记忆依赖任务上优于同骨干基线，并在真实 Find-the-Item 任务中通过生成文本记忆显著提升成功率。
papers.one_line_takeaway: UniWALM 用单一混合 Transformer 骨干同步生成语言、动作与视频，把语言作为可复用的记忆闭环，在无外部规划器条件下提升记忆依赖操作任务。
papers.core_method: 构建统一世界-动作-语言模型：视频、动作、语言共享表示，各模态扩散头在 mixture-of-transformers 骨干内同步去噪，一次前向同时输出子任务文本、文本记忆与动作；生成语言在下一步作为条件重新输入，形成语言即记忆闭环；引入 Flow Matching with Correction 训练目标，使动作流在扰动轨迹下可恢复且不增加推理成本。
innovation_points: 三模态在单一骨干内同步去噪，语言生成与动作解码同 pass 完成，取消独立规划阶段与外部记忆库
生成的语言在下一步被重新消费，构成语言即记忆的闭环机制
Flow Matching with Correction 在不增加推理成本下提升动作流对扰动轨迹的恢复能力
不依赖预训练语言或推理模型即可支持记忆依赖行为
experiment_results: 在组合式抓放 MolmoSpaces 上持续优于同骨干基线 FastWAM
在 RMBench 记忆依赖子集达到 34.5%，超过配备关键帧的 Mem-0（28.5%），且仅用单锚点帧、无预训练语言或推理模型
真实 Find-the-Item 任务中生成文本记忆将成功率从 11.1% 提升至 61.1%，而先进 VLA 方法不超过 33.3%
limitations: 实验集中在抓放与记忆依赖操作任务，未覆盖更广泛的长程或开放世界场景
依赖视频、动作、语言联合训练，数据与算力需求可能较高，摘要未给出规模与效率分析
语言即记忆闭环的长期稳定性与错误累积未在给定材料中量化评估
papers.practical_value: 面向具身机器人在真实业务中的记忆依赖操作（如找物、多步抓放），UniWALM 以单骨干同步生成语言与动作，省去外挂规划器与记忆库，降低系统集成复杂度；FMC 不增加推理成本，利于线上部署；真实任务成功率从 11.1% 到 61.1% 显示语言记忆对工程落地有直接价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 它挑战了“视频-动作骨干+外挂 VLM 两阶段”的主流范式，证明语言生成可作为共享表示的正则与记忆机制，在同一次前向中提升操作与记忆能力，为具身控制中统一多模态生成提供了可复用的技术路线。

papers.title: SPAR: Stepwise Personalized Autoregressive Recommendation with Prefix-Balanced Semantic IDs
affiliations: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China
University of Science and Technology of China
papers.abstract: Semantic ID (SID)-based generative recommendation retrieves items through successive token-level decisions, making personalization at each decoding step essential. However, existing methods insufficiently account for prefix-dependent user evidence and imbalanced historical interaction loads among candidate branches. This can cause irreversible branch-selection errors and favor popular paths. We propose SPAR, a generative recommendation framework that jointly improves stepwise personalization and SID construction. Its PATH Decoder retrieves prefix-relevant evidence from compressed long-term user memories and combines it with recent behavior, user profiles, and event context to guide each token decision. Its RQ-PIB module balances historical interaction loads among sibling branches under each parent prefix while preserving semantic structure. Experiments on large-scale Youku production data show an average relative HitRate improvement of 2.66% over the strongest baseline. SPAR also increases target-prefix retention by 5.79 percentage points and reduces the traffic-weighted largest child-branch share by 32.84% across SID levels. In a 7-day online A/B test, SPAR serves 10% of Youku's production traffic and improves average watch time per user by 3.95% and play conversion rate by 3.38%. These results demonstrate more reliable hierarchical decoding, balanced SID branches, and improved user engagement in industrial recommendation.
papers.summary: SPAR针对基于语义ID（SID）的生成式推荐中逐步解码个性化不足与候选分支历史交互负载不均衡的问题，提出联合优化逐步个性化与SID构造的生成式推荐框架。其PATH Decoder从压缩的长期用户记忆中检索与当前前缀相关的证据，并结合近期行为、用户画像与事件上下文，引导每个token级决策；RQ-PIB模块在保持语义结构的前提下，平衡同一父前缀下兄弟分支的历史交互负载，缓解流行路径偏好与不可逆分支选择错误。在优酷大规模生产数据上，SPAR相对最强基线平均HitRate相对提升2.66%，目标前缀保留率提升5.79个百分点，流量加权最大子分支占比在SID各层级降低32.84%。7天线上A/B测试中，SPAR承载优酷10%生产流量，人均观看时长提升3.95%，播放转化率提升3.38%，验证了层次解码可靠性、SID分支均衡性与用户参与度的工业价值。
papers.one_line_takeaway: SPAR通过前缀感知的逐步个性化解码与兄弟分支负载均衡的语义ID构造，在优酷线上显著提升生成式推荐效果与用户参与度。
papers.core_method: SPAR包含两个核心组件：PATH Decoder在每一步token解码时，从压缩的长期用户记忆中检索与当前前缀相关的证据，并与近期行为、用户画像和事件上下文融合，实现逐步个性化；RQ-PIB模块在语义ID的每个父前缀下，对兄弟分支的历史交互负载进行平衡，同时保持语义结构，以缓解流行路径偏好和不可逆分支选择错误。
innovation_points: 提出PATH Decoder，在生成式推荐的每个解码步骤中动态检索前缀相关长期记忆，并与近期行为、画像和上下文联合引导token决策，增强逐步个性化。
设计RQ-PIB模块，在保持语义结构的前提下平衡同一父前缀下兄弟分支的历史交互负载，缓解流行路径偏好与分支选择偏差。
将逐步个性化解码与语义ID构造联合优化，形成端到端的生成式推荐框架，并在工业级生产数据与线上A/B测试中验证。
在优酷大规模生产环境中部署，覆盖10%线上流量，验证了方法在真实业务场景下的工程可行性与线上价值。
experiment_results: 在优酷大规模生产数据上，SPAR相对最强基线平均HitRate相对提升2.66%。
目标前缀保留率提升5.79个百分点，流量加权最大子分支占比在SID各层级降低32.84%。
7天线上A/B测试中，SPAR承载优酷10%生产流量，人均观看时长提升3.95%，播放转化率提升3.38%。
limitations: 摘要未披露PATH Decoder中长期用户记忆的压缩方式、检索开销及在线推理延迟等工程约束细节。
RQ-PIB的负载平衡策略可能对语义ID的语义纯度或长尾物品覆盖产生何种影响，摘要未给出消融或敏感性分析。
线上A/B测试仅覆盖优酷单一业务场景与7天周期，跨场景、跨平台的泛化性尚未验证。
papers.practical_value: SPAR面向工业级生成式推荐的真实业务场景，在优酷生产环境承载10%线上流量并取得人均观看时长与播放转化率的双提升，说明其逐步个性化解码与SID分支均衡策略在工程约束下具备可部署性。RQ-PIB缓解流行路径偏好，有助于改善候选分支负载不均与长尾曝光结构，为基于语义ID的生成式推荐系统提供可落地的优化路径。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作直面生成式推荐中逐步解码个性化不足与SID分支负载失衡两个关键问题，提出可联合优化的框架，并在大规模生产数据与线上A/B测试中给出明确收益，对关注生成式推荐工业落地与语义ID构造的研究者和工程师具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: EASformer: Environment-Action-State Alignment for Industrial Generative Ranking
papers.abstract: Modern industrial ranking systems increasingly adopt generative recommendation (GR) paradigms, in which user behavior sequences and non-sequential (NS) features are tokenized and jointly modeled by Transformer-style backbones. This unified formulation provides a scalable interface for modeling long histories and heterogeneous features. However, sequence and NS representations often carry asymmetric semantics: historical representations may combine environment context with observed-action semantics, whereas candidate-side NS representations contain no observed action but incorporate richer supplementary context, such as user-item interaction features and recent behavior lists. Direct interaction between such representations can make query-key dot products compare different semantic objects, limiting meaningful cross-token interaction. To fill this gap, we propose EASformer, an Environment-Action-State disentangled architecture for industrial app ranking. EASformer constructs an explicitly aligned context environment space shared by historical and non-sequence tokens, while disentangling user actions from historical token and candidate-specific context form non-sequence tokens. Based on this aligned space, EASformer enables complementary historical action retrieval and state-conditioned action prediction. Furthermore, the disentangled design supports a Cloze-style self-supervised objective by masking historical actions and reusing the candidate prediction pathway. On an offline benchmark from a real-world industrial app marketplace, EASformer achieves an AUC of 0.89411, yielding a 0.88% relative improvement over the deployed baseline. Online A/B tests further support this advantage, with relative eCPM lifts of 1.26% and 3.94% across two real-world ranking scenarios.
papers.summary: EASformer针对工业生成式推荐中用户行为序列与非序列特征联合建模时的语义不对称问题：历史表示混合环境上下文与已观测动作语义，候选侧非序列表示不含观测动作但含更丰富补充上下文，直接做query-key点积会比对不同语义对象，限制跨token交互。作者提出环境-动作-状态解耦架构，构建历史与非序列token共享的显式对齐上下文环境空间，将用户动作从历史token中解耦，并由候选特定上下文构成非序列token；在该对齐空间上实现互补的历史动作检索与状态条件动作预测，并支持掩码历史动作、复用候选预测通路的Cloze式自监督目标。真实工业应用市场离线基准AUC为0.89411，较线上基线相对提升0.88%；两个真实排序场景在线A/B的eCPM相对提升1.26%和3.94%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: EASformer通过环境-动作-状态显式解耦与共享环境空间对齐，修复了生成式推荐中序列与非序列token的语义错配，并在真实工业场景取得离线与在线双重收益。
papers.core_method: 将历史行为序列与非序列特征token化后，构建历史token与候选侧非序列token共享的显式对齐上下文环境空间；把用户动作语义从历史token中剥离，候选特定上下文形成非序列token；在统一对齐空间上分别执行历史动作检索与状态条件动作预测，并以掩码历史动作、复用候选预测通路的Cloze式自监督目标训练Transformer骨干。
innovation_points: 提出环境-动作-状态解耦表示，明确区分历史token中的环境上下文与已观测动作语义，缓解query-key点积比对不同语义对象的问题
构建历史与非序列token共享的显式对齐环境空间，使跨token交互在同一语义坐标系下进行
在对齐空间上组合历史动作检索与状态条件动作预测，形成互补的生成式排序路径
设计掩码历史动作并复用候选预测通路的Cloze式自监督目标，提升训练信号利用率
experiment_results: 真实工业应用市场离线基准AUC为0.89411，较已部署基线相对提升0.88%
两个真实排序场景在线A/B测试eCPM相对提升分别为1.26%和3.94%
摘要未提供消融实验、各模块独立贡献及训练成本数据
limitations: 离线评估仅基于单一真实工业应用市场基准，跨业务泛化性证据有限
在线收益来自两个排序场景的A/B结果，未披露长期生态指标与用户侧影响
摘要未给出解耦各模块的消融数据，难以量化环境对齐与动作解耦的独立贡献
papers.practical_value: 面向工业应用市场排序场景，提供可落地的序列-非序列统一建模接口，在保持Transformer骨干可扩展性的同时修正语义错配；在线eCPM提升表明该解耦对齐设计可直接服务于真实流量排序与生成式推荐系统升级。
papers.why_it_matters: 生成式推荐正从学术走向工业部署，序列与非序列特征语义不对称是统一建模中的共性工程难题；该工作给出显式对齐与解耦的系统性方案，并附真实线上A/B证据，对基座式推荐架构设计与线上价值验证均有参考意义。

papers.title: Physical AI for Intralogistics: Benchmarking the NVIDIA Sim-to-Real Ecosystem for Cosmos-Enhanced COMPASS Navigation on Industrial Mobile Robots
papers.abstract: Classical robot navigation stacks are reliable but often require re-engineering for each new robot type and site. Learning-based navigation shifts this effort from hand-tuned parameters to data generation and training, where a policy adapts to each new embodiment or facility by fine-tuning in simulation. Whether policies adapted this way stay reliable on real industrial robots has seen little systematic testing. We study this for NVIDIA's X-Mobility and COMPASS workflow for training learned navigation policies on Idealworks robots. In simulation, we extend the COMPASS benchmark with two embodiments, the differential-drive iw$\mkern-1.5mu.\mkern-1.5mu$hub and an omnidirectional Humanoid Mobile Platform (HMP), and with a digital twin of the Idealworks R&D center. For the real world, we fine-tune X-Mobility on data from this digital twin, with and without sim-to-real variants generated by NVIDIA Cosmos, train COMPASS on top of it from scratch in the digital twin, deploy the resulting policies on the iw$\mkern-1.5mu.\mkern-1.5mu$hub's onboard Jetson AGX Xavier, and benchmark them in the Idealworks R&D center against COMPASS trained only on NVIDIA's environments and the existing Idealworks navigation stack on task success, efficiency, safety, smoothness and onboard compute. Running every static scenario both in a digital-twin replica and in the real facility measures the sim-to-real gap and how far Cosmos-augmented data closes it. Training in the digital twin with Cosmos sim-to-real augmentation raises the real-world success rate of learned navigation from 65.3% to 91.7% across four scenarios and nearly halves its weighted travel time compared with simulation-only training, bringing it within 8.3 points of the production navigation stack, fully onboard; with an integrated global planner, it also reaches far, occluded goals in every trial.
papers.summary: 该论文系统评测了NVIDIA X-Mobility与COMPASS工作流在工业移动机器人上的sim-to-real可靠性。研究在仿真中扩展COMPASS基准，加入差速iw.hub与全向HMP两种本体及Idealworks研发中心数字孪生；真实世界中用数字孪生数据微调X-Mobility，并对比有无NVIDIA Cosmos生成的sim-to-real变体，再从头在数字孪生中训练COMPASS，部署到iw.hub的Jetson AGX Xavier上，在真实研发中心与仅用NVIDIA环境训练的COMPASS及现有Idealworks导航栈对比任务成功率、效率、安全性、平滑性和板载算力。每个静态场景同时在数字孪生副本和真实设施运行，以度量sim-to-real差距及Cosmos增强数据的弥合程度。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 数字孪生训练加Cosmos sim-to-real增强将学习型导航真实成功率从65.3%提升至91.7%，接近生产栈且全板载运行。
papers.core_method: 基于NVIDIA X-Mobility与COMPASS工作流：先在数字孪生中微调X-Mobility，并利用Cosmos生成sim-to-real变体增强数据；再在数字孪生中从头训练COMPASS策略，部署到iw.hub的Jetson AGX Xavier；在真实研发中心与仅仿真训练策略及现有Idealworks导航栈进行多维度基准对比，并通过数字孪生副本与真实设施同场景运行量化sim-to-real差距。
innovation_points: 将COMPASS基准扩展到差速iw.hub与全向HMP两种工业机器人本体，并引入Idealworks研发中心数字孪生
系统评测NVIDIA Cosmos生成的sim-to-real增强数据对真实工业机器人导航策略迁移的作用
在真实设施与数字孪生副本上同场景运行，量化sim-to-real差距及增强数据的弥合程度
全板载部署于Jetson AGX Xavier，并与生产导航栈进行成功率、效率、安全、平滑性和算力对比
experiment_results: 数字孪生训练加Cosmos sim-to-real增强使真实世界成功率从65.3%提升至91.7%（四个场景）
加权旅行时间相比仅仿真训练几乎减半，与生产导航栈差距缩小至8.3个百分点，且全板载运行
集成全局规划器后，在所有试验中均可到达远处或被遮挡的目标
limitations: 评测限于Idealworks研发中心的静态场景，动态障碍与多机器人交互未覆盖
仅测试iw.hub与HMP两种本体，跨更多工业机器人本体的泛化性未知
与生产导航栈仍有8.3个百分点成功率差距，sim-to-real gap未完全消除
papers.practical_value: 为工业内部物流移动机器人提供可复现的sim-to-real评测流程，证明数字孪生加Cosmos数据增强能显著提升学习型导航的真实部署成功率并降低旅行时间，且可全板载运行，减少对逐站点手工调参的依赖。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作首次系统量化NVIDIA Cosmos增强数据在真实工业机器人导航中的sim-to-real收益，并给出与生产栈的差距，对评估学习型导航能否进入工业部署具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Physical Canvas: A Vision Tactile World Model For Robot Policy Evaluation And Learning
papers.abstract: Evaluating and post-training robot policies through physical interaction is costly and difficult to scale, motivating action-conditioned world models as interactive simulators. However, visually plausible predictions can misrepresent contact dynamics, providing unreliable feedback for policy evaluation and learning. We introduce PhysCanvas, a state-consistent visuo-tactile world model for contact-rich robot manipulation. PhysCanvas unifies multi-view RGB, tactile images, marker displacement, task state, and actions within a unified vision space. All modalities share a video VAE and pretrained generative backbone, allowing optical touch to reuse visual and temporal priors. Motion images derived through forward kinematics and camera projection provide spatially aligned action conditioning, while an initial RGB anchor and updated reference observations guide sequential generation. Our consistency-aware post-training uses the frozen Scene Reward Model, Modality Reward Model, and State Reward Model to supervise scene preservation, visual-tactile compatibility, and agreement with real task outcomes. The resulting world model supports closed-loop policy rollouts for evaluation and provides imagined interactions and rewards for GRPO policy updates. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, when policies are rolled out in the world model, State Reward Model supervision increases the arithmetic mean of task-wise Pearson correlations between world-model and real-world success rates from 0.602 to 0.885. Policy post-training in the reward-guided world model further increases $π_{0.5}$'s mean real-world success rate from a 59.1% SFT baseline to 70.8%. These results demonstrate the value of unified multimodal modeling and consistency-aware post-training for robot policy evaluation and learning. Project page: https://zebinx.github.io/PhysCanvas_HomePage/.
papers.summary: PhysCanvas 面向接触密集型机器人操作，提出状态一致的视觉-触觉世界模型，用于策略评估与后训练。研究问题在于：仅视觉上合理的预测可能误表达接触动力学，导致策略评估与学习反馈不可靠。技术路线将多视角 RGB、触觉图像、标记位移、任务状态与动作统一到视觉空间，所有模态共享视频 VAE 与预训练生成主干，使光学触觉复用视觉与时间先验；由正运动学与相机投影得到的运动图像提供空间对齐的动作条件，初始 RGB 锚点与更新参考观测引导序列生成。一致性感知后训练使用冻结的场景奖励模型、模态奖励模型与状态奖励模型，分别监督场景保持、视觉-触觉兼容及与真实任务结果的一致性。世界模型支持闭环策略 rollout 评估，并为 GRPO 策略更新提供想象交互与奖励。四个真实操作任务上，状态奖励模型监督将世界模型与真实成功率逐任务 Pearson 相关均值从 0.602 提升至 0.885；奖励引导世界模型后训练将 π0.5 平均真实成功率从 59.1% SFT 基线提升至 70.8%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: PhysCanvas 用统一视觉-触觉世界模型与一致性感知后训练，把接触动力学纳入策略评估与 GRPO 后训练，显著提升世界模型与真实成功率的对齐及真机策略表现。
papers.core_method: 构建状态一致的视觉-触觉世界模型：多视角 RGB、触觉图像、标记位移、任务状态和动作共享视频 VAE 与预训练生成主干；用正运动学与相机投影生成空间对齐的运动图像作为动作条件，并以初始 RGB 锚点和更新参考观测引导自回归生成；采用冻结的场景、模态、状态三个奖励模型进行一致性感知后训练，支持闭环策略评估与 GRPO 策略更新。
innovation_points: 将触觉图像与标记位移映射到统一视觉空间，使光学触觉复用视频 VAE 和预训练生成主干中的视觉与时间先验。
用正运动学与相机投影构造运动图像，为世界模型提供空间对齐的动作条件，而非仅依赖低维动作向量。
引入冻结的场景奖励模型、模态奖励模型与状态奖励模型做一致性感知后训练，分别约束场景保持、视觉-触觉兼容和真实任务结果一致性。
把世界模型同时用于闭环策略评估和 GRPO 策略后训练的想象交互与奖励来源。
experiment_results: 四个真实操作任务上，状态奖励模型监督将世界模型与真实世界逐任务成功率 Pearson 相关均值从 0.602 提升至 0.885。
在奖励引导的世界模型中后训练，将 π0.5 的平均真实世界成功率从 59.1% 的 SFT 基线提升至 70.8%。
摘要未报告其他任务、基线或消融的详细数值。
limitations: 实验仅覆盖四个真实操作任务，任务多样性与规模有限。
依赖冻结的场景、模态、状态奖励模型，其质量与覆盖范围可能限制一致性后训练效果。
方法面向接触密集型操作，向更广泛机器人任务与场景的泛化性尚未在给定材料中验证。
papers.practical_value: 为机器人策略提供可扩展的交互式评估与后训练环境，减少昂贵且难扩展的真实物理交互；通过触觉与状态一致性约束提升世界模型反馈可靠性，并可直接用于 GRPO 策略更新，在真实操作任务上带来成功率提升。
papers.why_it_matters: 它指出视觉上逼真但接触动力学错误的世界模型会误导策略评估与学习，并给出统一视觉-触觉建模与一致性后训练的可操作方案，同时展示了世界模型评估与真实成功率对齐及真机策略提升的量化证据。

papers.title: FIT-MAC: A Closed-Loop Multi-Agent Framework for Robust Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong performance on standard robotic manipulation benchmarks. However, their reliability can degrade substantially when task conditions deviate from the nominal setting. Perturbations in object positions and task instructions may lead to complete task failure. Existing VLA policies generally lack an explicit runtime mechanism for distinguishing these failure modes and selecting an appropriate recovery strategy. To systematically mitigate this issue, we propose FIT-MAC, a failure-aware, closed-loop multi-agent control framework for improving the robustness of VLA policies at inference time. FIT-MAC augments a VLA policy with an inference-time control layer. First, the Planner Agent parses the language instruction into a structured task specification that captures the manipulation goal and spatial constraints, and the Grounder Agent resolves each instruction-level reference to a visual target. Next, the Verifier Agent tracks phase-specific execution progress, distinguishes target-binding errors from local execution failures, and determines whether intervention is warranted. The Correction Agent then routes permitted interventions to target rebinding or bounded grasping or placement recovery, depending on the failure type. When no intervention is required, the pretrained VLA remains the default action generator. Extensive experiments on LIBERO-PRO demonstrate that FIT-MAC improves robustness across multiple VLA backbones, consistently increasing success rates and achieving state-of-the-art performance under diverse perturbations.
papers.summary: 针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在物体位置与指令扰动下可靠性显著下降、且缺乏运行时失败模式区分与恢复机制的问题，本文提出FIT-MAC——一种失败感知的闭环多智能体推理时控制框架。该框架在预训练VLA策略之上增加推理时控制层：Planner Agent将语言指令解析为含操作目标与空间约束的结构化任务规范，Grounder Agent将指令级指称解析为视觉目标，Verifier Agent跟踪分阶段执行进度并区分目标绑定错误与局部执行失败以判断是否干预，Correction Agent按失败类型路由至目标重绑定或有界抓取/放置恢复；无需干预时仍由预训练VLA生成动作。在LIBERO-PRO上的实验表明，该方法在多种VLA骨干上提升成功率，并在多样扰动下取得当前最优性能。
papers.one_line_takeaway: FIT-MAC在推理阶段为VLA策略加装失败感知的闭环多智能体控制层，通过区分目标绑定错误与执行失败并路由相应恢复策略，显著提升扰动下的操作鲁棒性。
papers.core_method: 在预训练VLA策略之上构建推理时控制层，由四个智能体分工协作：Planner解析指令为结构化任务规范，Grounder完成指令指称到视觉目标的绑定，Verifier跟踪分阶段执行进度并判别失败类型、决定是否干预，Correction按失败类型执行目标重绑定或有界抓取/放置恢复；无干预需求时保留原VLA作为默认动作生成器，形成闭环控制。
innovation_points: 提出失败感知的推理时控制层，在不重训练VLA的前提下增强鲁棒性
显式区分目标绑定错误与局部执行失败两类失败模式，并据此路由不同恢复策略
以多智能体闭环结构将指令解析、目标定位、进度验证与纠错恢复解耦
保持预训练VLA为默认动作生成器，干预仅在必要时触发
experiment_results: 在LIBERO-PRO上跨多种VLA骨干验证，成功率一致提升
在多样扰动条件下取得当前最优性能
摘要未给出具体成功率数值与消融数据
limitations: 依赖外部智能体模块，推理时引入额外计算与延迟开销
恢复策略限定为目标重绑定与有界抓取/放置，覆盖失败类型有限
实验集中于LIBERO-PRO仿真基准，未提供真实机器人部署证据
papers.practical_value: 为已部署的VLA策略提供无需重训练的推理时鲁棒性增强方案，通过失败类型判别与按需干预降低扰动导致的整任务失败，便于在机器人操作系统中以控制层形式集成。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作把VLA鲁棒性问题从训练阶段前移到推理时闭环控制，给出可解释的失败分类与恢复路由思路，对提升机器人操作策略在非标称条件下的可靠性具有参考价值。

papers.title: SLoSa: Small, Low-Power, and Safe Foundation Models for Robotic Task Planning
papers.abstract: Safe robotic task planning requires planners that can reliably achieve task goals while satisfying safety constraints. Classical planners search over explicit symbolic task representations and can provide formal guarantees with respect to encoded safety constraints, but require rigid input formats. Their computational cost also increases rapidly with the search space. In contrast, large language models (LLMs) offer flexible task interfaces and strong generalization capabilities, but they are large, power-hungry, and pre-trained with little robot-specific safety data and knowledge. Thus, they can be difficult to deploy locally on robotic systems with limited resources. To address these limitations, we present SLoSa, a neuro-symbolic compression and fine-tuning framework for training foundation-model-based robotic task planners with Small size, Low power demand, and Safety awareness. The framework first constructs a safety-aware dataset using classical planners, an advanced teacher LLM, and formal verifiers, followed by two training stages: supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning guided by a verification-based reward machine to enforce safety alignment. We evaluate SLoSa across four Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL) domains, two household simulation environments, local edge platforms, and a desktop robotic arm. Across the PDDL tasks, verifier-guided post-training raises the success rate of compact 4B-14B planners to 70.5-76.0%, while INT4 deployment on a Jetson Orin requires 17.85-26.41 W of average power. Results in household simulators and on the physical robot further demonstrate the applicability of SLoSa across diverse robotic task settings.
papers.summary: SLoSa 针对机器人任务规划中经典规划器依赖显式符号表示、难以灵活扩展，而大语言模型虽接口灵活但体积大、功耗高且缺乏机器人安全知识的问题，提出神经符号压缩与微调框架，训练小型、低功耗且具安全意识的基座规划器。方法上先用经典规划器、教师大模型和形式验证器构建安全感知数据集，再经监督微调与由基于验证的奖励机引导的强化学习微调实现安全对齐。在四个 PDDL 域、两个家庭仿真环境、本地边缘平台和桌面机械臂上评估，验证器引导的后训练使 4B-14B 紧凑规划器成功率提升至 70.5-76.0%，INT4 部署于 Jetson Orin 平均功耗 17.85-26.41 W，仿真与真机结果进一步表明其跨场景适用性。
papers.one_line_takeaway: SLoSa 用神经符号数据构建与验证器引导的后训练，把机器人任务规划基座模型压缩到 4B-14B 并实现低功耗、安全对齐的本地部署。
papers.core_method: 构建由经典规划器、教师 LLM 和形式验证器生成的安全感知数据集；对紧凑基座模型先做监督微调，再用基于验证的奖励机引导强化学习微调，以强制安全对齐并压缩模型规模。
innovation_points: 将经典规划器的形式安全保证与教师 LLM 的泛化能力结合，自动构建安全感知训练数据
引入基于形式验证的奖励机驱动 RL 微调，把安全约束直接注入后训练目标
面向资源受限机器人平台做神经符号压缩，实现 4B-14B 小模型与 INT4 低功耗部署
experiment_results: 四个 PDDL 域上，验证器引导后训练将 4B-14B 规划器成功率提升至 70.5-76.0%
INT4 部署于 Jetson Orin 平均功耗 17.85-26.41 W
两个家庭仿真环境与桌面机械臂实验表明方法可跨场景应用；摘要未给出具体成功率与安全违规率数据
limitations: 安全保证依赖形式验证器与编码约束的完备性，摘要未说明对未建模风险的覆盖程度
评估集中于 PDDL 域与有限家庭仿真/单机械臂场景，真实复杂环境的泛化性证据有限
摘要未报告与教师 LLM 或经典规划器的直接对比数据及安全违规率
papers.practical_value: 为资源受限的机器人系统提供可本地部署的小型低功耗规划基座模型，降低对云端大模型的依赖，并以验证器引导的后训练提升任务执行的安全合规性，适合边缘平台与实体机器人落地。
papers.why_it_matters: 它展示了如何用神经符号数据与验证奖励把安全约束注入小模型后训练，在保持低功耗部署的同时兼顾泛化与形式安全，为机器人任务规划基座模型的工程化提供可参考路线。

papers.title: Large Multimodal Models for Direct Robot Control: GPT-6 as a Beginning
papers.abstract: Recent advances in visuospatial understanding and agentic reasoning enable direct robotic manipulation with general-purpose multimodal models, but their embodied capabilities remain poorly understood. This paper systematically evaluate GPT-6 Astra for closed-loop robotic manipulation using a lightweight agent execution framework. We first probe three fundamental embodied capabilities-depth perception, embodied in-context learning, and tactile understanding-and demonstrate that the model can exploit depth information, acquire simple manipulation strategies from contextual demonstrations, and use tactile feedback to correct its actions. We then evaluate GPT-6 Astra across five established manipulation benchmarks along six capability dimensions. Despite competitive performance on several benchmarks-26.92\% success on RoboDojo and 76.0\% on RoboTwin 2.0-our analysis reveals a pronounced gap between semantic reasoning and physical execution, particularly in consequence-aware action planning, precision, and complex motion coordination. To further examine these limitations, we introduce LIBERO-GeoMotion, a new benchmark of geometry-constrained tasks that require precise pose alignment, coordinated translation and rotation, and anticipation of physical action consequences. GPT-6 Astra achieves only 11.1\% zero-shot success, exposing the difficulty of translating spatial understanding into physically feasible motion. Real-world experiments corroborate these findings: zero-shot execution is feasible for simple tasks, yet persistent deficits remain in motion feasibility, precise control, and physical safety, while substantial inference latency further hinders practical deployment. Overall, our results characterize the emerging embodied capabilities of general-purpose multimodal models and delineate the key challenges toward safe, efficient, and reliable robotic manipulation.
papers.summary: 该论文系统评估了通用多模态大模型GPT-6 Astra在闭环机器人操作中的具身能力。作者采用轻量级智能体执行框架，先探测深度感知、具身上下文学习和触觉理解三项基础能力，发现模型能利用深度信息、从演示中习得简单策略并借助触觉反馈纠错。随后在五个操作基准、六个能力维度上评测，RoboDojo成功率26.92%、RoboTwin 2.0达76.0%，但暴露出语义推理与物理执行间的显著鸿沟，尤其体现在后果感知动作规划、精度和复杂运动协调上。为此作者提出LIBERO-GeoMotion几何约束基准，GPT-6 Astra零样本成功率仅11.1%。真实实验进一步证实简单任务可零样本执行，但运动可行性、精确控制与物理安全仍存持续缺陷，推理延迟也阻碍实际部署。
papers.one_line_takeaway: GPT-6 Astra具备初步具身能力，但语义推理到物理执行的转化仍是通用多模态模型直接控制机器人的核心瓶颈。
papers.core_method: 构建轻量级智能体执行框架，将GPT-6 Astra接入闭环机器人操作流程；先以探针任务评估深度感知、具身上下文学习与触觉理解三项基础能力，再在五个操作基准的六个能力维度上系统评测，并新提出LIBERO-GeoMotion几何约束基准与真实世界实验进行交叉验证。
innovation_points: 首次对GPT-6 Astra进行系统性具身能力评测，覆盖基础感知、上下文学习与触觉反馈三个层面
提出LIBERO-GeoMotion基准，以几何约束任务暴露空间理解到物理可行运动的转化困难
结合仿真基准与真实机器人实验，从语义推理与物理执行差距角度刻画通用多模态模型的具身能力边界
experiment_results: RoboDojo成功率26.92%，RoboTwin 2.0成功率76.0%
LIBERO-GeoMotion零样本成功率仅11.1%
真实实验中简单任务可零样本执行，但运动可行性、精确控制与物理安全存在持续缺陷，推理延迟显著
limitations: 仅评测GPT-6 Astra单一模型，缺乏与其他通用多模态模型的横向对比
真实世界实验规模与任务多样性有限，结论的泛化性有待验证
推理延迟等工程约束未被量化优化，难以支撑实时闭环部署
papers.practical_value: 为企业评估通用多模态大模型直接驱动机器人提供了可复用的评测框架与几何约束基准，明确了当前模型在精度、运动协调与安全性上的工程短板，有助于指导具身智能系统在真实业务场景中的选型与部署边界判断。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作直面通用多模态模型能否直接控制机器人这一关键问题，用多基准与真实实验揭示了语义推理与物理执行之间的系统性差距，为后续具身能力改进与安全部署划定了清晰的挑战清单。

papers.title: Industrial ReMEmbR: Scaling Spatiotemporal Memory to Robot Fleets
papers.abstract: Warehouse robot fleets continuously observe operational conditions, but preserving these observations as reusable semantic memory incurs substantial computation, communication, and storage costs. For example, explaining recurring aisle blockages can require reviewing video from multiple robots across several shifts. We present IndustrialRemembr, a shared spatiotemporal memory system that extends NVIDIA ReMEmbR to robot fleets and reduces server-side computation by generating scene descriptions only on demand. On each robot, an NVIDIA Jetson encodes video clips into retrieval embeddings with Cosmos-Embed1, vision tokens with Cosmos3-Edge, and reconstruction latents with the Wan2.2 VAE, without uploading raw camera frames. The encoding models are re-used to detect people in image patches, zeroing them out to support PII abstraction for GDPR-compliant deployments. We split Cosmos3-Edge at its vision-language boundary, placing the vision encoder on the robot and the language decoder on an on-premises server. A Nemotron agent retrieves memories by content, position, and time and queries the decoder using cached vision tokens. This design eliminates caption generation at write time, while cached-token decoding reproduces the unsplit model's output in all 450 tested decodes.
papers.summary: Industrial ReMEmbR 面向仓库机器人集群的时空记忆复用问题：持续观测产生大量视频，若在写入时生成描述并上传原始帧，会带来高昂的计算、通信与存储开销。作者将 NVIDIA ReMEmbR 扩展到多机器人场景，提出按需生成场景描述的共享时空记忆系统。每台机器人用 Jetson 上的 Cosmos-Embed1 编码检索嵌入、Cosmos3-Edge 编码视觉 token、Wan2.2 VAE 编码重建潜变量，原始相机帧不上传；同一批编码模型还用于检测图像块中的人并置零，以实现 PII 抽象。系统将 Cosmos3-Edge 在视觉-语言边界切分，视觉编码器留在机器人端，语言解码器部署在本地服务器，由 Nemotron 智能体按内容、位置和时间检索记忆并利用缓存视觉 token 查询解码器。该设计消除了写入时的描述生成，且在全部 450 次测试解码中，缓存 token 解码复现了未切分模型的输出。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Industrial ReMEmbR 通过端侧编码、视觉-语言模型切分与按需解码，把机器人集群的时空记忆写入成本转化为可检索的缓存 token，并在 450 次解码中保持与未切分模型一致的输出。
papers.core_method: 系统在每台机器人端用 Cosmos-Embed1 生成检索嵌入、Cosmos3-Edge 视觉编码器生成视觉 token、Wan2.2 VAE 生成重建潜变量，不上传原始帧；将 Cosmos3-Edge 在视觉-语言边界切分，视觉部分端侧运行、语言解码器置于本地服务器；Nemotron 智能体按内容、位置和时间检索记忆，并用缓存视觉 token 按需查询解码器生成描述；复用编码模型检测并置零图像块中的人以实现 PII 抽象。
innovation_points: 将 ReMEmbR 从单机器人扩展到机器人集群的共享时空记忆系统，支持跨机器人、跨班次检索。
在视觉-语言边界切分 Cosmos3-Edge，视觉编码端侧化、语言解码服务器化，避免写入时生成描述。
复用编码模型进行人物检测与置零，以 PII 抽象支撑 GDPR 合规部署。
以缓存视觉 token 按需解码，替代写入时描述生成，降低服务器端计算。
experiment_results: 在全部 450 次测试解码中，缓存 token 解码复现了未切分模型的输出。
摘要未提供检索准确率、端到端延迟、带宽或存储节省的定量数据。
limitations: 缺少大规模真实仓库部署的定量评估，如检索质量、延迟与成本收益。
PII 抽象依赖图像块人物检测，摘要未说明其召回率与漏检风险。
系统依赖特定 NVIDIA 模型栈（Jetson、Cosmos、Nemotron、Wan2.2），可移植性未讨论。
papers.practical_value: 为仓库机器人集群提供可落地的隐私合规记忆方案：原始帧不出端侧，写入时不做描述生成，服务器按需解码，降低通信、存储与计算开销，并支持跨机器人跨班次回溯如通道阻塞等重复事件。
papers.why_it_matters: 它展示了生成式模型在机器人集群记忆系统中的工程化路径：通过模型切分与缓存 token 把重计算从写入侧移到查询侧，同时用端侧 PII 抽象满足合规要求，对多机器人语义记忆系统设计有直接参考价值。

papers.title: Combining Long-Term Memory and LLMs Comes at a High Cost: From Prompt Injection to Persistent Compromise
affiliations: Universidade do Estado de Santa Catarina
papers.abstract: The widespread adoption of generative artificial intelligence in recent years has brought a parallel rise in prompt injection and jailbreak attacks. By embedding malicious instructions, these exploits manipulate language models to bypass intended behavior and operational boundaries. In traditional chatbots, such attacks are confined to a single session because state memory is not preserved across conversations. However, persistent memory features in modern conversational interfaces enable cross-session attack propagation, establishing a threat vector known as memory injection. This work explores this emerging vulnerability in leading LLM-as-a-service platforms, highlighting its real-world severity and the need for countermeasures. While existing literature focuses on violations tailored to specific platform features, we present a general threat model. We demonstrate that all NIST attack goals are collectively achievable across ChatGPT Instant 5.3, Claude Sonnet 4.6, and Gemini 3 Flash under this model. We also show that memory injections can exploit multiple attack vectors, including personal memories, projects, skills, organization instructions, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-connected resources. Our findings reveal that all evaluated services can be manipulated to persistently spread disinformation, generate harmful content, or simulate offline unresponsiveness, even in fresh sessions. In the particular case of Claude, shared-memory features allow an attacker to compromise multiple users within an organization and also exfiltrate user prompts. To address these vulnerabilities, we derive defense mechanisms from our proposed threat model and foundational cybersecurity principles. Our analysis indicates that nearly half of these mitigations remain unimplemented across the target services. Datasets and attack artifacts are available at https://github.com/PedroBarcha/Memory-injection.
papers.summary: 该论文研究现代对话式LLM服务中持久记忆功能引入的跨会话攻击面，提出“记忆注入”这一新型威胁向量。作者构建通用威胁模型，覆盖个人记忆、项目、技能、组织指令及MCP连接资源等多种注入载体，并在ChatGPT Instant 5.3、Claude Sonnet 4.6和Gemini 3 Flash上验证NIST全部攻击目标可被组合达成。实验表明，攻击者可利用记忆注入在新会话中持续传播虚假信息、生成有害内容或模拟离线无响应；Claude的共享记忆特性还允许攻击者危害组织内多用户并窃取用户提示。作者基于威胁模型与基础网络安全原则推导防御机制，并指出近半数缓解措施在目标服务中尚未实现。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 持久记忆把提示注入从单会话风险升级为跨会话、跨用户的持续性妥协，现有主流LLM服务防御缺口显著。
papers.core_method: 提出面向LLM即服务平台的通用记忆注入威胁模型，系统枚举个人记忆、项目、技能、组织指令和MCP连接资源等注入向量，映射至NIST攻击目标，并在三个主流商业模型服务上进行实证验证与防御措施差距分析。
innovation_points: 首次提出并系统化“记忆注入”这一跨会话攻击向量，突破传统提示注入的单会话边界
构建通用威胁模型而非针对特定平台功能，覆盖多种记忆载体与MCP连接资源
在ChatGPT、Claude和Gemini三个主流商业服务上验证NIST全部攻击目标可组合达成
揭示Claude共享记忆导致组织内多用户连锁妥协与提示泄露的放大效应
experiment_results: 在ChatGPT Instant 5.3、Claude Sonnet 4.6和Gemini 3 Flash上，NIST全部攻击目标可在该威胁模型下组合实现
记忆注入可在全新会话中持续传播虚假信息、生成有害内容或模拟离线无响应
Claude共享记忆特性使攻击者可危害组织内多用户并窃取用户提示；近半数推导出的缓解措施在目标服务中未实现
limitations: 研究基于标题、摘要和学术元数据，未提供各攻击向量的成功率、样本规模等定量实验数据
防御机制仅从威胁模型和网络安全原则推导，未报告实际部署或对抗评估效果
评估覆盖三个商业平台，结论对其他LLM服务或自托管部署的泛化性未经验证
papers.practical_value: 为企业与LLM服务提供商提供记忆功能的安全设计检查清单，提示在启用持久记忆、共享记忆和MCP连接资源时需优先落实身份隔离、记忆写入审计与跨会话污染检测，避免攻击在组织内持久扩散。
papers.why_it_matters: 随着LLM产品普遍引入长期记忆与组织级共享上下文，提示注入的危害从单次会话扩展到持久化、跨用户的安全事件；该文给出了可操作的威胁模型与防御差距分析，对LLM推理系统与记忆架构的安全设计具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: AGR: Agentic Generative Retrieval with Tool-Augmented Search
papers.abstract: Large-scale search and recommendation systems derive much of their retrieval quality from rich, heterogeneous features, yet existing generative retrieval (GR) methods struggle to exploit such feature ecosystems efficiently. Static feature injection either encodes all available signals or places them according to predetermined schemes, increasing serving cost and introducing irrelevant or conflicting evidence. More fundamentally, existing methods cannot adaptively determine when a feature is needed, which feature to select, or where it should influence hierarchical Semantic ID (SID) generation. We propose Agentic Generative Retrieval (AGR), a tool-augmented paradigm that interleaves SID generation with on-demand feature acquisition. Conditioned on the request and decoded SID prefix, AGR decides whether to invoke a tool, which feature to acquire, and where its observation should influence subsequent decoding, thereby steering generation toward feature-consistent SID branches. To supervise this behavior, we construct tool-augmented trajectories based on feature applicability and information gain along the SID hierarchy, and train the model through SID pretraining followed by tool-augmented fine-tuning. Experiments on an industrial dataset and three public benchmarks, together with an online A/B test, consistently demonstrate the effectiveness of AGR.
papers.summary: 针对生成式检索（GR）难以高效利用大规模搜索推荐系统中异构特征生态的问题，本文提出Agentic Generative Retrieval（AGR），一种工具增强的生成式检索范式。AGR将语义ID（SID）生成与按需特征获取交错进行：在给定请求与已解码SID前缀的条件下，模型自适应决定是否调用工具、选择哪个特征、以及观测结果应影响后续解码的哪个位置，从而将生成引导至特征一致的SID分支。为监督该行为，作者依据特征适用性与沿SID层级的信息增益构造工具增强轨迹，并采用SID预训练加工具增强微调的两阶段训练。工业数据集、三个公开基准与线上A/B测试一致验证了AGR的有效性。
papers.one_line_takeaway: AGR把特征获取从静态注入改为由SID前缀驱动的按需工具调用，使生成式检索能自适应选择特征并定位其影响位置。
papers.core_method: 以自回归SID生成为主干，在解码每一步根据请求与已解码SID前缀决策是否调用工具、选取哪个特征、以及观测注入到后续解码的何处；用特征适用性与信息增益构造工具增强轨迹，先做SID预训练再做工具增强微调。
innovation_points: 提出工具增强的Agentic生成式检索范式，将特征获取与SID生成交错而非静态注入
让模型自适应决定何时需要特征、选哪个特征、以及特征影响哪个层级的SID解码位置
基于特征适用性与信息增益沿SID层级构造监督轨迹，并设计SID预训练+工具增强微调的训练流程
experiment_results: 在工业数据集与三个公开基准上验证了AGR的有效性
线上A/B测试一致表明方法有效
摘要未给出具体指标数值，无法报告定量提升幅度
limitations: 工具调用引入额外决策与获取开销，摘要未讨论其对线上时延与服务成本的影响
监督依赖基于特征适用性与信息增益构造的轨迹，轨迹质量与构造成本可能制约效果
摘要未披露公开基准的具体设置与对比基线细节
papers.practical_value: 面向大规模搜索推荐的真实业务场景，AGR让系统按需调用异构特征而非全量注入，有望降低服务成本并缓解无关或冲突特征对SID生成的干扰，且已通过线上A/B测试验证，具备落地参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把生成式检索的特征利用问题从静态编码转为解码过程中的自适应工具调用，为语义ID生成与特征生态的结合提供了可监督、可上线的新路线。

papers.title: Don't Rewrite the SID Map: Topology Preservation for Generative Retrieval in Dynamic E-Commerce Search
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China
papers.abstract: Generative retrieval assigns each item a discrete semantic identifier (SID) and retrieves items by autoregressively generating SID sequences. In dynamic environments such as e-commerce, new items arrive continuously, requiring periodic updates to the SID-to-Item mapping and model to maintain retrieval timeliness. Each update, however, can invalidate search paths already learned by the retriever, and the quantitative relationship between mapping change and retrieval quality has not been systematically characterized. We study this problem with extensive controlled experiments over 67 days of large-scale e-commerce search logs and obtain three core findings. (1) SID semantic drift causes severe retrieval degradation that may be masked by large beam sizes: mapping updates reduce HitRate by 41.78-62.05% at beam size 1 but only 8.33-10.85% at beam size 1000, as redundant candidate generation conceals the true severity of drift. (2) The fraction of changed SIDs is strictly monotonically related to retrieval quality: as the remapped fraction increases from 0% to 72.75%, HitRate decreases monotonically, dropping up to 42.66% at beam size 1. Full remapping remains substantially worse than the preservation policy under warm-start training, indicating that short-budget continued training alone cannot repair topology disruption. (3) The SID topology-preserving principle makes even the simplest warm-start strategy highly effective: fixing old-item SIDs, inserting new-items, and warm-starting from the previous model improves old-item HitRate by 10% and new-item HitRate by 109%, validated across two non-overlapping update cycles. These findings distill into a concise deployment principle: insert new-items, freeze old-items; warm-start when possible, otherwise freeze; never change SIDs the model has already learned. A three-week online A/B test on TmallAPP shows UCTCVR +0.29% and GMV +1.16%.
papers.summary: 该论文研究动态电商搜索中生成式检索的语义ID（SID）映射更新问题：新商品持续到达迫使周期性重映射SID与模型，但更新会破坏检索器已学习的搜索路径。作者基于67天大规模电商搜索日志开展受控实验，发现三点：SID语义漂移导致检索显著退化，且大beam size会掩盖真实严重性（beam=1时HitRate下降41.78-62.05%，beam=1000时仅8.33-10.85%）；变更SID比例与检索质量严格单调负相关，0%到72.75%重映射时HitRate最多下降42.66%，全量重映射在热启动下仍明显差于保持策略；遵循SID拓扑保持原则——固定旧商品SID、插入新商品、从上一模型热启动——即使最简单策略也有效，旧商品HitRate提升10%、新商品HitRate提升109%，并在两个不重叠更新周期验证。最终形成部署原则：插入新商品、冻结旧商品；能热启动则热启动，否则冻结；绝不更改模型已学SID。天猫APP三周在线A/B测试显示UCTCVR +0.29%、GMV +1.16%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 动态电商中应保持已学SID拓扑不变，仅插入新商品并热启动模型，避免重映射导致的检索退化。
papers.core_method: 提出SID拓扑保持原则：固定旧商品SID、为新商品分配新SID、从上一版本模型热启动继续训练；通过67天搜索日志的受控实验系统刻画SID变更比例与检索质量的关系，并对比全量重映射与保持策略。
innovation_points: 系统量化SID语义漂移对生成式检索的影响，揭示大beam size通过冗余候选掩盖退化严重性；
发现变更SID比例与检索质量严格单调负相关，且短预算热启动无法修复全量重映射的拓扑破坏；
提出并验证最简单的拓扑保持策略（冻结旧SID+插入新SID+热启动）在旧/新商品上均显著有效；
给出可操作的部署原则，并在天猫APP在线A/B测试中验证业务价值。
experiment_results: beam=1时映射更新使HitRate下降41.78-62.05%，beam=1000时仅下降8.33-10.85%；
重映射比例从0%增至72.75%时HitRate单调下降，beam=1时最多下降42.66%；
拓扑保持策略使旧商品HitRate提升10%、新商品HitRate提升109%，两个不重叠更新周期验证；天猫APP三周在线A/B：UCTCVR +0.29%、GMV +1.16%。
limitations: 实验基于单一电商平台（天猫）日志，跨平台泛化性未验证；
未系统比较不同SID分配算法或模型架构下的拓扑保持效果；
在线A/B仅报告三周结果，长期影响与多次更新累积效应未充分讨论。
papers.practical_value: 为动态电商生成式检索提供可直接落地的SID更新部署原则：插入新商品、冻结旧商品SID、优先热启动，避免全量重映射；在真实业务中实现GMV与转化率正向收益，降低更新带来的检索退化风险。
papers.why_it_matters: 生成式检索在动态商品流中必须持续更新SID映射，但重映射会破坏已学拓扑。该文用大规模日志实验量化退化机制，并给出简单有效的保持策略与线上验证，对工业界部署具有直接指导意义。

papers.title: SPAR: Structural Pruning and Action Recovery for Vision-Language-Action Models
affiliations: Nanjing University of Information Science and Technology
papers.abstract: The limited onboard computing resources of robots make the inference demands of vision-language-action (VLA) models costly to accommodate. Reducing these demands through aggressive compression, however, can degrade manipulation performance beyond what supervised fine-tuning alone recovers. We present SPAR (Structural Pruning and Action Recovery), which simultaneously prunes the hidden and feed-forward intermediate dimensions of the large language model (LLM) backbone through pruning-aware tuning, then applies reinforcement learning (RL) to recover policy performance. Applied to $π_{0.5}$, SPAR reduces the language backbone from 2.34B to 0.09B parameters and the full model from 3.37B to 1.12B, removing approximately 96% and 67% of their parameters, respectively. At this compression level, RL raises average success across the four LIBERO suites from 84.55% to 93.45%, an 8.90-percentage-point gain. The compressed policy achieves a $1.98\times$ full-policy inference speedup over the unpruned model. These results identify substantial intermediate-dimension redundancy and show that post-pruning RL can recover manipulation performance in compact policies.
papers.summary: SPAR针对机器人端侧算力受限导致视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型推理成本高的问题展开研究。作者指出，仅靠监督微调难以恢复激进压缩带来的操作性能损失，因此提出结构化剪枝与动作恢复相结合的两阶段方案：先通过剪枝感知训练，同时裁剪LLM主干隐藏维度与前馈中间维度，再以强化学习恢复策略性能。在π0.5上，语言主干由2.34B降至0.09B，全模型由3.37B降至1.12B，分别削减约96%和67%参数；在此压缩率下，RL将LIBERO四个套件平均成功率由84.55%提升至93.45%，提升8.90个百分点，压缩策略相对未剪枝模型取得1.98倍推理加速。结果说明中间维度存在显著冗余，剪枝后RL可恢复紧凑策略的操作性能。
papers.one_line_takeaway: SPAR通过结构化剪枝加RL动作恢复，把VLA语言主干压缩约96%后仍将LIBERO平均成功率提升8.90个百分点，并实现1.98倍推理加速。
papers.core_method: 对VLA模型LLM主干的隐藏维度与前馈中间维度做结构化剪枝，并配合剪枝感知训练；剪枝后使用强化学习对动作策略进行恢复性后训练，以弥补监督微调无法挽回的性能损失。
innovation_points: 同时裁剪LLM主干的隐藏维度与前馈中间维度，而非只做单一维度压缩
将剪枝感知训练与剪枝后强化学习动作恢复结合为两阶段流程
在π0.5上验证极高压缩率下RL恢复策略性能的可行性
experiment_results: 语言主干由2.34B降至0.09B（约96%），全模型由3.37B降至1.12B（约67%）
RL使LIBERO四个套件平均成功率由84.55%升至93.45%，提升8.90个百分点
压缩策略相对未剪枝模型实现1.98倍推理加速
limitations: 实验集中在LIBERO仿真套件，未提供真实机器人平台验证数据
仅报告π0.5单一基座模型结果，跨模型泛化性未知
摘要未给出剪枝感知训练与RL各自贡献的消融数据
papers.practical_value: 面向机器人端侧算力受限场景，SPAR大幅降低VLA模型参数量与推理开销，为在有限板载资源上部署大模型驱动的操作策略提供可参考的压缩与恢复流程。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作表明VLA模型中间维度存在大量冗余，且剪枝后强化学习可有效恢复操作性能，为具身智能模型的高效部署提供了剪枝加RL恢复的新思路。

papers.title: HAF-VLA: Hierarchical Action Flow Framework for Humanoid Vision-Language-Action Control
papers.abstract: Humanoid robots hold great promise as general-purpose agents in human-centered environments, yet adapting generalist vision-language-action (VLA) policies to real-world humanoid loco-manipulation remains challenging. Unlike fixed-base or wheeled manipulators, humanoids must coordinate locomotion, posture, gaze, and dual-arm manipulation over a high-dimensional whole-body action space, where inaccurate base or waist motions can easily induce unstable and aggressive upper-body compensation. We propose HAF-VLA, a hierarchical action-flow framework for humanoid VLA control. Built upon a pretrained flow-matching VLA, HAF-VLA inherits the vision-language prefix encoder and action expert weights, and adapts them to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation with learnable stage embeddings and cross-stage KV-cache conditioning. Instead of generating the full action chunk in a single pass, HAF-VLA progressively denoises a shared whole-body action space: first locomotion and head commands, then waist refinement, and finally full-body manipulation. To preserve structural dependencies across stages, we introduce a cross-stage KV cache conditioning mechanism, enabling subsequent action generation stages to refine and augment their outputs based on the action representations from preceding stages. Experimental results across six real-world tasks demonstrate that our framework significantly enhances the performance of existing models in humanoid loco-manipulation tasks, demonstrating an effective pathway for adapting strong mobile-manipulation VLAs to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation.
papers.summary: 针对人形机器人在真实环境中进行全身移动操作时，通用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略难以直接适配的问题，本文提出 HAF-VLA 分层动作流框架。该方法基于预训练的流匹配 VLA，继承其视觉-语言前缀编码器与动作专家权重，并引入可学习阶段嵌入与跨阶段 KV-cache 条件机制，将全身动作分阶段渐进去噪：先生成移动与头部指令，再细化腰部，最后生成全身操作动作。跨阶段 KV 缓存使后续阶段能基于前序动作表示进行修正与增强，从而缓解高维全身动作空间中底座或腰部误差引发的上肢剧烈补偿。在六个真实任务上的实验表明，该框架显著提升现有人形移动操作模型的表现，为将强移动操作 VLA 适配到人形全身控制提供了有效路径。
papers.one_line_takeaway: HAF-VLA 通过分层动作流与跨阶段 KV 缓存，把预训练流匹配 VLA 渐进适配到人形全身移动操作，并在六个真实任务上验证了有效性。
papers.core_method: 以预训练流匹配 VLA 为基座，继承视觉-语言前缀编码器与动作专家权重；引入可学习阶段嵌入和跨阶段 KV-cache 条件，在共享全身动作空间内按“移动与头部→腰部细化→全身操作”的顺序分阶段渐进去噪，使后阶段基于前阶段动作表示进行修正与增强。
innovation_points: 提出分层动作流生成范式，将全身动作分阶段渐进去噪，而非单次生成完整动作块；
设计跨阶段 KV-cache 条件机制，保留阶段间结构依赖，使后续阶段能细化并增强前序动作表示；
在预训练流匹配 VLA 上以阶段嵌入和权重继承实现适配，降低从移动操作到人形全身控制的迁移成本。
experiment_results: 在六个真实世界任务上开展实验，框架显著提升现有人形移动操作模型的表现；
摘要未给出具体量化指标、对比基线数值或消融数据，需以论文正文为准。
limitations: 摘要未报告定量结果与统计显著性，性能提升幅度缺乏具体数据支撑；
方法依赖预训练流匹配 VLA 基座与真实人形平台，跨平台泛化性尚未在摘要中说明；
分阶段去噪引入多阶段推理开销，实时性约束未在摘要中讨论。
papers.practical_value: 面向人形机器人真实全身移动操作场景，提供了一条从成熟移动操作 VLA 向人形全身控制迁移的工程路径；分层生成与跨阶段条件有助于抑制底座/腰部误差导致的上肢补偿，对提升线上部署稳定性具有参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 人形全身移动操作是高维耦合控制难题，该工作将分层动作流与预训练 VLA 结合，为通用 VLA 策略落地人形平台提供了可复用的适配思路，值得关注其真实任务验证与工程约束处理。

papers.title: EmbodiedWorld-200K: Toward Embodied World Agents via Embodied-Planning Dataset and Interactive World Models
papers.abstract: Building embodied agents that can perceive, reason, and act across diverse 3D worlds is a central research direction toward artificial general intelligence. Yet most existing work remains confined to specific tasks in a single scene and transfers poorly to new environments, leaving general embodied agents for open-world settings under-explored. We refer to such agents as Embodied World Agents (EWAs), whose defining property is the ability to understand diverse visual environments and execute general actions in open-world conditions. To advance EWA research, we study open-world embodied navigation-planning and release EmbodiedWorld-200K, a large-scale dataset of over 200K samples spanning diverse scenes. Each example is equipped with multi-level annotations, ranging from low-level camera-motion trajectories to high-level semantic instructions. The dataset also provides unified evaluation splits and task-specific metrics, supporting offline pretraining and fair evaluation of EWAs. Beyond offline supervision, a defining characteristic of an EWA is its interaction with the environment; training solely on offline data is therefore insufficient, especially for generalizing to scenes not covered in the training distribution. Building dedicated real interactive environments, however, is often prohibitively expensive. To address this, we propose a novel training scheme that employs a video world model as a low-cost environment proxy and performs interactive reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training of the EWA within it. Empirically, pretraining on EmbodiedWorld-200K substantially improves the open-world embodied planning ability of the EWA, and further RL post-training inside a world model yields clear gains on out-of-distribution scenes. The dataset, baseline checkpoints, and training and evaluation code are available at https://xiaokunfeng.github.io/EmbodiedWorld-200K/.
papers.summary: 该论文针对开放世界具身智能体（EWA）训练数据与环境交互不足的问题，提出EmbodiedWorld-200K大规模数据集，包含超20万样本，覆盖多样场景，并提供从低层相机运动轨迹到高层语义指令的多级标注及统一评测划分与任务指标，支持离线预训练与公平评测。针对离线数据难以泛化到训练分布外场景的局限，作者提出以视频世界模型作为低成本环境代理，在模型内对EWA进行交互式强化学习后训练。实验表明，在EmbodiedWorld-200K上预训练可显著提升开放世界具身规划能力，而世界模型内的RL后训练在分布外场景上带来明显增益。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 用大规模多级标注具身规划数据集做预训练，再以视频世界模型为低成本环境代理进行交互式RL后训练，可提升开放世界具身智能体的规划与泛化能力。
papers.core_method: 构建EmbodiedWorld-200K数据集（20万+样本、多场景、多级标注、统一评测划分与指标），先进行离线预训练；随后将视频世界模型作为环境代理，在其中对具身智能体执行交互式强化学习后训练，以弥补纯离线监督在分布外泛化上的不足。
innovation_points: 发布EmbodiedWorld-200K大规模开放世界具身导航-规划数据集，提供从低层相机运动轨迹到高层语义指令的多级标注及统一评测协议
提出以视频世界模型作为低成本环境代理，在模型内进行交互式RL后训练，规避构建真实交互环境的高昂成本
将离线预训练与模型内交互式后训练结合，面向开放世界具身智能体（EWA）的通用规划与泛化能力
experiment_results: 在EmbodiedWorld-200K上预训练显著提升EWA的开放世界具身规划能力
在世界模型内进行RL后训练，在分布外场景上取得明显增益
摘要未给出具体数值指标，需查阅原文实验部分
limitations: 视频世界模型作为环境代理，其保真度与物理一致性可能限制RL后训练效果向真实环境的迁移
数据集与评测聚焦开放世界导航-规划任务，对其他具身任务类型的覆盖有限
摘要未报告具体量化结果与消融细节，结论强度需结合原文实验验证
papers.practical_value: 为具身智能体提供可复用的开放世界规划预训练数据与基线检查点，并以视频世界模型替代昂贵真实环境进行RL后训练，降低企业构建具身导航与规划系统的数据与环境成本，适合作为离线预训练加模型内后训练的工程范式参考。
papers.why_it_matters: 它同时回应了具身智能中数据规模不足与环境交互成本高两个关键瓶颈，给出数据集、训练方案与评测协议的一体化路径，对开放世界具身智能体的预训练与后训练研究具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: PaceVLA: Adaptive Temporal Action Quantization in Vision-Language-Action Models
affiliations: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology
papers.abstract: Fast and reliable manipulation is crucial for practical robot deployment. Although Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently shown remarkable progress as generalist robot policies, their execution often remains temporally inefficient. A key source of this inefficiency is that policies learn fine-grained temporal patterns from teleoperated demonstrations, requiring many low-level action steps. Temporal action quantization offers a simple way to accelerate execution by aggregating consecutive low-level actions into temporally coarser actions. However, applying action quantization without considering when fine-grained control is required introduces a speed-accuracy trade-off: accelerated actions may efficiently reduce redundant steps in some phases, while discarding critical motion details in precision-sensitive interactions. To address this, we propose PaceVLA, a unified framework for adaptive temporal execution in VLAs that integrates two coupled components: (1) mode-specific action decoders built on a shared action expert, supporting multiple temporal granularities and prediction horizons, and (2) a quantizability-guided mode selection scheme which decides whether coarse execution is appropriate, and a context-conditioned router that selects an execution mode at each inference step. Experiments across three multi-task simulation benchmarks and six real-world tasks show that PaceVLA improves execution efficiency while maintaining task success rate across multiple embodiments, including long-horizon and dexterous manipulation.
papers.summary: PaceVLA针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中执行时序效率低的问题展开研究：策略从遥操作演示中学习细粒度时序模式，导致需要大量低层动作步。时间动作量化可将连续低层动作聚合为更粗粒度动作以加速执行，但若不区分何时需要精细控制，会引入速度-精度权衡，在精度敏感交互中丢弃关键运动细节。为此作者提出统一的自适应时序执行框架，包含两个耦合组件：基于共享动作专家的模式特定动作解码器，支持多种时间粒度与预测视野；以及量化性引导的模式选择方案，判断粗粒度执行是否合适，并由上下文条件路由器在每个推理步选择执行模式。在三个多任务仿真基准和六个真实任务上，方法在多种本体（含长程与灵巧操作）中提升执行效率并保持任务成功率。
papers.one_line_takeaway: PaceVLA用可量化性引导的路由在粗粒度与细粒度动作解码间自适应切换，在不牺牲成功率的前提下加速VLA机器人操作。
papers.core_method: 在共享动作专家之上构建多个模式特定的动作解码器，分别对应不同时间粒度与预测视野；引入量化性引导的模式选择机制判断当前是否适合粗粒度执行，并用上下文条件路由器在每个推理步选择执行模式，实现自适应时序执行。
innovation_points: 提出模式特定动作解码器与共享动作专家结合的多粒度、多预测视野动作生成结构
设计量化性引导的模式选择方案，显式判断粗执行是否合适，缓解速度-精度权衡
用上下文条件路由器在每步推理动态选择执行模式，实现自适应时序执行
在仿真与真实任务、多种本体上验证效率与成功率的兼顾
experiment_results: 在三个多任务仿真基准和六个真实任务上评估，覆盖长程与灵巧操作及多种本体
摘要称方法提升执行效率并保持任务成功率，但未给出具体数值指标
limitations: 摘要未提供量化加速比与成功率的具体数值，效率收益幅度不明确
模式选择依赖量化性判断，其阈值与泛化性在材料中未说明
真实任务规模为六项，跨本体泛化仍需更广泛验证
papers.practical_value: 面向机器人实际部署中对快速可靠操作的需求，PaceVLA在不重训通用策略的前提下按需加速执行，减少冗余低层动作步，对长程与精度敏感任务兼顾效率与成功率，具备工程落地参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把时间动作量化的速度-精度权衡从固定超参变为按上下文自适应决策，为VLA策略的推理效率优化提供了可复用的框架思路。

papers.title: Robot Learning with Vision-Language-Action Models for Agricultural Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation in agricultural environments remains challenging due to variations in plant geometry, occlusion, and camera viewpoints. Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) and generalist robot policies offer a promising approach to addressing these challenges by learning manipulation behaviors from multimodal observations and language instructions. However, adapting these policies to agricultural tasks requires domain-specific demonstrations, which are costly and time-consuming to collect on physical robots. In this work, we develop a simulation-to-real robot-learning framework for agricultural reaching and grasping that integrates task-specific demonstration collection and pretrained policy adaptation. A MuJoCo-based agricultural environment is developed with diverse tomato plant structures to support demonstration collection and controlled evaluation. Expert demonstrations are collected through joystick teleoperation, with a low-level controller used to execute robot actions. Two pretrained generalist robot policies, Octo and $π_{0.5}$, are adapted using simulated demonstrations, followed by further fine-tuning on a physical Franka Research 3 manipulator using real-robot demonstrations. The adapted policies are evaluated under in-distribution, viewpoint/spatial-shift, and out-of-distribution conditions in simulation, followed by physical-robot experiments. The influence of proprioceptive information on policy performance is also investigated. Results show that $π_{0.5}$ achieves higher task-performance scores than Octo and exhibits less degradation under distribution shifts. These findings demonstrate the potential of integrating pretrained generalist policies with task-specific demonstration learning for agricultural manipulation.
papers.summary: 该论文研究农业环境下机器人抓取与到达任务中，预训练视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的适配问题。针对植物几何形态多变、遮挡和视角变化等挑战，作者构建了基于MuJoCo的农业仿真环境，包含多样番茄植株结构，通过手柄遥操作采集专家演示，并配合底层控制器执行动作。研究将Octo与π_{0.5}两种预训练通用机器人策略先用仿真演示适配，再在真实Franka Research 3机械臂上用真实演示微调，并在分布内、视角/空间偏移和分布外条件下评估，同时考察本体感知信息的影响。结果显示π_{0.5}任务表现优于Octo，且在分布偏移下退化更小，表明预训练通用策略与任务特定演示学习结合可用于农业操作。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 预训练通用机器人策略经仿真演示适配与真机微调后，π_{0.5}在农业抓取任务中优于Octo且对分布偏移更鲁棒。
papers.core_method: 构建MuJoCo农业仿真环境与番茄植株场景，通过手柄遥操作采集专家演示并用底层控制器执行；将Octo和π_{0.5}两种预训练通用机器人策略先在仿真演示上适配，再在真实Franka Research 3上用真机演示微调；在分布内、视角/空间偏移和分布外条件下评估，并分析本体感知信息的作用。
innovation_points: 面向农业操作构建含多样番茄植株结构的MuJoCo仿真环境，支持演示采集与受控评估
提出仿真到真实的机器人学习框架，将任务特定演示采集与预训练通用策略适配结合
在仿真与真机上系统比较Octo和π_{0.5}在分布偏移下的表现，并考察本体感知信息影响

π_{0.5}在分布偏移下性能退化小于Octo

评估集中于番茄植株的到达与抓取任务，任务与作物类型覆盖有限
摘要未给出定量性能数据与统计显著性信息
papers.practical_value: 为农业机器人操作提供可复用的仿真到真实学习流程，说明预训练通用策略结合少量任务演示即可适配农业场景，并提示π_{0.5}在视角与空间变化下更稳健，有助于降低真机演示采集成本并指导策略选型。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作将VLA与通用机器人策略引入农业操作，并给出仿真到真实的适配与评估路径，对关注预训练策略落地、分布偏移鲁棒性和农业机器人工程化的研究者具有参考价值。

papers.title: Robotic Photography System based on Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: Modern robotic photography requires understanding photographic intent, planning camera motions, and producing aesthetically pleasing images in complex environments. We present RoboPhoto-VLA, a unified Vision-Language-Action framework that jointly models perception, reasoning, and camera control for autonomous robotic photography. RoboPhoto-VLA incorporates PhotoCoT for structured action planning and Aesthetic Direct Preference Optimization (ADPO) to align camera behaviors with human aesthetic preferences. To facilitate training and evaluation, we construct OpenPhotography, a robotic photography dataset with language-guided demonstrations. Extensive real-world experiments demonstrate that RoboPhoto-VLA produces photographs better aligned with human aesthetic preferences while generalizing effectively to unseen subjects, viewpoints, poses, and complex photographic instructions.
papers.summary: RoboPhoto-VLA 面向自主机器人摄影任务，要求系统理解摄影意图、规划相机运动并在复杂环境中生成具有审美价值的图像。作者提出统一的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，将感知、推理与相机控制联合建模；其中 PhotoCoT 负责结构化的动作规划，Aesthetic Direct Preference Optimization（ADPO）用于将相机行为与人类审美偏好对齐。为支持训练与评测，作者构建了带语言引导演示的机器人摄影数据集 OpenPhotography。真实世界实验表明，该方法生成的摄影作品更符合人类审美偏好，并能泛化到未见主体、视角、姿态及复杂摄影指令。
papers.one_line_takeaway: RoboPhoto-VLA 用统一 VLA 框架结合结构化规划与审美偏好对齐，把机器人摄影从“拍得到”推进到“拍得符合人类审美”。
papers.core_method: 提出 RoboPhoto-VLA 统一视觉-语言-动作框架，联合建模感知、推理与相机控制；引入 PhotoCoT 进行结构化动作规划，并采用 Aesthetic Direct Preference Optimization（ADPO）将相机行为与人类审美偏好对齐；同时构建带语言引导演示的 OpenPhotography 数据集用于训练与评测。
innovation_points: 将 VLA 框架统一用于机器人摄影的感知、推理与相机控制联合建模
提出 PhotoCoT 实现结构化的摄影动作规划
提出 ADPO 将相机行为与人类审美偏好直接对齐
构建 OpenPhotography 语言引导机器人摄影数据集

papers.why_it_matters: 该工作把 VLA 从操作任务拓展到审美驱动的摄影任务，并给出规划与偏好对齐的组合路线，对机器人摄影与多模态动作生成研究具有参考价值。

papers.title: Vision-Language-Delta-Action: Learning Compact Deltas as Actionable Transition Interfaces for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation is not merely observation-to-action generation, but the realization of task-specified state changes in the physical world. Existing vision-language-action (VLA) methods directly learn observation-to-action mappings, imposing a substantial learning burden due to the gap between semantic understanding and action execution. Although world-action models (WAMs) improve control through future prediction, modeling complete future states wastes capacity on static appearance and action-irrelevant changes. We propose Vision-Language-Delta-Action (VLDA), a paradigm that reformulates full future prediction as compact actionable transition modeling. Its core is a compact Delta variable that captures latent world-state changes, serving as an interface between vision-language understanding and action generation. VLDA learns Delta through a unified objective composed of the Local Transition Filter (LT-Filter) and Global Transition Anchor (GT-Anchor). LT-Filter captures task-relevant manipulation-centric changes while suppressing static reconstruction biases. GT-Anchor provides coarse future-level regularization to preserve the overall direction of state changes. Delta-Driven Action Refinement (DDAR) further grounds Delta in the action manifold and injects it as a structured seed to guide action denoising. We implement VLDA within LoongForge, an open-source training framework for large-scale foundation and embodied models, using its modular and distributed infrastructure for unified two-stage optimization. Experiments show that VLDA improves long-horizon consistency, robustness, and generalization, validating actionable Delta as an alternative to direct action prediction and full future-state modeling.
papers.summary: 该论文针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型直接学习观测到动作映射时语义理解与动作执行之间存在鸿沟、学习负担大的问题，以及世界动作模型（WAM）预测完整未来状态时浪费容量于静态外观和动作无关变化的问题，提出Vision-Language-Delta-Action（VLDA）范式，将完整未来预测重构为紧凑的可操作过渡建模。其核心是紧凑Delta变量，捕获潜在世界状态变化，作为视觉语言理解与动作生成之间的接口。VLDA通过由局部过渡滤波器（LT-Filter）和全局过渡锚点（GT-Anchor）组成的统一目标学习Delta：LT-Filter捕获任务相关的以操作为中心的变化并抑制静态重建偏差，GT-Anchor提供粗粒度未来级正则化以保持状态变化的整体方向。Delta驱动动作细化（DDAR）进一步将Delta锚定到动作流形，并作为结构化种子引导动作去噪。VLDA在开源训练框架LoongForge中实现，利用其模块化分布式基础设施进行统一两阶段优化。实验表明VLDA提升了长时程一致性、鲁棒性和泛化能力，验证了可操作Delta作为直接动作预测和完整未来状态建模替代方案的有效性。
papers.one_line_takeaway: VLDA用紧凑的潜在状态变化Delta作为视觉语言理解与动作生成之间的可操作接口，替代直接动作预测和完整未来状态建模，提升机器人操作的长时程一致性与泛化能力。
papers.core_method: 提出VLDA范式，学习紧凑Delta变量捕获潜在世界状态变化；通过LT-Filter捕获任务相关操作中心变化并抑制静态重建偏差，GT-Anchor提供粗粒度未来级正则化；DDAR将Delta锚定到动作流形并作为结构化种子引导动作去噪；在LoongForge框架中实现统一两阶段优化。
innovation_points: 将完整未来预测重构为紧凑可操作过渡建模，用Delta变量作为视觉语言理解与动作生成的接口
设计LT-Filter与GT-Anchor统一目标，分别捕获任务相关局部变化和保持全局状态变化方向
提出DDAR将Delta锚定到动作流形并作为结构化种子引导动作去噪
在LoongForge开源框架中实现模块化分布式两阶段优化
experiment_results: 实验表明VLDA提升了长时程一致性、鲁棒性和泛化能力
验证了可操作Delta作为直接动作预测和完整未来状态建模替代方案的有效性
摘要未提供具体量化指标或数据集名称
limitations: 摘要未报告具体实验数据、基线对比和消融结果，量化收益不明确
Delta变量的紧凑表示可能对复杂任务中细粒度状态变化的表达能力有限
方法依赖两阶段优化和LoongForge框架，工程实现复杂度较高
papers.practical_value: 为机器人操作提供一种介于直接动作预测与完整世界模型之间的紧凑过渡建模范式，降低语义到动作的学习负担，并借助开源LoongForge框架便于在具身智能系统中落地和复现。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作重新审视了VLA与WAM之间的设计空间，提出以紧凑Delta作为可操作过渡接口，为机器人操作中状态变化建模提供了新思路，对关注具身智能和动作生成的研究者有参考价值。

papers.title: Vision–Language–Action Models for Robotic Manipulation: A Critical Review of Design Choices, Evidence, and Emerging Frontiers
affiliations: Graduate University of Science and Technology
Vietnam Academy of Science and Technology
Trường Đại học Khoa học và Công nghệ Hà Nội
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models aim to unify perception, language grounding, and robotcontrol, yet recent progress in robotic manipulation remains difficult to compare because systems differ widely in observation modalities, action interfaces, execution regimes, control horizons, and measurement boundaries. This paper presents a representative critical review of more than 40 influential VLA systems, benchmarks, and enabling techniques that have shaped major design choices in robotic manipulation. We organize the field through a five-axis design-space taxonomy: (A) perception encoding and spatial grounding, (B) action generation, control regime, and reasoning–control interface, (C) training and adaptation, (D) data provenance and embodiment,and (E) temporal horizon and stabilization. Across these axes, we synthesize five recurring failure dimensions—visual brittleness, action degeneration, static supervised fine-tuning limitation, embodiment gaps, and long-horizon breakdown—and consolidate them into four research gaps: reasoning–action decoupling, closed-loop control under contact, spatiotemporal grounding, and data/embodiment mismatch. To support auditable cross-paper interpretation, we introduce a comparability-first reporting schema, a taxonomy coding manual, canonical pseudocode for core VLA mechanisms, and an evidence-tier policy for calibrating claims. We further critique what LIBERO, SimplerEnv, and CALVIN can and cannot establish, showing that current benchmarks remain insufficient for strong deployment-level claims about contact-rich recovery, viewpoint robustness, embodiment transfer, long-horizon stability, and end-to-end latency
papers.summary: 该综述针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中难以横向比较的问题，系统梳理了40余个代表性VLA系统、基准与使能技术。作者提出五轴设计空间分类法：感知编码与空间定位、动作生成与控制机制及推理-控制接口、训练与适配、数据来源与具身、时间跨度与稳定性。基于该框架，归纳出五类反复出现的失败维度——视觉脆弱性、动作退化、静态监督微调局限、具身鸿沟与长时程崩溃，并凝练为四个研究缺口：推理-动作解耦、接触下闭环控制、时空定位、数据/具身失配。为支持可审计的跨论文解读，文章还提出以可比性优先的报告模式、分类编码手册、核心机制伪代码与证据分级策略，并批判性分析LIBERO、SimplerEnv、CALVIN等基准的证明边界。
papers.one_line_takeaway: VLA模型进展受限于不可比的设计选择与薄弱的基准证据，需以可比性优先的报告规范和证据分级来约束部署级主张。
papers.core_method: 对40余个VLA系统、基准与使能技术进行批判性综述，构建五轴设计空间分类法（感知编码与空间定位、动作生成与控制机制、训练与适配、数据来源与具身、时间跨度与稳定性），并配套分类编码手册、核心机制伪代码、可比性优先报告模式与证据分级策略。
innovation_points: 提出覆盖感知、动作、训练、数据与时间维度的五轴VLA设计空间分类法，统一组织异构系统
归纳五类反复失败维度并凝练为四个研究缺口，形成问题导向的综述结构
引入可比性优先的报告模式、分类编码手册与证据分级策略，支持可审计的跨论文解读
系统批判LIBERO、SimplerEnv、CALVIN等基准的证明边界，明确其不能支撑的部署级主张
experiment_results: 本文为批判性综述，未开展新的实验，无自产实验数据
通过文献综合指出当前基准不足以支撑接触丰富恢复、视角鲁棒性、具身迁移、长时程稳定性和端到端延迟等强部署级主张
limitations: 综述范围限定于40余个代表性系统，可能未覆盖全部新兴VLA工作
未提供新的定量实验或统一复现结果，分类与证据分级依赖作者判断
对基准局限性的分析基于现有文献证据，未通过新实验验证
papers.practical_value: 为企业与研究者提供VLA系统设计选择的对照框架和可比性报告规范，帮助识别从基准到真实部署之间的证据缺口，指导在接触控制、具身迁移和长时程稳定性上的工程投入与评估设计。
papers.why_it_matters: 该文直面VLA领域系统异构、结论难以比较的核心痛点，给出可操作的设计空间分类、失败模式清单与证据分级策略，是评估VLA进展和规划后续研究的重要参考。

papers.title: PrismWAM: Decoupling State Representations in World Action Models
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) typically represent the world through latent embeddings from pretrained video models, which entangle heterogeneous aspects of the world, from how it looks (e.g., texture and color) to how it is physically configured (e.g., occupancy and pose). This raises an underexplored question: $\textbf{what should constitute the state of a WAM?}$ We argue that the world state should separate how the world appears from how the world evolves under action: the former captures semantic context, while the latter is governed by physical state. To this end, we propose $\textbf{PrismWAM}$, which decouples physics from semantics while jointly modeling state and action. PrismWAM factorizes an embodied task into a $\mathrm{Semantic\ Planning}\rightarrow\mathrm{Physical\ Rollout}\rightarrow\mathrm{Executable\ Action}$ pipeline: given only the initial RGB observation, semantic planning learns to predict the final goal image, while physical rollout predicts the fine-grained evolution toward this goal in depth space; executable actions are then generated from the depth rollout. Without any embodied action pretraining or additional data augmentation, PrismWAM achieves strong manipulation performance in both simulation and the real world. Notably, PrismWAM even surpasses a broad range of models with large-scale embodied action pretraining (e.g., OpenWAM-$α$). More broadly, we reframe World Action Models from modeling how the world looks to how it responds to action, paving the way for action-centric world models grounded in occupancy, flow, tactile sensing, proprioception, and beyond.
papers.summary: PrismWAM针对世界动作模型（WAM）中状态表示的核心问题展开研究：现有方法通常直接使用预训练视频模型的潜在嵌入来表示世界，但这种嵌入混杂了纹理、颜色等外观语义与占据、位姿等物理配置，导致状态定义不清。作者提出应将世界状态解耦为“世界如何呈现”（语义上下文）与“世界如何在动作下演化”（物理状态），并据此设计PrismWAM，将具身任务分解为语义规划→物理推演→可执行动作三阶段流水线：仅给定初始RGB观测，语义规划预测最终目标图像，物理推演在深度空间预测朝目标的细粒度演化，再由深度推演生成可执行动作。该方法无需具身动作预训练或额外数据增强，在仿真与真实世界操作任务中均取得较强性能，甚至超过具备大规模具身动作预训练的OpenWAM-α等模型。
papers.one_line_takeaway: PrismWAM通过将世界状态解耦为语义外观与物理演化，在无具身动作预训练下实现了优于大规模预训练基线的高效操作策略。
papers.core_method: 提出语义规划→物理推演→可执行动作的三阶段流水线：语义规划从初始RGB预测目标图像，物理推演在深度空间预测细粒度状态演化，最终由深度推演生成可执行动作，从而将物理与语义解耦并联合建模状态与动作。
innovation_points: 重新定义WAM的状态表示，明确区分“世界如何呈现”的语义上下文与“世界如何随动作演化”的物理状态
以深度空间作为物理推演的中间表示，避免视频潜在嵌入中外观与物理属性的纠缠
构建语义规划、物理推演、动作生成的分阶段可解释流水线，无需具身动作预训练
experiment_results: 在仿真与真实世界操作任务中均取得较强性能
超过包括OpenWAM-α在内的多种具备大规模具身动作预训练的模型
未提供具体量化指标，摘要仅给出定性比较结论
limitations: 物理推演依赖深度空间表示，深度感知质量可能影响动作生成效果
摘要未报告具体实验数据与消融结果，难以评估各阶段贡献
方法在更广泛具身任务（如触觉、本体感知）上的泛化性尚未验证
papers.practical_value: 为具身智能与机器人操作提供了一种无需大规模具身动作预训练即可获得强操作性能的建模范式，降低了对昂贵具身数据预训练的依赖，并提升了状态表示的可解释性与工程可控性。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作直面WAM中“状态应该是什么”这一被忽视的基础问题，提出语义与物理解耦的状态表示思路，并展示了无需具身预训练即可超越大规模预训练基线的潜力，对世界模型与动作生成交叉方向具有概念启发与工程参考价值。

papers.title: What Would Removing This Corruption Change? Failure Attribution for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are sensitive to visual corruptions, but knowing that a corruption is typically harmful does not establish whether removing it would benefit the current episode. Furthermore, when several corruptions co-occur, deciding what to correct requires understanding which ones contribute to failure risk and how much their removal would help. We define this problem as failure attribution. Detecting corruption presence alone cannot answer this question, as corruptions can be present but relatively harmless, while directly measuring removal benefits requires costly paired policy rollouts with and without the corruption present. To address this, we introduce a factorized risk model that learns separate representations of the scene and corruptions, allowing us to estimate removal benefits through latent intervention from the current image and task instruction, without paired clean images or additional counterfactual rollouts. We evaluate our approach on OpenVLA and $π_{0.5}$ in simulation and $π_{0.5}$-DROID on a Franka robot. Our method outperforms monolithic and vision-language-model (VLM) baselines, including achieving approximately 3x lower attribution error than frontier VLMs. We also demonstrate our method adapts to execution context and corruption intensity, and can be used for online failure monitoring on hardware.
papers.summary: 该论文研究视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的失败归因问题：视觉损坏通常有害，但仅检测损坏存在并不能判断移除它是否会让当前回合受益，尤其当多个损坏同时出现时，需要判断哪些损坏贡献了失败风险以及移除它们的收益有多大。作者将这一问题定义为失败归因，并提出因子化风险模型，分别学习场景与损坏的表示，从而通过潜在干预从当前图像和任务指令估计移除收益，无需成对干净图像或额外的反事实策略 rollout。在 OpenVLA 与 π0.5 仿真环境以及 Franka 机器人上的 π0.5-DROID 上评估，方法优于整体式与 VLM 基线，归因误差约为前沿 VLM 的 1/3，并能适应执行上下文与损坏强度，可用于硬件在线失败监控。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 提出因子化风险模型，无需成对干净图像或反事实 rollout 即可估计视觉损坏移除收益，实现 VLA 失败归因。
papers.core_method: 学习场景与损坏的分离表示，构建因子化风险模型；通过潜在干预从当前图像和任务指令估计移除某损坏后的收益，避免成对干净图像与额外策略 rollout。
innovation_points: 将 VLA 对视觉损坏的敏感性问题形式化为失败归因，区分损坏存在与移除收益。
提出因子化风险模型，分离场景与损坏表示，支持潜在干预估计。
无需成对干净图像或反事实策略 rollout 即可估计移除收益。
在仿真与真实 Franka 机器人上验证，并支持在线失败监控。
experiment_results: 在 OpenVLA 和 π0.5 仿真及 π0.5-DROID 的 Franka 机器人上评估，方法优于整体式与 VLM 基线。
归因误差约为前沿 VLM 的 1/3。
方法能适应执行上下文与损坏强度，并可用于硬件在线失败监控。
limitations: 评估主要覆盖 OpenVLA、π0.5 与 π0.5-DROID，未说明对其他 VLA 架构的泛化性。
摘要未给出真实机器人任务规模、损坏类型覆盖范围与在线监控延迟等工程指标。
潜在干预估计依赖学习到的因子化表示，其因果有效性未在摘要中量化。
papers.practical_value: 为 VLA 部署提供在线失败监控与损坏纠正优先级判断能力，帮助机器人在多损坏共存时决定优先修正哪一项，减少昂贵成对 rollout 需求。
papers.why_it_matters: VLA 对视觉损坏敏感，但检测损坏不等于知道移除收益；该工作把失败归因做成可在线估计的潜在干预问题，对机器人可靠部署与调试有直接价值。

papers.title: BetaMem: Learning to Remember a Changing World for Embodied Agents
affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
papers.abstract: Long-horizon embodied agents face temporal confusion and incomplete or distorted records, recurring errors from fixed memory rules, and growing storage and retrieval costs. We present BetaMem, a framework for building and evolving traceable long-term memory through six linked layers: working, spatial, entity, episodic, experiential, and procedural memory. A dual-level write contract constrains operation executability and source support for content: supervised fine-tuning learns compliant memory operations, while reinforcement learning combines repeated sampling with teacher verification of the original observations to reward complete, accurate records and penalize omissions, distortion, and unsupported content. We formulate failure-driven policy recursive self-improvement through diagnosis along the causal sequence of memory operations and local rule repairs gated by independent replay. Atomic tools frame storage, updates, retrieval, and forgetting as cost-utility allocation under storage and read budgets. Using the open-source Qwen3.5-9B model for memory generation, BetaMem achieves overall scores of 48.08% on M3-Bench-robot, 92.08% on LoCoMo, 72.6% on OpenEQA EM-EQA, and 62.4% on EgoLifeQA, the highest among the listed memory methods under their respective evaluation protocols. Training the model for memory generation raises the contract pass rate from 50.9% to 86.2% while reducing output tokens per stored action by 47.3%. A separate Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct evaluation on EMem-Bench achieves an average success rate of 38.4% and an average error recurrence rate of 24.9%. We perform best among evaluated methods using comparably sized open-source models. Category results show that we have advantages in integrating information across observations, recalling events over long histories, and inferring personal habits.
papers.summary: BetaMem针对长时程具身智能体在长期记忆中面临的时间混淆、记录不完整或失真、固定记忆规则导致错误复现以及存储与检索成本增长等问题，提出通过工作、空间、实体、情节、经验和程序六层联动结构构建可追溯且可演化的长期记忆。方法上采用双层写入契约约束记忆操作的可执行性与内容来源支撑，先用监督微调学习合规记忆操作，再用强化学习结合重复采样与教师对原始观测的验证来奖励完整准确记录、惩罚遗漏失真与无依据内容；同时以失败驱动的策略递归自我改进，沿记忆操作因果序列诊断并由独立回放门控局部规则修复，原子工具将存储、更新、检索和遗忘建模为预算约束下的成本效用分配。实验使用Qwen3.5-9B生成记忆，在M3-Bench-robot、LoCoMo、OpenEQA EM-EQA和EgoLifeQA上分别取得48.08%、92.08%、72.6%和62.4%的总体得分，为所列记忆方法中最高；训练使契约通过率从50.9%升至86.2%，每存储动作输出token减少47.3%；Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct在EMem-Bench上平均成功率38.4%、平均错误复现率24.9%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: BetaMem用六层可追溯记忆、双层写入契约和失败驱动的策略自改进，在受限预算下提升具身智能体长期记忆的准确性与一致性。
papers.core_method: 构建工作、空间、实体、情节、经验和程序六层联动长期记忆；以双层写入契约约束操作可执行性和内容来源支撑；监督微调学习合规记忆操作，强化学习结合重复采样与教师对原始观测的验证奖励完整准确记录；失败驱动策略递归自我改进，沿记忆操作因果序列诊断并由独立回放门控局部规则修复；原子工具将存储、更新、检索和遗忘建模为存储与读取预算下的成本效用分配。
innovation_points: 提出六层联动、可追溯且可演化的长期记忆框架，覆盖从工作记忆到程序记忆的完整层次
设计双层写入契约，同时约束记忆操作的可执行性与内容来源支撑，减少无依据记录
结合监督微调与基于教师验证原始观测的强化学习，奖励完整准确记录并惩罚遗漏、失真和无支撑内容
