papers.why_it_matters: 该工作通过受控消融纠正了多任务操作策略比较中的归因混淆，明确指出视觉表示是性能主导因素，为紧凑高效策略设计提供了可复现的实验依据。

papers.title: PAIR: Bridging Perception and Action in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions to continuous robot actions. This task requires a transition from representations that describe the scene and instruction to representations that support action generation. Many continuous-action VLAs leave this transition implicit and supervise it mainly through the final action-prediction loss. We introduce PAIR, a framework that learns a shared perception-action representation between these two spaces. During training, a Masked Action Autoencoder encodes expert action chunks into horizon-aligned Action Latent Tokens. A Bridge Module extracts task-relevant features from the current visual-language representations. PAIR aligns these features with the Action Latent Tokens to form Bridge Tokens that preserve task information and capture the structure of expert actions. The Bridge Tokens are then projected into the action-token space and injected into the initial Action Tokens, providing an action-ready starting point for Action Expert refinement. At inference, the autoencoder is removed, and the Bridge Tokens are generated only from the current observation and instruction. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and CALVIN ABC-D show gains for the evaluated OpenVLA-OFT and VLA-Adapter models. On LIBERO-Plus, PAIR raises VLA-Adapter's success rate from 59.1% to 64.2%. On CALVIN, it increases VLA-Adapter's average completed sequence length from 4.42 to 4.53. Across seven real-world tasks, PAIR raises OpenVLA-OFT's success rate from 51.4% to 65.0%. Representation analyses show that Bridge Tokens retain task information while making continuous-action information accessible before Action Expert refinement. These results support a shared intermediate representation as a useful interface between perception and action in continuous-action VLAs.
papers.summary: PAIR针对连续动作视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中感知表征到动作表征转换主要依赖最终动作预测损失隐式监督的问题，提出学习共享的感知-动作中间表征。训练时用掩码动作自编码器将专家动作块编码为与预测时域对齐的Action Latent Tokens；Bridge Module从当前视觉-语言表征中提取任务相关特征，并与Action Latent Tokens对齐形成Bridge Tokens，再投影到动作token空间注入初始Action Tokens，为Action Expert细化提供动作就绪起点。推理时移除自编码器，仅由当前观测与指令生成Bridge Tokens。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和CALVIN ABC-D上对OpenVLA-OFT与VLA-Adapter评估均有提升，并在七个真实任务上提高成功率。
papers.one_line_takeaway: PAIR通过可学习的共享感知-动作中间表征，把连续动作VLA中隐式的感知到动作转换显式化，在仿真与真实任务上稳定提升成功率。
papers.core_method: 训练阶段使用Masked Action Autoencoder将专家动作块编码为horizon对齐的Action Latent Tokens；Bridge Module从视觉-语言表征提取任务相关特征，与Action Latent Tokens对齐生成Bridge Tokens；Bridge Tokens投影到动作token空间并注入初始Action Tokens，交由Action Expert细化。推理时去掉自编码器，仅从当前观测和指令生成Bridge Tokens。
innovation_points: 提出共享感知-动作表征框架，将连续动作VLA中原本隐式的感知到动作转换显式建模为中间表征对齐。
设计Masked Action Autoencoder生成与预测时域对齐的Action Latent Tokens，为动作结构提供可监督的潜在目标。
Bridge Module将视觉-语言特征与动作潜在token对齐并注入初始Action Tokens，形成动作就绪的起点。
推理阶段移除自编码器，Bridge Tokens仅由观测和指令生成，保持部署时无额外动作编码依赖。
experiment_results: LIBERO-Plus上VLA-Adapter成功率从59.1%提升到64.2%。
CALVIN ABC-D上VLA-Adapter平均完成序列长度从4.42提升到4.53。
七个真实世界任务上OpenVLA-OFT成功率从51.4%提升到65.0%；表征分析显示Bridge Tokens保留任务信息并使连续动作信息在Action Expert细化前可访问。
limitations: 实验主要围绕OpenVLA-OFT与VLA-Adapter两类模型评估，对其他VLA架构的泛化性未在给定材料中说明。
真实世界评估为七个任务，任务多样性与规模有限，更大规模场景下的稳定性未给出。
推理虽移除自编码器，但训练依赖专家动作块编码，对动作数据质量与对齐方式的敏感性未在材料中分析。
papers.practical_value: PAIR提供了一种可插拔的中间表征接口，训练时利用专家动作结构，推理时仅依赖观测与指令，不增加部署期动作编码器，适合作为连续动作VLA模型的增强模块以提升真实机器人任务成功率。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把连续动作VLA中常被隐式监督的感知到动作转换显式化为共享中间表征，并给出仿真与真实任务的一致增益，为VLA表征接口设计提供了可复用的思路。

papers.title: StairVLA: Stage-Aware Hierarchical Action Generation for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly rely on diffusion- or flow-matching-based action heads to generate continuous robot actions. These action heads typically process the denoising trajectory in a largely uniform manner. However, we observe that the conditioning focus naturally shifts across denoising stages: early stages combine language instructions and visual observations to establish a coarse action trajectory, whereas later stages place greater emphasis on current visual observations for action alignment. Based on this insight, we introduce StairVLA, a stage-aware hierarchical action generation framework that uses partially denoised actions as a natural interface between coarse long-horizon action generation and local refinement. A high-level VLA performs early denoising to produce a reusable long-horizon partially denoised action trajectory, while a lightweight refiner operates at a higher frequency to refine local action chunks using the latest observations. This design amortizes expensive high-level VLA computation while preserving frequent closed-loop correction. On LIBERO, our GR00T-style instantiation improves average success from 96.5% to 97.8% while reducing amortized inference latency from 115.0 ms to 44.2 ms per action chunk. More broadly, across two VLA backbones, simulation benchmarks, and real-robot tasks, StairVLA consistently reduces inference cost while maintaining strong task performance.
papers.summary: StairVLA针对扩散/流匹配动作头在去噪过程中条件关注随阶段变化的现象——早期阶段主要结合语言指令与视觉观测建立粗粒度动作轨迹，后期阶段更依赖当前视觉观测进行动作对齐——提出阶段感知的分层动作生成框架。该方法以部分去噪动作作为高层长时程生成与局部精修之间的自然接口：高层VLA仅执行早期去噪，产出可复用的长时程部分去噪动作轨迹；轻量级精修器以更高频率、利用最新观测对局部动作块进行精修。该设计将昂贵的高层VLA计算摊销，同时保留频繁的闭环修正能力。在LIBERO上，GR00T风格实例将平均成功率从96.5%提升至97.8%，并将每个动作块的摊销推理延迟从115.0 ms降至44.2 ms；在两个VLA骨干、仿真基准和真实机器人任务上，方法一致降低推理成本并保持较强任务性能。
papers.one_line_takeaway: StairVLA利用去噪阶段的条件关注差异，将高层VLA的早期去噪与轻量精修器解耦，在保持任务成功率的同时显著降低摊销推理延迟。
papers.core_method: 将扩散/流匹配动作头的去噪轨迹按阶段拆分：高层VLA执行早期去噪，生成可复用的长时程部分去噪动作轨迹；轻量级精修器以更高频率接收最新视觉观测，对局部动作块进行后期去噪精修，部分去噪动作作为两级之间的接口。
innovation_points: 观察到去噪不同阶段的条件关注自然转移：早期偏语言指令与视觉观测建立粗轨迹，后期偏当前视觉观测做动作对齐
以部分去噪动作作为高层长时程生成与低层局部精修之间的自然接口，实现计算摊销与闭环修正的兼顾
高层VLA低频执行、轻量精修器高频运行的分层异步架构，降低昂贵VLA计算的调用频率
experiment_results: LIBERO上GR00T风格实例平均成功率从96.5%提升至97.8%
每动作块摊销推理延迟从115.0 ms降至44.2 ms
在两个VLA骨干、仿真基准和真实机器人任务上一致降低推理成本并保持较强任务性能
limitations: 摘要未给出真实机器人任务的量化成功率与延迟数据
方法依赖对去噪阶段条件关注转移的观察，阶段划分与精修器设计可能需按骨干和任务调参
未报告与其它分层或异步VLA推理加速方法的系统性对比
papers.practical_value: 面向机器人部署中对高频闭环控制与有限算力的双重需求，StairVLA通过摊销高层VLA计算、以轻量精修器维持高频修正，在LIBERO上同时提升成功率并大幅降低每动作块延迟，为VLA线上推理降本提供可复用范式。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把扩散/流匹配动作头的去噪阶段特性转化为系统级推理加速机会，在不牺牲闭环修正的前提下显著降低VLA推理成本，对VLA工程落地具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: VLA-ACL: Action-Consistent Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong robotic manipulation performance but incur high computational costs from processing long token sequences at every control step, limiting real-time deployment. Visual token pruning offers a direct solution, as visual patches dominate the input sequence and contain considerable redundancy. Existing approaches, however, either rely on indirect training-free heuristics, such as attention scores and motion thresholds, or require costly fine-tuning of the base VLA model. We introduce VLA-ACL (Action Consistency Learning), which learns a lightweight visual token pruning policy through action-level supervision while keeping the base VLA model entirely frozen. The training objective encourages actions produced from pruned visual contexts to remain consistent with the full-context teacher, with ground-truth actions as auxiliary supervision. This directly ties token selection to its effect on the downstream control output. Experiments on LIBERO and real-world manipulation tasks show that VLA-ACL prunes up to 87.5% of visual tokens while retaining competitive performance, reduces computation by up to 75%, and achieves a 1.5x inference speedup. These results establish a stronger performance-efficiency trade-off than existing frozen-VLA pruning methods and demonstrate the value of action-level supervision for visual token selection. Code is available at https://github.com/du-owen/VLA-ACL.
papers.summary: VLA-ACL针对视觉-语言-动作模型在每一步控制中处理长token序列导致计算开销大、难以实时部署的问题，提出以动作级监督学习轻量视觉token剪枝策略，同时完全冻结基座VLA模型。其训练目标要求剪枝视觉上下文产生的动作与全上下文教师模型保持一致，并以真实动作作为辅助监督，从而将token选择直接关联到下游控制输出，避免依赖注意力分数、运动阈值等间接启发式或昂贵的基座微调。在LIBERO和真实机器人操作任务上，该方法最多剪除87.5%的视觉token仍保持有竞争力的性能，计算量最多降低75%，推理加速1.5倍，优于现有冻结VLA剪枝方法。
papers.one_line_takeaway: VLA-ACL用动作级一致性监督学习视觉token剪枝策略，在冻结基座VLA的前提下实现最高87.5%剪枝率、75%计算削减和1.5倍推理加速。
papers.core_method: 保持基座VLA模型完全冻结，训练一个轻量视觉token剪枝策略网络；以全上下文教师模型输出的动作为一致性目标，真实动作作为辅助监督，使剪枝后视觉上下文产生的动作与教师保持一致，从而将token选择与下游控制效果直接绑定。
innovation_points: 以动作级监督替代注意力分数、运动阈值等间接无训练启发式来学习视觉token剪枝策略
基座VLA完全冻结，仅训练轻量剪枝策略，避免昂贵的基座模型微调
将token选择与下游控制输出直接关联，用全上下文教师动作做一致性约束
experiment_results: 在LIBERO和真实机器人操作任务上，最多剪除87.5%视觉token仍保持有竞争力的性能
计算量最多降低75%，推理加速1.5倍
性能-效率权衡优于现有冻结VLA剪枝方法
limitations: 摘要未给出各任务上的具体成功率数值与方差，性能对比细节有限
仅在LIBERO与真实操作任务上验证，未覆盖更广泛的VLA基座与场景
剪枝策略需额外训练，依赖全上下文教师推理生成监督信号
papers.practical_value: 面向机器人实时部署场景，在不重新训练基座VLA的情况下显著降低每步控制的计算量并提升推理速度，为视觉token冗余严重的VLA流水线提供可直接叠加的轻量加速模块。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把视觉token剪枝从间接启发式转为动作级监督学习，在冻结基座模型下取得更强的性能-效率权衡，为VLA实时部署提供了可复用的剪枝范式。

papers.title: VeriFine: Scaling Verification for Self-Improvement in Embodied Reasoning
papers.abstract: Self-improving policies continually expose new failure patterns, changing what their judges must be able to verify. However, current fixed judges constrain both optimization feedback and the discovery of useful training examples, limiting further self-improvement. This challenge is even more acute in embodied reasoning, where reliable evaluation must account for spatial grounding, causal reasoning, and safety-aware decision-making. We introduce VeriFine, an agent harness framework that scales verification through the co-evolution of the policy, training curriculum, and judge. The Policy Improvement Loop uses a rubric judge to diagnose recurring failures, construct an adaptive curriculum, and optimize the policy. When progress plateaus and verification becomes a bottleneck, the Judge Improvement Loop selectively queries human guidance on informative failure cases and refines the judge through coactive calibration, in which humans and agents resolve disagreements and converge toward the objective rubric of physical reasoning. The revised judge then guides the next stage of data selection and policy optimization. Experiments on driving and robot navigation tasks demonstrate continuous self-improvement in both policy and judge capability across reinforcement and supervised fine-tuning. These results show how scaling verification supports continuous self-improvement as policy failure patterns evolve.
papers.summary: VeriFine针对自改进策略不断暴露新失败模式、固定评判器成为优化反馈与训练样本发现瓶颈的问题，提出智能体框架，通过策略、训练课程与评判器协同演化来扩展验证能力。其策略改进循环用评分标准评判器诊断反复出现的失败、构建自适应课程并优化策略；当进展停滞且验证成为瓶颈时，评判器改进循环选择性查询人类指导，通过协同校准让人类与智能体解决分歧，收敛到物理推理的客观评分标准，再用修订后的评判器指导下一阶段数据选择与策略优化。在驾驶与机器人导航任务上，强化学习与监督微调均显示策略和评判器能力持续自改进。
papers.one_line_takeaway: VeriFine用策略-课程-评判器协同演化把验证从固定瓶颈变成可扩展的自改进引擎。
papers.core_method: 智能体harness框架：策略改进循环以评分标准评判器诊断失败、构建自适应课程并优化策略；评判器改进循环在验证瓶颈时选择性查询人类指导，通过协同校准解决分歧并收敛到物理推理客观评分标准，再驱动数据选择与策略优化。
innovation_points: 提出策略、训练课程与评判器三者协同演化的自改进框架，突破固定评判器对优化反馈和训练样本发现的限制
设计评判器改进循环，在进展停滞时选择性查询人类指导，通过协同校准收敛到客观评分标准
将验证扩展机制应用于具身推理，覆盖空间 grounding、因果推理与安全感知决策
experiment_results: 在驾驶与机器人导航任务上，强化学习和监督微调均观察到策略与评判器能力的持续自改进；摘要未给出具体量化指标
limitations: 摘要未报告具体量化结果与统计显著性
人类指导查询的选择策略与协同校准成本未在摘要中说明
实验仅覆盖驾驶与机器人导航任务，泛化性待验证
papers.practical_value: 为具身智能策略自改进提供可扩展验证框架，通过评判器与课程协同演化降低对固定人工评估的依赖，并选择性引入人类指导以控制标注成本，适用于驾驶与机器人导航等安全敏感场景的持续迭代。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把评判器从静态评估工具变为与策略共同进化的组件，为自改进系统在失败模式演化下保持验证有效性提供了可操作路径，对具身推理与强化学习后训练均有参考价值。

papers.title: Beyond Task Intelligence: Artificial Intelligence, Embodied Robotics, and the Epistemic Limits of Machine Cultural Understanding
papers.abstract: Abstract Even though artificial intelligence is becoming more and more capable of surpassing humans on specific cognitive and physical tests, remarkable task performance does not always equate to general, situated, or epistemically responsible intelligence. This paradox is evident in modern humanoid robotics, which can outperform humans in running, jumping, and other specialised tasks while still being susceptible to common manipulation, recovery, and interaction issues. A parallel tension is revealed by multimodal systems and large language models. Although they are capable of information retrieval, translation, qualitative material coding, literary evidence retrieval, image generation, synthesis of scholarship, and support for scientific discovery, empirical research still reveals hallucinated citations, cultural and contextual errors, interpretive flaws, representational stereotypes, and systematic biases. The fundamental problem, according to this article, is not a lack of computational knowledge but rather the difference between benchmarkable task competence and the situated, relational, historical, embodied, and reflexive nature of human knowledge. Drawing on embodied cognition, situated action, tacit knowledge, situated knowledges, thick description, distributed cognition, hermeneutics, representation theory, archival studies, science and technology studies, digital humanities, and contemporary AI evaluation research, the article distinguishes task competence, contextual competence, and epistemic competence. It proposes that future AI evaluation must examine provenance, uncertainty, interpretive plurality, cultural authority, absence, temporality, embodied context, conceptual framing, and the capacity to recognise when questions themselves are malformed. Rather than claiming that such limitations are permanently unsolvable, the article distinguishes engineering problems from problems requiring evaluation architectures and questions concerning authority, value, participation, and interpretation. It concludes that the humanities should become an intellectual environment for testing what general intelligence means.
categories: Ethics and Social Impacts of AI
papers.summary: 该文针对当代AI与机器人系统在特定任务上超越人类、却在情境理解与文化解释上频繁失误的悖论展开分析。作者指出，问题不在于计算知识不足，而在于可基准测试的任务能力与人类知识的情境性、关系性、历史性、具身性和反身性之间存在鸿沟。文章综合具身认知、情境行动、默会知识、情境化知识、厚描述、分布式认知、诠释学、表征理论、档案研究、STS、数字人文与当代AI评估研究，区分任务能力、语境能力与认知能力三个层次，并提出未来AI评估应考察来源溯源、不确定性、解释多元性、文化权威、缺席、时间性、具身语境、概念框架以及识别问题本身是否失当的能力。文章未报告实验数据，属于理论性论述，并强调应区分工程问题与需要评估架构及权威、价值、参与、解释问题的议题，主张人文学科应成为检验通用智能含义的思想环境。
papers.one_line_takeaway: AI的任务能力不等于情境化与认知责任意义上的智能，评估体系需从基准分数转向来源、不确定性、解释多元性与文化权威等维度。
papers.core_method: 概念分析与理论综合：以具身认知、情境行动、默会知识、情境化知识、厚描述、分布式认知、诠释学、表征理论、档案研究、STS与数字人文等为理论资源，结合当代AI评估研究，构建任务能力—语境能力—认知能力的三层区分框架，并提出面向来源、不确定性、解释多元性、文化权威、缺席、时间性、具身语境与概念框架的评估维度。
innovation_points: 提出任务能力、语境能力与认知能力的三层区分，将AI局限从计算知识问题重新定位为知识性质差异问题
将人文学科理论资源系统引入AI评估讨论，提出涵盖来源溯源、不确定性、解释多元性、文化权威、缺席与时间性等维度的评估议程
区分工程问题与需要评估架构及权威、价值、参与、解释问题的议题，避免将局限简单归为永久不可解
主张人文学科应成为检验通用智能含义的思想环境，而非仅作为应用领域
experiment_results: 本文为理论性论文，未报告任何实验数据或定量结果
文中引述的机器人操作恢复问题、幻觉引用、文化语境错误与表征刻板印象等均为对已有实证研究的定性归纳，非本文实验产出
limitations: 文章为概念性论述，未提供新的实证数据或可操作的评估指标量化方案
所提评估维度（如来源、缺席、时间性）尚未给出具体测量方法与验证流程
对工程问题与评估架构问题的边界划分主要停留在概念层面，缺乏案例层面的系统检验
papers.practical_value: 为AI评估体系设计者提供超越基准分数的多维评估框架思路，提示在文化敏感、知识溯源与解释多元场景中应关注来源、不确定性与文化权威等维度；同时为机器人系统在真实交互环境中的能力边界沟通提供概念工具，帮助区分可工程化改进的问题与需要价值与参与讨论的问题。
papers.why_it_matters: 该文将AI能力讨论从任务性能拉回知识论层面，提醒研究者和实践者：基准测试的高分不能代表情境化理解与认知责任。其提出的三层能力区分与多维评估议程，对构建更负责任的AI评估体系具有概念启发价值，也为人文学科参与AI研究提供了明确切入点。

papers.title: A BI-DIRECTIONAL BRIDGE BETWEEN MUJOCO AND NVIDIA ISAAC SIM FOR DIGITAL-TWIN-POWERED LHC ROBOTIC INTERVENTIONS
papers.abstract: No single simulation tool provides both trusted physics and a photorealistic digital twin of the LHC. MuJoCo is fast and accurate for contact dynamics but has very minimal rendering. NVIDIA Isaac Sim renders CERN's digital twins in high delity but is less specialised for research-grade contact simulation. This report presents a bi-directional bridge that connects the two: MuJoCo remains the single source of truth for physics and runs the control loop, while Isaac Sim acts as a live mirror, displaying the robot inside the LHC tunnel digital twin. State (base pose and joint angles) and commands (velocity or joint targets) are exchanged over two one-way ZeroMQ channels at approximately 60 Hz. The design is robot-agnostic, meaning it was validated both on CERNbot2, a collimator-maintenance robot imported from CAD and rigged by hand in NVIDIA Isaac Sim into a controllable articulation, and on a Unitree Go2 quadruped imported directly from the MuJoCo Menagerie and driven live with a game controller. A collision-detection layer, a movement controller, and an inverse-kinematics arm controller are also described.
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.summary: 该论文针对大型强子对撞机（LHC）机器人干预任务中单一仿真工具无法同时提供可信物理与高逼真数字孪生的问题，提出了一种连接MuJoCo与NVIDIA Isaac Sim的双向桥接系统。MuJoCo作为物理仿真的唯一真实源并运行控制循环，Isaac Sim则作为实时镜像，在LHC隧道数字孪生中显示机器人。系统通过两个单向ZeroMQ通道以约60 Hz交换状态（基座位姿和关节角）与命令（速度或关节目标），且设计具有机器人无关性，在CERNbot2和Unitree Go2四足机器人上进行了验证。此外，还描述了碰撞检测层、运动控制器和逆运动学手臂控制器。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 提出了一种MuJoCo与Isaac Sim的双向桥接方案，兼顾可信物理与高逼真渲染，并验证了机器人无关性。
papers.core_method: 通过两个单向ZeroMQ通道以约60 Hz频率交换状态和命令，MuJoCo负责物理仿真与控制循环，Isaac Sim作为实时可视化镜像，实现双向桥接。
innovation_points: 提出MuJoCo与Isaac Sim的双向桥接架构，结合MuJoCo的接触动力学精度与Isaac Sim的高保真渲染。
设计机器人无关的桥接接口，并在CERNbot2和Unitree Go2两种机器人上验证。
集成碰撞检测层、运动控制器和逆运动学手臂控制器，支持实际干预任务。
experiment_results: 在CERNbot2和Unitree Go2上成功验证了桥接系统的实时性（约60 Hz）和机器人无关性。
未提供定量性能数据（如延迟、精度等），仅通过演示验证可行性。
limitations: 未提供定量实验数据评估桥接系统的性能（如延迟、同步误差等）。
仅通过两个机器人案例验证，泛化性需进一步测试。
未讨论桥接系统在复杂接触场景下的物理一致性。
papers.practical_value: 为LHC机器人干预任务提供了一种兼顾物理精度与视觉逼真的仿真框架，支持机器人无关的快速集成，可降低真实部署风险。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作解决了数字孪生中物理真实性与视觉保真度的矛盾，为高能物理等复杂环境下的机器人仿真与操作提供了实用方案。

papers.title: MANUSH Superintelligence: The Blueprint for Embodied Intelligence, Humanoid Robots, and the Future of Humankind
papers.abstract: Abstract Foundation models have made machines fluent in language and images, but intelligence that acts reliably in the physical world remains largely unsolved. This blueprint and position paper presents MANUSH, a framework for embodied intelligence built on a six-stage loop (sense, understand, reason, plan, act, learn). In it, a single shared policy is conditioned on a description of each robot's body, so one intelligence can run humanoids, quadrupeds, service robots, industrial arms and autonomous machines. An independent safety layer, SafeCore, sets limits that no learned component can override. The paper brings together the mathematics of robot motion, dynamics, balance and control, then works through a full sizing cascade for a 1.70 m, 60 kg reference humanoid. These design analyses are computed, not measured. They show that a 120 N·m knee is achievable with a 100:1 strain-wave actuator but has almost no thermal margin at 45 °C, and that a 1.26 kWh battery gives about 2.2 hours at an average draw of 485 W. They also show that certified safety cannot rest on a learned policy alone, and that a shared intelligence platform pays off only across fleets of thousands of robots. The paper sets out a learning and data engine, a quantitative safety case, deployment economics, a 2026–2046 roadmap and ten open problems. It argues that robots should be built to amplify human capability rather than replace it. Keywords: embodied AI; humanoid robots; cross-embodiment learning; legged locomotion; robot safety; vision-language-action models; India
papers.venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
papers.summary: 该文是一篇具身智能与人形机器人的蓝图与立场论文，提出MANUSH框架：以感知、理解、推理、规划、行动、学习六阶段闭环组织具身智能，并用单一共享策略以机器人身体描述为条件，实现跨形态（人形、四足、服务机器人、工业臂、自主机器）复用同一智能。论文给出独立安全层SafeCore，设定任何学习组件不可覆盖的硬约束，并系统梳理机器人运动学、动力学、平衡与控制数学，对1.70米、60公斤参考人形完成完整尺寸级联设计分析。作者强调这些设计分析为计算而非实测：120 N·m膝关节可由100:1谐波减速执行器实现，但在45 °C下几乎无热裕度；1.26 kWh电池在平均485 W功耗下约续航2.2小时。论文还讨论学习与数据引擎、定量安全论证、部署经济性、2026–2046路线图与十个开放问题，主张机器人应增强而非替代人类能力。
papers.one_line_takeaway: MANUSH以跨形态共享策略加不可覆盖的安全层，给出人形机器人从控制数学到部署经济的系统蓝图，但关键设计数字均为计算而非实测。
papers.core_method: 提出六阶段具身智能闭环（感知、理解、推理、规划、行动、学习），以机器人身体描述为条件训练单一共享策略实现跨形态控制；叠加独立安全层SafeCore提供学习组件不可覆盖的硬限制；结合机器人运动学、动力学、平衡与控制数学，对参考人形执行尺寸级联设计分析，并配套学习数据引擎、安全论证与部署经济性框架。
innovation_points: 跨形态共享策略：以身体描述为条件，让同一智能运行人形、四足、服务机器人、工业臂与自主机器
独立安全层SafeCore：安全约束不依赖学习策略，任何学习组件不可覆盖
完整尺寸级联设计分析：对1.70米、60公斤参考人形给出关节、执行器、热与电池续航的定量推算
系统化蓝图：整合学习数据引擎、定量安全案例、部署经济性、2026–2046路线图与十个开放问题
experiment_results: 无实测实验数据；论文明确设计分析为计算而非测量
计算显示120 N·m膝关节可由100:1谐波减速执行器实现，但在45 °C下几乎无热裕度
计算显示1.26 kWh电池在平均485 W功耗下续航约2.2小时
limitations: 关键设计数字均为计算推算，缺少硬件实测与真实场景验证
共享智能平台的经济性依赖数千台机器人规模，小规模部署难以体现价值
作为蓝图与立场论文，未提供跨形态策略的实证性能或安全层的形式化验证结果
papers.practical_value: 为具身智能与人形机器人研发提供可操作的系统架构参考：六阶段闭环与跨形态共享策略指明软件复用路径，SafeCore强调安全必须独立于学习组件，尺寸级联分析给出关节、热管理与电池续航的工程权衡起点，部署经济性讨论则提示平台价值依赖规模化机队。
papers.why_it_matters: 该文把具身智能从单一形态 demo 提升到跨形态平台与安全架构层面，并诚实标注设计数字为计算而非实测；对关注人形机器人工程约束、安全论证与部署经济的读者，提供了结构化的路线图与开放问题清单。

papers.title: Encoded but Not in Control: Revealing the Grounding Gap in Vision-Language Robot Policies
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China
papers.abstract: Instruction following is central to language-conditioned robot policies: language should determine what to do when the same scene permits multiple valid actions. Yet successful execution alone cannot establish whether a policy follows the instruction or infers the task from the scene. We study this ambiguity through scene-preserving instruction interventions, using valid target substitutions, arbitrary nouns, and unrelated sentences while holding the scene fixed. We evaluate vision-language-action (VLA) policies and world-action models (WAMs) in simulation and in real-world experiments. Our analysis addresses three questions: (a) Does task success imply instruction following? When instructions request a different visible object, all evaluated policies predominantly approach and pick up the incorrect original target associated with the scene. (b) Is this failure caused by language insensitivity? Instruction perturbations affect task performance. A layerwise action lens shows intermediate action predictions respond to these perturbations. Linear probes accurately recover instructed targets, indicating modified instructions are encoded despite rarely determining target selection. (c) Why does encoded language fail to control action? Attention analysis indicates weak instruction-token contributions to action generation. Target-token attention can remain focused on the original object, revealing a mismatch between target encoding and visual grounding. UMAP and shared non-negative matrix factorization show target information remains accessible within representations increasingly organized by scene identity. Our findings expose a grounding gap concealed by nominal success and provide a diagnostic framework. They further establish a concrete criterion for progress: policies should reliably follow valid changes in user intent, even when they conflict with scene-favored behavior.
papers.summary: 该论文研究语言条件机器人策略是否真正遵循指令，而非仅凭场景推断任务。作者提出场景保持的指令干预方法，在固定场景下替换有效目标、使用任意名词或无关句子，系统评估视觉-语言-动作策略（VLA）与世界动作模型（WAM），覆盖仿真与真实实验。结果显示：当指令要求不同可见物体时，所有被评估策略仍主要接近并抓取场景关联的原始目标，说明任务成功不等于指令遵循。进一步分析表明，指令扰动确实影响任务表现，逐层动作透镜显示中间动作预测对扰动有响应，线性探针能准确恢复被指令目标，说明修改后的指令已被编码；但注意力分析显示指令token对动作生成贡献微弱，目标token注意力仍集中于原始物体，目标编码与视觉 grounding 之间存在错配。UMAP与共享非负矩阵分解显示目标信息仍可访问，但表征日益按场景身份组织。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 机器人策略能编码指令却不由指令控制动作，暴露出被名义成功率掩盖的grounding gap。
papers.core_method: 采用场景保持的指令干预实验：在固定场景下进行有效目标替换、任意名词替换和无关句子注入，评估VLA策略与WAM在仿真和真实环境中的表现；结合逐层动作透镜、线性探针、注意力分析、UMAP与共享非负矩阵分解，诊断语言编码、动作生成与视觉grounding之间的关系。
innovation_points: 提出场景保持的指令干预范式，将任务成功与指令遵循解耦，揭示名义成功掩盖的grounding gap
结合逐层动作透镜与线性探针，证明修改指令在中间表征中被编码但很少决定目标选择
通过注意力分析定位失败机制：指令token对动作生成贡献弱，目标token注意力固着于场景原始物体
给出可操作的进展判据：策略应在用户意图有效变化时可靠遵循，即使与场景偏好行为冲突
experiment_results: 当指令要求不同可见物体时，所有被评估策略仍主要接近并抓取场景关联的原始目标，任务成功不能证明指令遵循
指令扰动影响任务表现，逐层动作透镜显示中间动作预测对扰动有响应，线性探针能准确恢复被指令目标
注意力分析显示指令token对动作生成贡献弱，目标token注意力可保持聚焦原始物体；UMAP与共享NMF显示表征日益按场景身份组织
limitations: 研究聚焦于场景保持的指令干预设定，未覆盖场景变化与指令变化耦合的复杂情形
评估对象为VLA策略与WAM，结论对其他机器人策略架构的泛化性尚需验证
分析以诊断性实验为主，未提出并验证修复grounding gap的训练方法
papers.practical_value: 为机器人策略评估提供诊断框架，提醒工业界不能仅以任务成功率衡量指令遵循能力；在真实业务中，需引入场景保持的指令干预测试，防止策略在用户意图变化时固着于场景偏好行为，从而提升人机交互安全性与可靠性。
papers.why_it_matters: 该研究挑战了以任务成功率作为指令遵循代理指标的惯例，揭示语言被编码却不控制动作的深层机制，为VLA与WAM的评测和后续对齐训练提供了可复用的诊断工具与明确进展判据。

papers.title: FreeSpeed: Training-Free Speed Control for Generative Robot Policies
papers.abstract: Online control of execution speed is essential for deploying robot policies in real-world scenarios, as robots may need to speed up under time constraints or slow down to facilitate human interaction and improve safety. However, imitation-learned policies inherit the execution speed of their demonstrations, and test-time speed modification can introduce unrecoverable out-of-distribution observations, reducing task success. We observe that the directional inconsistency of action chunks reflects task-phase criticality, indicating how aggressively action step lengths can be modified while preserving task success. Based on this observation, we introduce FreeSpeed, a training-free module that post-processes action chunks from pretrained policies. FreeSpeed resamples each predicted chunk at the requested rate, then uses directional inconsistency between adjacent actions as the primary signal for rescaling. This signal adaptively determines how closely the execution speed can approach the requested speed, allowing flexible speed adjustment within the evaluated limits without compromising task success. Across three policy families and 50 simulated tasks, FreeSpeed supports online speed changes, with realized execution rates spanning 0.22x to 2.53x among settings that preserve per-task success. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, FreeSpeed achieves an average success rate of 94.0%, matching the frozen policy's 93.8%, while realizing execution rates from 0.38x to 1.97x.
papers.summary: FreeSpeed 关注机器人模仿学习策略在真实部署中无法在线调节执行速度的问题：策略继承示教速度，测试时直接改速会引入不可恢复的分布外观测并降低任务成功率。作者观察到动作块的方向不一致性可反映任务阶段的关键程度，据此提出免训练后处理模块 FreeSpeed：先按请求速率对预训练策略输出的动作块重采样，再以相邻动作的方向不一致性作为主信号进行自适应缩放，决定执行速度能多接近请求速度，从而在不损害任务成功的前提下实现灵活调速。在三个策略家族、50 个仿真任务上支持在线变速，保持逐任务成功的设置下实现 0.22x 至 2.53x 的执行速率；四个真实操作任务平均成功率 94.0%，与冻结策略的 93.8% 基本持平，实现 0.38x 至 1.97x 的执行速率。
papers.one_line_takeaway: FreeSpeed 用动作块方向不一致性作为任务阶段关键性信号，对预训练机器人策略做免训练动作块重采样与自适应缩放，在保持成功率的同时实现在线变速。
papers.core_method: FreeSpeed 是作用于预训练策略输出动作块的后处理模块，无需额外训练。它先按请求速率对每个预测动作块重采样，再计算相邻动作之间的方向不一致性，将其作为任务阶段关键性的代理信号，并据此自适应地缩放动作步长，决定实际执行速度能在多大程度上逼近请求速度，从而在评估范围内实现灵活调速。
innovation_points: 提出以动作块方向不一致性作为任务阶段关键性信号，用于判断动作步长可被修改的激进程度
设计免训练的后处理模块，直接对预训练策略的动作块重采样与自适应缩放，无需微调或额外数据
支持在线速度调节，并在保持逐任务成功的约束下给出可实现的执行速率范围
experiment_results: 在三个策略家族、50 个仿真任务上支持在线变速，保持逐任务成功的设置下实现 0.22x 至 2.53x 的执行速率
在四个真实世界操作任务上平均成功率 94.0%，与冻结策略的 93.8% 基本持平
真实任务中实现 0.38x 至 1.97x 的执行速率
limitations: 速度调节范围受方向不一致性信号约束，仅在评估限定的速率区间内保证任务成功，超出范围的效果未给出数据
真实世界验证仅覆盖四个操作任务，场景与任务多样性有限
方法依赖预训练策略输出动作块的可重采样性，对不输出动作块或动作粒度不同的策略适用性未说明
papers.practical_value: 面向真实机器人部署，FreeSpeed 让已训练好的模仿学习策略在不重新训练的情况下按需加速或减速，兼顾时间约束、人机交互与安全性，降低线上策略改造成本，并给出可保持任务成功的执行速率区间，便于工程侧设定安全速度边界。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把执行速度这一部署期关键变量转化为对预训练策略的免训练后处理问题，避免测试时改速带来的分布外失败，为机器人策略上线后的在线调速提供了可落地且低成本的工程路径。

papers.title: VLA-ZO: Fast Zeroth-Order Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Adapting vision-language-action (VLA) models to deployment-time distribution shifts is important for reliable robotic operation, but conventional first-order adaptation can exceed the memory budget of inference-oriented deployment platforms. Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization offers a forward-only alternative with inference-level memory, but accurate gradient estimation requires many perturbation queries, making naive ZO prohibitively slow for large VLA models. We present VLA-ZO, a framework for fast ZO adaptation that exploits the structure of VLA computation. By confining adaptation to the action side, VLA-ZO keeps the expensive vision-language prefix frozen and reuses its conditioning states across perturbation queries and optimizer steps, while schedule-aware prefetching hides state-transfer overhead. On LIBERO camera-viewpoint shifts, VLA-ZO reduces end-to-end adaptation time by 25.59$\times$ at $q=16$ and 32.54$\times$ at $q=64$ relative to baseline ZO, while improving average task success from 48.27% without adaptation to 58.17% and 63.58%, respectively. These results show that making ZO faster can make larger query budgets practical, providing a promising path toward resource-efficient VLA adaptation on deployment platforms.
papers.summary: VLA-ZO聚焦视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在部署时面对分布偏移的适配问题：一阶微调常超出推理平台内存预算，而零阶（ZO）优化虽只需前向计算、内存开销接近推理，却因梯度估计需要大量扰动查询而速度过慢。作者提出利用VLA计算结构的快速ZO适配框架：将适配限制在动作侧，冻结昂贵的视觉-语言前缀，并在多次扰动查询与优化器步之间复用其条件状态，同时用调度感知预取隐藏状态传输开销。在LIBERO相机视角偏移任务上，相对基线ZO，q=16时端到端适配时间降低25.59倍，q=64时降低32.54倍；平均任务成功率从无适配的48.27%分别提升至58.17%和63.58%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: VLA-ZO通过冻结视觉-语言前缀并复用条件状态，把零阶适配加速数十倍，使大查询预算在部署平台上变得可行。
papers.core_method: 将ZO适配限定在动作侧，冻结视觉-语言前缀并跨扰动查询与优化器步复用其条件状态，配合调度感知预取隐藏状态传输开销，从而在推理级内存下实现快速零阶适配。
innovation_points: 利用VLA计算结构，把适配限制在动作侧，避免对昂贵视觉-语言前缀做扰动与重计算
跨扰动查询和优化器步复用前缀条件状态，显著降低ZO梯度估计的重复前向成本
引入调度感知预取，隐藏状态传输开销，提升端到端适配吞吐
证明加速ZO可使更大查询预算变得实用，从而同时改善成功率
experiment_results: LIBERO相机视角偏移下，q=16时端到端适配时间相对基线ZO降低25.59倍
q=64时端到端适配时间降低32.54倍
limitations: 实验仅覆盖LIBERO相机视角偏移场景，其他分布偏移与真实机器人平台的泛化性未验证
方法依赖VLA动作侧可分离与前缀状态可复用的结构假设
摘要未报告内存占用的绝对数值与更大规模VLA上的扩展性
papers.practical_value: 为内存受限的推理型部署平台提供了一种无需一阶反传的VLA在线适配路径，降低适配时间与内存门槛，使机器人部署时应对视角等分布偏移更可行。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把零阶优化的速度瓶颈转化为结构复用问题，证明加速后的大查询预算能同时带来时间收益与成功率提升，为资源高效的VLA部署适配提供了可操作方向。

papers.title: When to Switch: Reliable Action-Chunk Extension for Vision-Language-Action Models
affiliations: Pohang University of Science and Technology
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models serve as unified policies for robotic manipulation, yet their expensive inference forces robots to pause between policy calls, resulting in stop-and-go execution that interrupts smooth motion and prolongs task completion. Extending the action chunk reduces policy calls and hence these pauses, but predicting farther into the future makes long-chunk execution unreliable. To understand where this unreliability arises, we analyze action errors within long chunks and find that they concentrate around transitions between manipulation subskills, growing sharply with chunk length. This suggests the importance of transition timing, i.e., when to switch subskills within a chunk. Motivated by this observation, we introduce RACE (Reliable Action-Chunk Extension), a framework that predicts the transition timing from an auxiliary one-step denoising pass and conditions action generation on it. By learning and conditioning on transition timing, RACE reduces errors at subskill transitions and enables reliable execution of longer action chunks. Across simulation benchmarks, RACE outperforms fine-tuning at the same chunk length; with 2x longer chunks, it surpasses recent state-of-the-art and efficient VLAs in success rate, and with 4x longer chunks, it remains competitive. On a real robot, RACE uses 4x longer chunks, which reduces the idle time caused by stop-and-go execution by about 5x, while achieving a higher success rate than fine-tuning with the same chunk length. Code and a real-robot demo are available at https://github.com/Seonghoon-Yu/RACE-VLA
papers.summary: 该论文研究视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作中的推理效率问题。VLA 模型推理开销大，导致机器人在策略调用之间停顿，形成走走停停的执行方式，既打断平滑运动又延长任务完成时间。延长动作块可减少策略调用与停顿，但预测更远的未来会使长块执行不可靠。作者分析长动作块内的动作误差，发现误差集中在操作子技能之间的切换处，并随块长度急剧增大，说明切换时机（即块内何时切换子技能）至关重要。据此提出 RACE 框架，通过一次辅助的单步去噪过程预测切换时机，并以该时机为条件生成动作。实验表明，在相同块长度下 RACE 优于微调；块长度延长 2 倍时成功率超过近期 SOTA 与高效 VLA，延长 4 倍时仍具竞争力；真实机器人上使用 4 倍长块将走走停停造成的空闲时间减少约 5 倍，且成功率高于是同块长度微调。
papers.one_line_takeaway: RACE 通过预测并条件化子技能切换时机，使 VLA 模型能够可靠执行更长的动作块，从而显著减少机器人走走停停的停顿。
papers.core_method: 分析长动作块内动作误差的分布，发现误差集中于子技能切换处且随块长度增长；提出 RACE 框架，利用一次辅助的单步去噪过程预测切换时机，并将该时机作为条件注入动作生成，从而在子技能切换处降低误差，支持更长动作块的可靠执行。
innovation_points: 揭示长动作块不可靠性的来源：动作误差集中在操作子技能切换处，并随块长度急剧增大
将切换时机作为显式预测目标，通过辅助单步去噪过程预测并以之为条件生成动作
在不增加策略调用次数的前提下延长动作块，兼顾推理效率与执行可靠性
experiment_results: 仿真基准中，相同块长度下 RACE 成功率优于微调
块长度延长 2 倍时成功率超过近期 SOTA 与高效 VLA，延长 4 倍时仍具竞争力
真实机器人上使用 4 倍长块，走走停停导致的空闲时间减少约 5 倍，成功率高于是同块长度微调
limitations: 摘要未给出各仿真基准的具体成功率数值与统计显著性
真实机器人实验的规模、任务种类与评估协议在摘要中未详细说明
方法依赖对子技能切换时机的准确预测，切换定义或标注方式的影响未在摘要中讨论
papers.practical_value: 面向机器人操作部署，RACE 通过延长动作块减少策略调用次数与执行停顿，在真实机器人上将走走停停造成的空闲时间减少约 5 倍，同时保持或提升成功率，有助于提升 VLA 策略在真实硬件上的执行流畅度与任务完成效率。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作从误差分析出发定位长动作块不可靠的关键原因，并给出轻量且可落地的切换时机条件化方案，对提升 VLA 模型推理效率与真实机器人执行平滑性具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: CIRRA: Dual-Level Continual Instruction Reconciliation with Ongoing Execution for Embodied Robot Agents in Interactive Household Tasks
papers.abstract: Household robots must accommodate new user instructions while executing ongoing tasks. Existing agents often regenerate or extensively revise the remaining task sequence, introducing plan ambiguity, logical inconsistency, and redundant execution. We formulate continual instruction reconciliation and propose CIRRA (Continual Instruction Reconciliation for Robot Agents), a dual-level framework combining LLM-based semantic reasoning with rule-constrained structural integration. CIRRA first grounds incoming instructions to unique executable skills and resolves underspecified actions and execution locations. It then preserves the ongoing subtask sequence as an execution backbone and generates integration candidates by inserting incoming subtasks into location-matched segments. The semantic reasoner evaluates only modified segments to identify dependencies and conflicts and select the most logically coherent local integration. This structure-preserving process maintains alignment with ongoing execution, mitigates ambiguity and inconsistency, and reuses shared subtasks to reduce redundant execution. We also introduce CHIRP (Continual Household Instruction Reconciliation and Planning), a text-based benchmark of 120 episodes across eight household environments and six categories of everyday activities. On CHIRP, CIRRA achieves 74.2% decision agreement, exceeding the strongest replanning baseline by 30 percentage points; every correct fusion decision yields a correctly placed, conflict-free schedule. On a Unitree G1 humanoid, CIRRA interrupts ongoing skills at the correct moment in every trial and significantly outperforms all baselines on every metric.
papers.summary: 该论文研究家庭机器人在执行进行中任务时如何接纳新用户指令的问题，指出既有智能体常重新生成或大幅改写剩余任务序列，导致计划歧义、逻辑不一致与冗余执行。作者将问题形式化为持续指令协调，提出CIRRA双层框架：先用LLM语义推理把新指令落地为唯一可执行技能，并消解欠指定动作与执行位置；再以进行中子任务序列为执行骨架，将新子任务插入位置匹配的片段生成候选，语义推理器仅评估被修改片段以识别依赖与冲突，选出逻辑最连贯的局部整合。结构保持过程维持与进行中执行的对齐，复用共享子任务以减少冗余。作者还构建CHIRP文本基准，含八个家庭环境、六类日常活动共120个回合。在CHIRP上CIRRA决策一致率达74.2%，超最强重规划基线30个百分点；在Unitree G1人形机器人上每次试验均在正确时机中断进行中技能，各指标显著优于基线。
papers.one_line_takeaway: CIRRA以结构保持的双层协调替代整体重规划，让家庭机器人在执行中更一致、低冗余地接纳新指令。
papers.core_method: 将新指令经LLM语义推理落地为唯一可执行技能并消解欠指定动作与位置；以进行中子任务序列为执行骨架，按位置匹配插入新子任务生成候选；仅对修改片段做依赖与冲突评估，选择最连贯的局部整合，并复用共享子任务。
innovation_points: 将执行中接纳新指令形式化为持续指令协调问题，强调结构保持而非整体重生成
提出语义推理与规则约束结构整合相结合的双层框架，局部评估修改片段
构建CHIRP文本基准，覆盖八个家庭环境与六类日常活动共120回合
在真实人形机器人Unitree G1上验证正确时机中断与执行表现
experiment_results: CHIRP上决策一致率74.2%，超最强重规划基线30个百分点
每个正确融合决策均产生位置正确且无冲突的调度
Unitree G1上每次试验均在正确时机中断进行中技能，各指标显著优于所有基线
limitations: 基准为文本形式，未覆盖视觉感知与真实家庭长时程多样性
方法依赖LLM语义推理与规则约束，对欠指定指令的消解能力受限于技能与位置匹配质量
摘要未报告真实机器人上的任务成功率与冗余执行量化数据
papers.practical_value: 面向家庭服务机器人真实业务场景，在任务执行中接纳新指令时避免整体重规划带来的歧义与冗余，保持执行连续性；结构保持与局部评估降低在线推理开销，便于工程部署与安全中断控制。
papers.why_it_matters: 它把执行中指令协调从重规划问题转为结构保持的局部整合问题，并给出基准与真实人形机器人验证，对具身智能体的在线任务管理有直接参考价值。

papers.title: From Prediction to Recommendation: A Hybrid Machine Learning and Fine-Tuned Language Model Approach for Soil-Based Crop Recommendation
affiliations: The University of Texas at Austin
papers.abstract: Abstract Crop recommendation is an important decision-support task in agriculture, where multiple crops may be suitable under similar soil and environmental conditions. In this paper, we propose a hybrid framework that combines classical machine learning with a fine-tuned lightweight language model for soil-based crop recommendation. We first evaluate several classical machine learning models and a neural network baseline on tabular agricultural data. Our results show that XGBoost achieves the best predictive performance (0.487 Top-1 and 0.770 Top-3 accuracy across 48 crop classes), while a Multi-Layer Perceptron does not provide meaningful improvement over tree-based methods. Because strict single-label prediction is often inadequate in agricultural settings, we reformulate the task as a Top-K recommendation problem and show that Top-3 accuracy provides a more realistic measure of practical utility. To improve interpretability and usability, we further fine-tune a lightweight language model using LoRA to generate structured, farmer-friendly recommendations conditioned on machine learning predictions. Qualitative evaluation on held-out examples demonstrates that the fine-tuned model produces more coherent, grounded, and useful outputs than the base model. Overall, our results highlight the effectiveness of combining tabular machine learning for prediction with language models for explanation in agricultural decision-support systems.
categories: Data Mining and Machine Learning Applications
papers.summary: 该论文研究土壤驱动的作物推荐问题：在相似土壤与环境条件下多种作物均可能适宜，严格单标签预测难以满足农业决策需求。作者先在表格农业数据上系统评估多种经典机器学习模型与神经网络基线，发现XGBoost预测性能最佳（48类作物下Top-1为0.487、Top-3为0.770），而多层感知机相对树模型无实质提升。据此将任务重构为Top-K推荐问题，并以Top-3准确率作为更贴近实际效用的度量。为提升可解释性与可用性，作者进一步用LoRA微调轻量语言模型，以机器学习预测为条件生成结构化、面向农户的推荐说明；在留出样例上的定性评估显示，微调模型输出比基座模型更连贯、更有依据且更有用。整体上，该工作展示了表格机器学习负责预测、语言模型负责解释的混合决策支持路径。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 用XGBoost做Top-K作物预测、用LoRA微调轻量语言模型生成农户可读解释，是农业决策支持中预测与解释分工的可行组合。
papers.core_method: 在表格农业数据上对比经典机器学习模型与神经网络基线，确定XGBoost为最佳预测器；将单标签分类重构为Top-K推荐并以Top-3准确率衡量实用性；再以机器学习预测为条件，用LoRA微调轻量语言模型生成结构化、农户友好的推荐文本。
innovation_points: 将作物推荐从严格单标签预测重构为Top-K推荐问题，更贴合多作物适宜的农业实际
采用预测与解释分离的混合架构：表格模型负责判别，微调语言模型负责生成可读推荐
使用LoRA对轻量语言模型进行条件化微调，以较低成本获得结构化农户友好输出
experiment_results: XGBoost在48类作物上取得Top-1 0.487、Top-3 0.770，为所评估模型中最佳
多层感知机相对树模型方法未带来有意义的提升
留出样例上的定性评估显示，LoRA微调模型输出比基座模型更连贯、更有依据且更有用；未报告语言模型侧的定量指标
limitations: Top-1准确率仅0.487，整体预测精度仍有限
语言模型部分仅做定性评估，缺少系统性定量评测
研究基于单一表格数据集，跨区域、跨作物体系的泛化性未验证
papers.practical_value: 为农业决策支持提供可落地范式：以树模型给出Top-K候选作物保证预测可靠性，再以轻量微调语言模型生成农户可理解的结构化建议，兼顾准确性与可用性，且LoRA微调成本较低，便于在资源受限场景部署。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作直面农业推荐中多作物适宜的模糊性，把评估重心从单标签准确率转向Top-K实用性，并给出预测与解释分工的轻量混合方案，对构建面向终端农户的决策支持系统具有参考价值。

papers.title: Benchmarking Jailbreak Guardrails for Embodied Agents
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
papers.abstract: Embodied agents powered by large language models and vision-language models are increasingly deployed in physical environments, but jailbreak attacks can induce these agents to perform physically harmful actions. A growing number of guardrail methods have been proposed to intercept dangerous behavior before it is executed, yet existing safety benchmarks evaluate the embodied models themselves, leaving it unclear how well these guardrails actually defend an embodied agent in practice. We present the first systematic evaluation of jailbreak guardrails for embodied agents. To compare guardrails under identical conditions, we build a pluggable evaluation framework that treats the embodied agent as a fixed backend and each guardrail as a module that can intervene at the perception, planning, or control stage. We subject six representative guardrails to template-based and automated jailbreak attacks as well as safe instructions, and assess them at the system level along three dimensions: defense effectiveness, measured by the bypass rate and the hazard success rate in the simulator; usability, measured by the false-positive rate and the task completion rate on safe instructions; and efficiency, measured by the latency overhead added at runtime. Experiments on guardrails that span different intervention stages, decision mechanisms, and input modalities reveal a clear trade-off among the three dimensions, and show that no single guardrail dominates in all settings. We further analyze how intervention stage, decision mechanism, and input modality shape safety outcomes, and we offer practical guidance for selecting and designing guardrails for embodied agents.
papers.summary: 该论文针对具身智能体越狱防护栏缺乏系统评测的问题，构建了首个可插拔评测框架：将具身智能体视为固定后端，把防护栏作为可在感知、规划或控制阶段介入的模块，在相同条件下比较六种代表性防护栏。评测覆盖模板化与自动化越狱攻击及安全指令，从系统层面衡量防御有效性（绕过率、模拟器危害成功率）、可用性（误报率、安全指令任务完成率）和效率（运行时延迟开销）。实验揭示三者在不同介入阶段、决策机制与输入模态下存在明显权衡，没有单一防护栏在所有设置中占优，并给出防护栏选择与设计的实践建议。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 首个具身智能体越狱防护栏系统评测显示，防御有效性、可用性与效率之间存在明显权衡，没有单一方案全面占优。
papers.core_method: 构建可插拔评测框架，将具身智能体固定为后端，防护栏作为可在感知、规划、控制阶段介入的模块；对六种代表性防护栏统一施加模板化与自动化越狱攻击及安全指令，从防御有效性、可用性、效率三个系统级维度进行评测。
innovation_points: 首个针对具身智能体越狱防护栏的系统性评测，而非评测具身模型本身
提出可插拔框架，将防护栏抽象为感知、规划、控制三阶段可介入模块，实现同条件对比
同时覆盖模板化与自动化越狱攻击以及安全指令，兼顾攻防两侧
从防御有效性、可用性、效率三维度做系统级量化，并分析介入阶段、决策机制、输入模态的影响
experiment_results: 六种代表性防护栏在防御有效性、可用性与效率之间存在明显权衡，没有单一防护栏在所有设置中占优
介入阶段、决策机制与输入模态会显著影响安全结果
摘要未给出具体绕过率、危害成功率、误报率、任务完成率与延迟数值
limitations: 评测仅覆盖六种代表性防护栏，样本范围有限
实验在模拟器中进行，与真实物理部署存在差距
摘要未报告具体量化指标，难以直接比较各防护栏的绝对性能
papers.practical_value: 为具身智能体部署方在选择和设计越狱防护栏时提供系统级评测依据，帮助在安全性、任务可用性与运行时开销之间做权衡，并指导防护栏介入阶段与输入模态的设计。
papers.why_it_matters: 具身智能体直接作用于物理环境，越狱攻击可导致现实危害；该工作填补了防护栏实际防御效果缺乏系统评测的空白，为安全部署提供可复用的评测框架与实践指引。

papers.title: Inspect Robots: Evaluating the Capabilities and Safety of Embodied AI
papers.abstract: General purpose language models are increasingly able to control robotic hardware. Understanding the capabilities and safety of these models when embodied is therefore increasingly important for understanding their societal impact and risks. To this end, we introduce Inspect Robots, a modular, open-source framework for developing and running evaluations of embodied agents. Inspect Robots pairs customizable, reusable abstractions for specifying physical evaluations and analyzing their results with infrastructure that automates evaluation setup, execution and termination. We demonstrate Inspect Robots by using it to evaluate the capabilities and safety of six policies based on frontier language models. Inspect Robots has seen significant early uptake, receiving nearly 100,000 downloads in the three months since its release.
categories: Ethics and Social Impacts of AI
papers.summary: 该论文针对通用语言模型日益具备控制机器人硬件能力这一趋势，提出需要系统评估具身化后模型的能力与安全风险。作者发布Inspect Robots——一个模块化、开源框架，用于开发与运行具身智能体评估。框架提供可定制、可复用的抽象层来指定物理评估并分析结果，同时配套自动化评估搭建、执行与终止的基础设施。作者用该框架评估了六个基于前沿语言模型的策略的能力与安全性，作为框架演示。论文未在摘要中给出具体评估数值结果。框架发布三个月获得近10万次下载，显示早期采用度较高。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Inspect Robots为具身语言模型提供模块化开源评估框架，并演示了对六个前沿模型策略的能力与安全评估。
papers.core_method: 提出模块化开源框架Inspect Robots：以可定制、可复用的抽象层描述物理评估任务与结果分析，并配套自动化评估搭建、执行和终止的基础设施；用该框架对六个基于前沿语言模型的策略进行能力与安全评估演示。
innovation_points: 面向具身智能体评估的模块化、开源框架，强调可复用抽象与自动化执行基础设施
同时覆盖能力评估与安全评估两个维度
以六个基于前沿语言模型的策略作为评估对象进行框架演示
发布三个月获近10万次下载，体现社区早期采用度
experiment_results: 摘要未提供六个策略的具体能力或安全评估数值结果，仅说明完成了演示性评估
摘要提及框架发布三个月获得近100,000次下载
limitations: 摘要未给出具体评估指标、任务集规模或定量结论，难以判断评估覆盖度
仅基于标题、摘要和学术元数据，无法核实评估设计的细节与可复现性
作为框架论文，对具身安全风险的度量方法深度未在摘要中展开
papers.practical_value: 为研究者和开发者提供可复用的具身智能体评估基础设施，降低搭建物理评估、执行与终止流程的工程成本，并支持对基于语言模型的机器人策略进行能力与安全对比。
papers.why_it_matters: 随着语言模型越来越多地直接控制机器人硬件，系统化评估其具身能力与安全风险成为理解社会影响的关键环节；该框架开源且早期采用度高，可作为具身评估的公共基础设施参考。

papers.title: GeoBridge-VLA: Geometry-Aware Residual Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models encode semantic information from vision-language pretraining, but manipulation also requires precise spatial reasoning. We present GeoBridge-VLA, a two-stage method for learning geometric features from a pretrained VLA's frozen visual encoder and using them for action prediction. Stage I trains a feature bridge and geometry decoder with depth supervision. Stage II freezes these modules and trains a gated residual interface together with the action-side projections and action expert. The residual augments the existing visual tokens without adding a second image encoder or increasing the token count. Deployment requires RGB, robot state, and language, but no depth observations. Under matched evaluation conditions, GeoBridge-VLA achieves 70.9% success on LIBERO, compared with 60.0% for SmolVLA. Disabling the residual in the same trained checkpoint reduces success from 70.90% to 69.85%, with mixed effects across suites. On a physical ROBOTIS OMY robot, GeoBridge-VLA succeeds in 148 of 200 trials (74.0%) across four tasks, compared with 108 of 200 (54.0%) for SmolVLA.
papers.summary: GeoBridge-VLA针对视觉-语言-动作模型在操作任务中空间推理不足的问题，提出两阶段几何感知残差适配方法。Stage I利用冻结的预训练VLA视觉编码器，通过深度监督训练特征桥接模块与几何解码器，从视觉特征中学习几何信息；Stage II冻结上述模块，训练门控残差接口及动作侧投影与动作专家，将几何特征以残差方式增强原有视觉token，不引入第二个图像编码器，也不增加token数量。部署时仅需RGB、机器人状态与语言，无需深度观测。在LIBERO上成功率70.9%，高于SmolVLA的60.0%；同一检查点禁用残差后降至69.85%，各套件效果不一。在ROBOTIS OMY实体机器人四任务200次试验中成功148次（74.0%），SmolVLA为108次（54.0%）。
papers.one_line_takeaway: GeoBridge-VLA用冻结视觉编码器加两阶段几何残差适配，在不增加编码器和token的前提下提升VLA操作成功率。
papers.core_method: 两阶段训练：Stage I在冻结VLA视觉编码器上以深度监督训练特征桥接与几何解码器；Stage II冻结几何模块，训练门控残差接口、动作侧投影和动作专家，将几何特征残差式注入现有视觉token，部署仅用RGB、状态和语言。
innovation_points: 从冻结VLA视觉编码器中提取几何特征，避免引入第二个图像编码器或增加token数量
门控残差接口将几何信息增强到原有视觉token，保持原模型接口与推理成本结构
训练依赖深度监督，但部署不需要深度观测，降低实际部署传感器要求
experiment_results: LIBERO上成功率70.9%，SmolVLA为60.0%
同一检查点禁用残差后成功率从70.90%降至69.85%，各套件效果不一
ROBOTIS OMY实体机器人四任务200次试验成功148次（74.0%），SmolVLA为108次（54.0%）
limitations: 残差消融显示增益有限且跨套件效果混合，几何残差贡献的稳定性有待进一步验证
摘要未报告推理延迟、显存占用等部署开销数据
实体机器人实验仅涉及四任务和单一平台，泛化性证据有限
papers.practical_value: 部署仅需RGB、机器人状态和语言，无需深度传感器，且不增加图像编码器与token数量，便于在现有VLA推理栈上做轻量适配，对真实机器人操作任务有直接工程参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作提供了一条在冻结VLA基座上注入几何空间推理能力的低成本路径，兼顾语义预训练优势与操作精度需求，并通过仿真与实体机器人对比给出可复现的增益证据。

papers.title: Vela: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models with Adaptive Action Curve Parametrization
papers.abstract: Most vision-language-action models represent future motion as fixed-rate action chunks, tying temporal resolution and prediction horizon to a fixed output budget. This pointwise representation wastes capacity on highly correlated neighboring actions, leaves temporal continuity and smoothness to be learned implicitly, and forces a tradeoff between long-horizon coverage and the local precision required for contact-rich manipulation. To address these limitations, we introduce Vela, a vision-language-action foundation model that represents future robot behavior as continuous trajectories. Vela combines a compact spline-based action representation with motion-dependent temporal support and a shared action interface for heterogeneous embodiments, allowing a fixed output budget to adapt its temporal resolution across motions. We pretrain Vela on large-scale multi-embodiment robot data and evaluate it on LIBERO-X, EBench, and two real-world long-horizon tasks, egg-cake cooking and potato shredding, obtaining promising results across simulation and physical manipulation. These results highlight the potential of continuous action representations as a foundation for future embodied foundation models. Project page and more results: https://clementine24.github.io/Vela/ .
papers.summary: Vela针对视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）普遍采用固定速率动作块表示未来运动、导致时间分辨率与预测视野受固定输出预算约束的问题，提出以连续轨迹表示机器人未来行为。其核心是紧凑的样条动作表示、随运动变化的时间支撑（motion-dependent temporal support）以及面向异构本体的共享动作接口，使固定输出预算能按运动自适应调整时间分辨率，避免在高度相关的相邻动作上浪费容量，并显式建模时间连续性与平滑性。作者在大规模多本体机器人数据上预训练Vela，并在LIBERO-X、EBench以及真实世界长程任务（蛋饼烹饪、土豆切丝）上评估，取得有希望的结果。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Vela用样条连续轨迹替代固定速率动作块，让固定输出预算按运动自适应分配时间分辨率，在仿真与真实长程操作任务上验证了连续动作表示的潜力。
papers.core_method: 将未来机器人行为表示为连续轨迹：采用紧凑的样条基函数参数化动作曲线，并引入随运动变化的时间支撑，使同一输出预算在不同运动段上自适应调整时间分辨率；同时设计共享动作接口以兼容异构本体。模型在大规模多本体机器人数据上预训练，形成VLA基座，再在仿真基准与真实长程任务上评估。
innovation_points: 以样条连续轨迹替代逐点固定速率动作块，显式编码时间连续性与平滑性，减少相邻高相关动作的容量浪费
引入运动相关的时间支撑，使固定输出预算能按运动自适应分配时间分辨率，缓解长程覆盖与局部精度之间的权衡
设计面向异构本体的共享动作接口，支持多本体数据联合预训练
在真实世界长程接触丰富任务（蛋饼烹饪、土豆切丝）上验证连续动作表示
experiment_results: 在LIBERO-X、EBench两个仿真基准上评估，摘要称取得有希望的结果，但未给出具体数值
在真实世界长程任务蛋饼烹饪与土豆切丝上评估，摘要称取得有希望的结果，但未给出量化指标
预训练使用大规模多本体机器人数据，具体数据规模与消融结果未在给定材料中披露
limitations: 给定材料未提供与固定动作块基线的定量对比和消融数据，难以判断各组件贡献
真实世界评估仅提及两个长程任务，未报告成功率、精度等具体指标
样条表示与自适应时间支撑在接触丰富的高频控制场景下的适用边界未在材料中说明
papers.practical_value: 面向机器人操作的企业场景，Vela的连续轨迹表示可在不增加输出预算的前提下兼顾长程任务覆盖与接触丰富操作的局部精度，并借助共享动作接口降低多本体数据联合训练的工程成本，对长程操作任务的部署具有参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 动作表示是VLA基座的关键设计选择，Vela将固定速率动作块改为自适应时间分辨率的连续轨迹，为长程覆盖与局部精度的权衡提供了新思路，并给出仿真与真实任务的初步验证，值得关注具身基座模型表示设计的研究者阅读。

papers.title: Beyond LLM Serving: Characterizing Vision-Language-Action Workloads for Embodied AI System Design
affiliations: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models translate multimodal observations into low-level robot actions. During robot operation, each control period sets an inference deadline, and overruns leave the robot acting on stale observations, reducing task success. Meeting this deadline motivates on-device or nearby edge execution, where a single robot requires batch-1 inference outside the design point of LLM serving systems. Although VLA architectures combine familiar vision-language, autoregressive, and diffusion-style components, their runtime behavior in this batch-1 control setting remains uncharacterized. We characterize four representative VLA models on an edge GPU server and two onboard SoCs, using single-inference profiling and 43,200 closed-loop episodes. Action tensor dimensionality determines whether a stage is memory- or compute-bound, platform balance can shift that bottleneck, and GPU frequency scaling yields a platform-dependent energy-latency sweet spot. In closed-loop operation, overlapping inference with action execution creates an accuracy-speed-energy tradeoff, and no configuration is Pareto-dominant across deployment SLOs. These results guide joint design of VLA model architectures, hardware, and runtime policies.
papers.summary: 该论文针对具身智能场景下视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的运行时特征展开系统刻画。研究指出，机器人每个控制周期都设有推理截止时间，超时会导致机器人基于过期观测行动并降低任务成功率，因此VLA推理需在机载或近端边缘设备上以batch-1方式执行，偏离了现有LLM serving系统的设计点。作者在边缘GPU服务器与两款机载SoC上对四个代表性VLA模型进行单次推理剖析，并运行43,200个闭环episode。结果显示：动作张量维度决定各阶段是访存受限还是计算受限，平台差异会改变瓶颈归属，GPU频率缩放存在平台相关的能耗-时延最优区间；闭环运行中推理与动作执行重叠会形成精度-速度-能耗权衡，且没有配置能在各部署SLO下帕累托占优。
papers.one_line_takeaway: VLA在batch-1闭环控制下的运行时瓶颈与权衡无法由LLM serving经验外推，需模型架构、硬件与运行时策略协同设计。
papers.core_method: 在边缘GPU服务器和两款机载SoC上，对四个代表性VLA模型做单次推理阶段级剖析，并结合43,200个闭环episode评估推理与动作执行重叠下的精度、速度与能耗表现。
innovation_points: 首次系统刻画VLA模型在batch-1机器人控制场景下的运行时行为，区别于LLM serving的批量吞吐设计点
揭示动作张量维度决定阶段访存/计算受限属性，且平台差异可迁移瓶颈归属
通过大规模闭环episode量化推理-执行重叠带来的精度-速度-能耗权衡，并指出无帕累托占优配置
experiment_results: 在边缘GPU服务器与两款机载SoC上完成四个VLA模型的单次推理剖析
闭环实验共43,200个episode，显示推理与动作执行重叠存在精度-速度-能耗权衡
GPU频率缩放呈现平台相关的能耗-时延最优区间；未给出具体数值指标
limitations: 仅覆盖四个代表性VLA模型与三类硬件平台，结论泛化范围有限
摘要未提供具体精度、时延与能耗数值，权衡关系缺乏定量细节
未涉及多机器人并发或云端协同等更复杂部署形态
papers.practical_value: 为具身智能系统的模型架构选型、边缘硬件配置与运行时调度策略提供实测依据，帮助部署方在控制截止时间约束下权衡精度、速度与能耗，避免直接套用LLM serving的优化假设。
papers.why_it_matters: 随着VLA模型走向真实机器人部署，batch-1闭环控制成为核心工作负载，本文填补了该类负载运行时特征的空缺，对系统与架构研究者具有直接参考价值。

papers.title: KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026: Reasoning Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation, has been attracted a surge of attentions in industrial and academic research community, towards to build more smart system to build next-generation recommender. Under the significant developing wave of large language model, our team have been developed Semantic ID based OneRec/OneRec-V2. These models have been widely deployed in production and demonstrate the scaling potential of the autoregressive next-item prediction paradigm for industrial recommender systems. Building on the success of OneRec, we further explored a series of models, including OneRec-Think, OpenOneRec, and OneReason, that connect item Semantic IDs with natural language in a unified representation space and seek to unlock the potential of natural-language chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning for recommendation. However, our preliminary works found that introducing reasoning CoT does not always improve the recommendation performance. To address this issue, OneReason strengthens the semantic alignment between items and language, introduces structured template-based supervision for interest reasoning, and applies advanced reinforcement learning techniques to make reasoning more beneficial to recommendation. As a frontier topic to building recommendation foundation models, we believe this topic has significant research value and hope to encourage more researchers to explore it together. To this end, together with the SIGIR 2026 community, we organized the KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026: Reasoning Generative Recommendation.
papers.summary: 本文是快手与SIGIR 2026联合举办的KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026的挑战赛介绍论文，聚焦推理生成式推荐这一前沿方向。作者团队基于此前在工业界大规模部署的OneRec/OneRec-V2语义ID生成式推荐模型，进一步探索了OneRec-Think、OpenOneRec和OneReason等模型，试图将物品语义ID与自然语言统一到同一表示空间，并解锁自然语言思维链推理对推荐的潜力。然而初步研究发现，引入推理思维链并不总能提升推荐性能。为此，OneReason通过增强物品与语言的语义对齐、引入结构化模板监督兴趣推理，并应用先进强化学习技术，使推理更有利于推荐。该工作旨在推动推荐基础模型的研究，并鼓励更多研究者参与探索。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 快手基于语义ID的生成式推荐模型OneRec系列在工业界成功部署后，进一步探索推理思维链在推荐中的应用，发现其并非总是有效，并通过OneReason的语义对齐与强化学习优化使推理真正服务于推荐。
papers.core_method: 基于语义ID的生成式推荐框架OneRec/OneRec-V2，将物品表示为语义ID并采用自回归下一项预测范式；进一步提出OneRec-Think、OpenOneRec和OneReason，其中OneReason通过统一表示空间对齐物品语义ID与自然语言，引入结构化模板监督兴趣推理，并应用强化学习技术优化推理过程以提升推荐性能。
innovation_points: 提出并工业部署了基于语义ID的生成式推荐模型OneRec/OneRec-V2，验证了自回归下一项预测范式在工业推荐系统中的扩展潜力。
探索了将物品语义ID与自然语言统一到同一表示空间的系列模型（OneRec-Think、OpenOneRec、OneReason），试图解锁自然语言思维链推理对推荐的潜力。
发现引入推理思维链并不总能提升推荐性能，并针对此问题在OneReason中通过语义对齐、结构化模板监督和强化学习使推理更有利于推荐。
experiment_results: OneRec/OneRec-V2已在生产环境中广泛部署，并展示了自回归下一项预测范式在工业推荐系统中的扩展潜力。
初步研究发现，引入推理思维链（CoT）并不总是提升推荐性能。
OneReason通过增强语义对齐、结构化模板监督和强化学习，使推理更有利于推荐，但摘要未提供具体量化实验结果。
limitations: 摘要未提供OneReason的具体实验数据和量化性能提升，无法评估其相对基线模型的改进程度。
推理思维链在推荐中的有效性仍不稳定，需要进一步研究其适用条件和优化方法。
作为挑战赛介绍论文，主要聚焦于问题提出和方向引导，未深入展开技术细节和全面实验验证。
papers.practical_value: OneRec/OneRec-V2已在快手生产环境中广泛部署，验证了生成式推荐在工业场景的可行性；OneReason通过强化学习和语义对齐提升推理对推荐的有效性，为构建下一代智能推荐系统提供了工程实践方向，并推动了推荐基础模型的研究。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作来自工业界大规模部署的生成式推荐系统，直面推理思维链在推荐中并非总是有效的关键问题，并提出了OneReason的解决方案，对生成式推荐和推荐基础模型的研究具有重要参考价值，同时通过挑战赛形式推动社区共同探索。

papers.title: Generative End-to-end Ad Retrieval at Douyin
papers.abstract: Generative retrieval reformulates recommendation as the generation of discrete item tokens. However, scaling this paradigm to real-world recommender systems reveals two critical bottlenecks: 1) Representation collapse, where the item tokenizer converges to degenerate results under continuous distribution shifts, fundamentally hindering stable end-to-end adaptation. 2) Item collisions, where the massive candidate pool causes distinct items to share identical token sequences, compromising the final retrieval precision. Crucially, these bottlenecks are inherently coupled: expanding codebook capacity to mitigate collisions inevitably exacerbates collapse. To address them simultaneously, we propose GEAR, an end-to-end framework that jointly optimizes the tokenizer, generator, and reranker. To mitigate representation collapse, we introduce BasisVQ, which re-parameterizes the codebook via an orthogonal basis to enable global gradient sharing and rigid spatial rotation of the latent space, effectively stabilizing gradient dynamics without ad-hoc heuristics. We further extend it to prefix-aware BasisRQ, substantially enhancing the codebook's expressiveness with the same asymptotic time complexity. To resolve item collisions, GEAR integrates a context-conditioned reranking head into the generative process, efficiently disambiguating colliding items with minimal computational overhead. By unifying stable tokenization and joint reranking within an end-to-end generative framework, GEAR establishes a fully differentiable and scalable paradigm. It currently serves hundreds of millions of daily active users on Douyin Ads, yielding substantial empirical improvements in extensive online A/B tests.
papers.summary: 本文针对生成式检索在真实推荐系统中面临的两个关键瓶颈：表示坍缩（tokenizer在连续分布偏移下退化）和物品碰撞（海量候选池导致不同物品共享相同token序列）展开研究。作者提出GEAR端到端框架，联合优化tokenizer、生成器和重排器。为缓解表示坍缩，设计BasisVQ，通过正交基重参数化码本，实现全局梯度共享和潜在空间的刚性旋转，稳定梯度动态；进一步扩展为前缀感知的BasisRQ，在不增加渐近时间复杂度的前提下增强码本表达能力。为解决物品碰撞，GEAR在生成过程中集成上下文条件重排头，以极低计算开销消歧碰撞物品。该框架在抖音广告系统服务数亿日活用户，在线A/B测试取得显著提升。
papers.one_line_takeaway: GEAR通过BasisVQ/BasisRQ稳定tokenizer训练并集成上下文重排头，解决了生成式检索在抖音广告中的表示坍缩与物品碰撞问题，实现了端到端可扩展的工业级部署。
papers.core_method: GEAR是一个端到端生成式检索框架，联合优化tokenizer、生成器和重排器。其核心包括：1）BasisVQ，利用正交基重参数化码本，实现全局梯度共享和潜在空间刚性旋转，稳定梯度动态；2）前缀感知的BasisRQ，在相同渐近时间复杂度下增强码本表达力；3）上下文条件重排头，在生成过程中消歧碰撞物品。
innovation_points: 提出BasisVQ，通过正交基重参数化码本，解决生成式检索中的表示坍缩问题，无需启发式技巧。
扩展为前缀感知的BasisRQ，在相同渐近时间复杂度下提升码本表达能力。
集成上下文条件重排头，以最小计算开销解决物品碰撞问题，实现端到端联合优化。
在抖音广告系统实现大规模部署，服务数亿日活用户，并通过在线A/B测试验证有效性。
experiment_results: 在抖音广告的在线A/B测试中取得显著经验提升，具体指标未在摘要中提供。
系统当前服务数亿日活用户，验证了工业级可扩展性。
limitations: 摘要未提供离线实验的量化结果，如召回率、碰撞率等具体指标。
未与其他生成式检索方法进行详细的对比实验分析。
方法在抖音广告场景验证，泛化到其他推荐场景的有效性需进一步研究。
papers.practical_value: GEAR为工业级生成式检索提供了可落地的解决方案，通过BasisVQ和BasisRQ稳定训练，重排头消歧碰撞，在抖音广告服务数亿用户，显著提升线上效果，对大规模推荐系统有直接参考价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作直面生成式检索在真实推荐系统中的两大耦合瓶颈，提出创新性的端到端解决方案，并在超大规模工业场景验证，为生成式推荐的研究与落地提供了重要参考。

papers.title: Characteristics of China's Embodied AI (Physical AI) Policy and Legal System and Korea's Regulatory Innovation Tasks : Focusing on the Humanoid Robot Industry
papers.summary: 该论文题为《中国具身智能（物理AI）政策与法律体系的特征及韩国的监管创新任务：以人形机器人产业为中心》，发表于《Korean Chinese Relations Review》。由于仅有标题与来源、无摘要，无法确认具体研究问题、技术路线与实证结果。从标题推断，研究属于政策与法律比较分析，聚焦中国人形机器人产业相关的政策法律体系特征，并讨论韩国在监管创新方面的任务。该文不涉及基座大模型预训练、架构、数据、扩展规律、对齐后训练或推理系统等技术内容，也不涉及生成式推荐或语义ID。其价值在于为具身智能产业的政策与监管比较提供框架性讨论，但缺少可核验的实验数据与量化结论。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 一篇比较中国具身智能政策法律体系与韩国监管创新任务的人形机器人产业政策论文，无技术实验数据。
papers.core_method: 基于标题与来源判断，采用政策与法律文本比较分析，围绕中国人形机器人产业的政策法律体系特征展开，并对照提出韩国监管创新任务；无摘要，无法确认具体分析框架与样本范围。
